NAME: Billie
TEXT: Meet Billie 💕A gentle, loving little girl who takes a little time to feel safe in new surroundings, but once she knows she's with kind people, she begins to relax and show her beautiful soul. Billie is happiest enjoying life's simple pleasures. Wandering around the backyard while you potter in the garden, following you from a distance just to be close, or heading out for a peaceful walk beside you on lead, taking everything in at her own gentle pace. Billie has a calm, easy-going nature and is relaxed around other Greyhounds as well as a pet Dachshund, making her a lovely companion both at home and out and about. Her perfect home could be with a single person, a young couple, or someone enjoying retirement who is looking for a faithful friend to share each day with. She would also be happy with a family that has older children (around 8–10 years and over) who understand that sometimes the kindest thing you can give a dog is patience. Billie is little girl with the biggest heart. All she needs is someone willing to let her settle in at her own pace, celebrate every little step forward, and show her that she is finally home. In return, she'll reward you with quiet companionship and unwavering loyalty.

NAME: Ozzie
TEXT: Meet Ozzie, Ozzie is a fun, larger-than-life Greyhound who loves being part of the action. He's full of energy, enjoys being around people, and isn't shy about showing his excitement. He's an affectionate boy with a playful nature and will thrive in a home that enjoys an active dog and is happy to continue building on his training. He is a playful dog who loves toys and is happiest when he has one to carry around. Ozzie can become quite excited during play and is enthusiastic when interacting with both people and his environment. He is affectionate and enjoys being with his people, although his excitement can sometimes lead to boisterous behaviour, so he will benefit from ongoing guidance to help him channel his energy appropriately. Ozzie will fit best with someone who enjoys a dog with plenty of personality and doesn't mind a bit of enthusiasm. He's a happy, playful boy who is ready to find a home that can give him the space, guidance and exercise he needs to really shine. Book in at Western Sydney

NAME: Fred
TEXT: *Hi I'm Fred, I have just gone to foster care in an apartment, updates to follow!* Fred is a loyal, intelligent boy looking for a calm home where he can truly thrive. ❤️ Fred is searching for an experienced and understanding owner. Once he builds trust, Fred forms strong bonds with his people and loves being included in daily life , especially if it involves attention, companionship, and a comfy place to relax nearby. While Fred can be social with medium to large dogs out and about, he would much prefer a home where he can soak up all the love and attention for himself as the only dog in the household. Fred can work up to being left alone for full-time hours with the right routine and settling period, making him a great companion for someone willing to give him time to adjust. Fred would be best suited to an adult-only home or one with older, dog-savvy children who understand how to respectfully interact with dogs and can help maintain a calm household environment. Meet Fred at Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Barbie
TEXT: Barbie has just finished up her foster care placement in Sydney CBD in an apartment. She has nailed stairs, toilet training, can be left alone & is a complete cuddle bug! Update from foster: "Barbie's been such a little love bug. She has been roaching absolutely everywhere, one of the quickest fosters we've had to get comfortable enough to sprawl out and relax, doing so in less than a week. She loves being close to her people and will happily follow you around the house throughout the day. Once she feels comfortable, she becomes incredibly affectionate, curling up beside you on the sofa, cuddling in close, and happily joining you for naps. Barbie is also a very curious girl. She wants to sniff everything, investigate everything, and always know what’s going on. She has a talent for accompanying you in task that doesn’t require a greyhound in the cutest possible way. She’s funny, outgoing, and full of personality. Whether she wants to go outside, have dinner, get some cuddles, or simply ask for attention, she'll happily let you know. I think Barbie would suit someone looking for a loving, affectionate companion with a personality who’ll make you laugh. She would likely thrive in a home where someone works from home, is around regularly, or is willing to continue building her confidence with being alone little by little. She's also doing very well with toilet training. She understands routines and timing well, and is generally very good at going outside when given regular opportunities." Meet Barbie at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a sweet, dog social boy with a sweet personality to match his handsome looks. His happy personality is hard not to fall in love with, and he would suit a home with respectful kids. He lights up every room he enters with his infectious energy and signature grin. Whether he’s heading out for a walk, playing with his favourite toys, or simply soaking up attention, Charlie approaches life with enthusiasm and charm. Charlie enjoys having company around him and would love a home where he can be part of the daily routine and included in family life. One of Charlie’s greatest joys is playtime, especially when squeaky toys are involved. With his good looks, playful spirit, and affectionate nature, he’s sure to make a wonderful addition to a lucky family. Meet Charlie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Matty
TEXT: Matty may have the distinguished looks of an older gentleman, but he still has plenty of life and love to share. He is a calm, gentle soul with lovely manners and a relaxed approach to the world. He walks politely on lead, is friendly with new people and enjoys quietly exploring his surroundings. Matty is comfortable with handling and has a soft, easy-going nature that makes him a pleasure to spend time with. He also enjoys toys, particularly anything with a good squeaker. Matty has shown gentle and appropriate behaviour around smaller dogs and has previously lived alongside a Staffy. He has also met a Cavoodle and has been social with other greyhounds. He may be able to share his home with a another dog following suitable introductions and a successful meet and greet. Matty could suit a range of home environments, provided his family can offer patient introductions, ongoing guidance and the right support as he settles into pet life. With his calm nature and kind personality, he has the potential to become a wonderful companion.

NAME: Cleo
TEXT: Cleo is a sweet, confident and playful girl who takes new experiences in her stride. She enjoys exploring unfamiliar environments and quickly looks to the people around her for attention and connection. She is highly engaged by toys, enjoys her food and is eager to participate, which should make her a fun and rewarding dog to continue training. Cleo is affectionate with people and regularly seeks out pats and interaction, making her a lovely potential companion for family life. Cleo has shown confidence around other dogs and particularly enjoys playful interactions with fellow greyhounds. She has also shown polite social skills around smaller dogs and may be able to share her home with one following a successful meet and greet, with appropriate introductions and ongoing management. With the right support and routine, Cleo could suit a range of home environments. She would thrive with a family who can offer her companionship, enrichment, playtime and continued guidance as she settles into pet life.

NAME: Pebbles
TEXT: Pebbles is a confident, playful greyhound who enjoys exploring her surroundings and being involved in whatever is happening around her. She loves playing fetch with toys and regularly checks back in with her handler, showing that she enjoys both independence and human connection. Pebbles may need a little encouragement when entering unfamiliar spaces, such as a crate or vehicle, but settles well once inside. She has previously lived around and socialised well with other greyhounds, although her play style can sometimes be enthusiastic and over the top. She may benefit from calm, well-matched canine companions and gradual introductions. Pebbles may even enjoy spending time with a smaller dog, pending a meet and greet first. Her playful nature means that any multi-dog home will need ongoing supervision and appropriate management as Pebbles settles into her new home. Pebbles would suit a home looking for a fun, confident and engaging companion who will enjoy playtime, enrichment and continuing to build her social skills.

NAME: Monnie
TEXT: Monnie is a loving, affectionate greyhound with a playful spirit and a heart of gold. She adores spending time with her people and is always happy to be part of the family, whether that's joining in a game, going for a walk, or relaxing at home together. One of Monnie's favourite things in the world is playing ball. She loves chasing, retrieving, and showing off her playful side, making her a wonderful companion for anyone looking for a dog who enjoys a bit of fun and interaction. Her enthusiasm for play is balanced by her sweet and gentle nature, making her a joy to have around. Monnie is very affectionate and thrives on human companionship. She loves pats, attention, and being close to her favourite people. Her friendly personality and loving temperament make it easy for her to form strong bonds with those around her. Adding to her many wonderful qualities, Monnie is toilet trained and has experience with household routines, helping her transition smoothly into a new home. With her combination of playful energy, affectionate nature, and good manners, Monnie is ready to become a cherished member of a lucky family. If you're looking for a greyhound who will happily play ball one minute and cuddle up beside you the next, Monnie could be your perfect match. 🐾💕

NAME: Tipsy
TEXT: Tipsy is a fun-loving, happy greyhound who approaches life with enthusiasm and a wagging tail. Full of personality, she loves making the most of every day, whether she's splashing around in the water, playing with her friends, or spending time with her people. One of Tipsy's favourite things is water! If there's a chance to paddle, splash, or cool off, she's first in line. Her playful nature shines through in everything she does, and she brings a sense of joy and adventure wherever she goes. Tipsy is very social and loves the company of other dogs. She enjoys playing, exploring, and simply hanging out with her canine friends, making her a great companion for a home with another friendly dog. Her easy-going and friendly nature also means she enjoys meeting new people and is always happy to make new friends. Despite her playful side, Tipsy also appreciates time to relax after a day of fun. With her sweet temperament and cheerful outlook, she's a wonderful combination of affectionate companion and playful adventurer. If you're looking for a friendly, happy greyhound who loves water, enjoys other dogs, and brings plenty of fun and laughter to everyday life, Tipsy could be the perfect addition to your family. 🐾💕💦

NAME: Sky
TEXT: If you're looking for a happy, people-loving companion, I could be the perfect match! I have a fun, bouncy personality and absolutely love spending time with my humans. Once I'm settled inside, I'm calm and relaxed, and I could comfortably adjust to a home where my family works full-time. I get along well with other dogs and really enjoy their company. In fact, having a confident canine friend helps me feel more secure and brings out my best. Because of this, I'd love a home with another friendly dog, or one where I can continue having positive dog interactions. I'm looking for a home with a secure yard where I can stretch my legs, play, and enjoy spending time outdoors. I'd be best suited to a family with children aged 10 years and over who can understand my bouncy nature and give me the love and companionship I'm looking for. If you're looking for a sweet, social dog with lots of love to give, I'd love to meet you!

NAME: Buster
TEXT: Buster is a handsome, friendly boy who has experience living indoors and understands the routines and comforts of home life. Having already enjoyed life as a pet, he is well placed to settle quickly into a new family environment. A gentle and affectionate boy, Buster is fantastic with children and enjoys being part of the family. He has a calm, easy-going nature and is happy spending time with his people, whether that's relaxing around the house, joining in family activities, or stretching out for a well-earned nap on a comfy bed. Buster would suit a home where he can continue to enjoy the comforts of indoor living and plenty of family interaction. However, he is not suitable for a home with small dogs, so any canine companions will need to be of a suitable size. With his loving personality, great manners, and wonderful nature around older children, Buster is ready to become a loyal and much-loved member of his forever family. 🐾💙

NAME: Sabrina
TEXT: Sabrina is a happy, friendly greyhound who loves being part of the action. With her cheerful personality and interactive nature, she enjoys spending time with her people and is always keen to be involved in family life. Having lived indoors, Sabrina is already familiar with the comforts and routines of a home. She has settled beautifully into pet life and appreciates all the things that make a house a home, from cosy beds to quality time with her family. Sabrina is good with both children and other dogs, making her a wonderful companion for a variety of households. She is social, affectionate, and loves making new friends, whether they have two legs or four. Her gentle and easy-going temperament helps her fit in well with those around her. This lovely girl has a bright, positive outlook on life and brings plenty of joy wherever she goes. If you're looking for a sweet, well-rounded greyhound who enjoys companionship, gets along well with kids and dogs, and is ready to become a treasured member of the family, Sabrina could be the perfect match. 🐾💖

NAME: Benno
TEXT: Benno is a relaxed, easy-going boy who has experience living in a home and spending time around children. Having already enjoyed the comforts and routines of family life, he has proven himself to be a well-mannered and adaptable companion. A fairly independent boy, Benno is happy to do his own thing and doesn't demand constant attention. He enjoys being part of the household but is equally content finding a comfortable spot to stretch out and watch the world go by. His calm, casual nature makes him an easy dog to have around. Benno is placid, taking most things in his stride. He is comfortable around children and appreciates a home where he can enjoy a balance of companionship and quiet time. While he may not be the centre of attention, he is a loyal and steady presence who enjoys being included in family life. If you're looking for a low-maintenance, laid-back greyhound who is already familiar with home living, Benno could be the perfect match. With his easy-going personality and gentle nature, he's ready to settle into his next forever home and enjoy all the comforts it has to offer. 🐾💙

NAME: Scarlet
TEXT: Scarlet is a beautiful, sweet-natured girl who has spent the past 12 months living as a pet while recovering from a leg injury. Thanks to plenty of care, rest, and love, she has made a full recovery and is now ready to find her forever home. A placid and easy-going girl, Scarlet has settled wonderfully into home life and knows exactly how to enjoy the comforts of being a family companion. Her favourite places are the sofa or a cosy bed, where she is more than happy to spend her days relaxing and watching the world go by. Scarlet has a gentle, affectionate personality and is a delight to have around the house. She enjoys the company of her people and has a calm presence that makes her an easy fit into a relaxed household. Having already experienced life in a home, she understands the routine and comforts that come with being a much-loved pet. With her sweet nature, excellent manners, and fully recovered health, Scarlet is ready to bring companionship, warmth, and plenty of couch cuddles to her next family. She is proof that sometimes the best days are spent stretched out on a soft bed, sharing quiet moments with the people she loves. 🐾❤️

NAME: Dreamy
TEXT: Dreamy is a gentle, shy greyhound with a heart full of sweetness. While she may take a little time to warm up to new people and unfamiliar situations, those lucky enough to earn her trust quickly discover a loving and loyal companion. With her soft eyes and quiet nature, Dreamy prefers calm surroundings where she can relax and observe the world at her own pace. She is wonderfully gentle, affectionate with those she knows, and happiest when curled up in a cosy bed or enjoying a peaceful stroll. Dreamy's sensitive and kind personality makes her a special friend. She may not be the first to seek attention, but her quiet nudges for pats and her content sighs when she's comfortable speak volumes. Once she feels safe, her playful side emerges, revealing a sweet and endearing greyhound who loves companionship and gentle affection. Elegant, thoughtful, and full of love, Dreamy is the perfect example of how the shyest dogs often have the biggest hearts. 🐾💕

NAME: Ruby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: I've just finished up my foster care! Foster Update: "Ruby is a warm, affectionate and goofy doggy with beautiful manners. She is quick to learn from and love lucky humans. In her foster care, she overcame her fears to confidently and easily go up and down steps and learnt to sleep quietly through the night. She quickly picked up commands like "no", "stop" and "go", and she walks beautifully on lead, even with people she's just met. She charms everyone she meets with her adorable little noises, curious nature and sweet personality. Ruby loves time with people, being active on walks and investigating her world. She adores playing 'fetch' with her favourite toys. Ruby is the kind of companion who will excitedly join you on a morning walk, make you smile with her goofy antics, then settle beside you while you relax at home. She has so much love to give and is ready to become someone's loyal best friend. Ruby's respectful manners and gentle nature would make her a great fit for a family, or anyone who is looking for a companion that enjoys running and playing alongside relaxing. In foster care, she was regularly left alone for up to 5 hours per day with no issues." ----------------- Ruby is a gentle, placid girl who is learning to be the best pet she can be in foster care. She fits perfectly into her new foster care home, conquering the staircases, showing off her perfect toilet training too! She’s very affectionate and enjoys being involved in whatever’s going on around her however she can be left alone successfully in her foster care home. She enjoys 3 walks a day and has shown great toilet training in foster care. She has also enjoyed being the GAP HQ office dog where she was perfectly behaved and charmed all the staff and visitors. She has continued this perfect behaviour in foster where she has never been destructive, or gotten into anything she shouldn't. She is a perfect office companion. She walks well on lead, has gone on bushwalks and street walks in foster, listens to cues & knows "no", too. Ruby is very food motivated and loves enrichment games and puzzle-style activities. She’s clever, confident, and enjoys figuring things out, especially if there’s food involved. With other dogs, Ruby prefers her own space and doesn’t tend to actively seek them out (but has paired nicely in the past). Older kids would be a great match for her affectionate side. Meet Ruby at Western Sydney!

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *I've just gone into a foster care home and I am available to adopt!* Foster Update: He's settling in beautifully and is an absolute sweetheart. He's incredibly calm, gentle and hardly ever barks. I've already done two short home-alone trials. He seems very comfortable around the house and spends most of his time resting, including beside me while I'm working. He's settling in so much faster than I expected, even played with one of his toys yesterday (!), and is proving to be a wonderful foster. ----------------- Rusty is a gentle soul with a quiet nature. He is settling in well in foster care. Once he settles into his home, Rusty becomes the ultimate companion. He loves being near his people and will happily follow you from room to room like your own loyal shadow. He has also been shown to settle well on his own. Rusty would thrive in a calm home with respectful children who can respect his gentle nature and give him the space he needs while settling in. He would also benefit from living with a calm medium large breed dog or another greyhound, as the company of a steady canine friend helps him feel more secure and confident. Behind his quiet exterior is a sweet, affectionate boy who simply wants to feel safe, loved, and included. For the right home, Rusty will become a devoted and loving companion who will be by your side every step of the way. Meet Rusty in Western Sydney.

NAME: Doc
TEXT: Doc is a calm and friendly young boy. He has an affectionate nature and loves a pat but does not like water and will avoid mud puddles, unlike his siblings. He likes to keep himself clean! Doc enjoys a play in the yard with his brother and two mini fox terriers. They lie down and rest together, even eating with the little dogs. He is also not fazed about the pet ferrets in cages in the yard and aviary birds. He walks well on the lead and loves to trot out with the grandkids 10, 12 and 17 years old in the park, plus a 2-year-old supervised in a pram. When not having a walk or play, Doc enjoys a rest in the yard or in the laundry on a cooler day. He would make a wonderful, loving pet for many households, including a family with older kids or with another dog. A walk a day and yard play is enough for this lad as he is not over-energetic. Doc is a gorgeous boy who will bring you much love and joy. 🩵🐾

NAME: Roo
TEXT: Roo is a calm, gentle, and wonderfully easy-going handsome blue boy, equally happy joining in the fun or quietly relaxing by your side. Whether he's chasing a ball around the backyard, proudly carrying a fluffy toy, or snoozing on his comfy bed indoors, Roo approaches life with a relaxed and happy attitude. A true family dog, Roo adores his people and would love a home where he can be part of the daily action. He's a big fan of car rides and also great on lead, enjoying both farm and neighbourhood strolls, taking the world in with his calm and confident nature. Roo gets along well with a variety of dogs, including Jack Russells, Dachshunds, Kelpies, and fellow Greyhounds. He's a social boy who enjoys canine company but is just as content soaking up attention from his humans. While Roo is wonderfully chilled for most of the day, he does have a playful side with his love for toys. His gentle nature makes him a fantastic companion for families with children aged 7+, or for anyone searching for a dog who is equal parts couch companion, backyard playmate, walking buddy, and professional cuddle enthusiast. Is Roo the one for you? ❤️🐾

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: Meet Poppy! Poppy has been enjoying retirement for the past 12 months and, after experiencing the comforts of home, she's decided that the indoor lifestyle is definitely for her! This happy, affectionate girl is looking for a family who will enjoy sharing life's simple pleasures with her. Whether it's a daily walk around the neighbourhood, a short zoomie session in the backyard, a casual stroll through Bunnings, a coffee run, or simply supervising errands, Poppy is always happy to be by your side. Poppy travels beautifully in the car and is a relaxed companion for outings and adventures. She gets along well with cats and both small and large dogs, although she would be most suited to a home with a medium to larger-sized canine companion, or she would be equally happy soaking up all the attention as an only dog. With her gentle nature and easy-going personality, Poppy would be a perfect companion for singles, couples or families with children aged 9 years and over. She's the type of girl who enjoys being part of the family without demanding constant entertainment. Could Poppy be your perfect match? 🐾💕

NAME: Betty
TEXT: Betty is a gorgeous young fawn girl who was not interested in racing and has been enjoying retired life to prepare for her next chapter as a family pet or companion. Betty is a very chilled, easy-going, friendly girl who is not fazed by much. She is great with cats, all dogs of any size, good with children 9+, gentle on lead and would enjoy life with a relaxed family or household. She enjoys a walk but isn't worried if it's not every day and is excellent in the car. She is a great one for new adventures! Betty is housetrained and an all-round loving, easy-maintenance girl who would be a perfect companion for any family or household. 🥰❤️ 🐶

NAME: Orli
TEXT: Orli is a sweet, quiet, and soft-natured girl who is looking for a loving home to call her own. Gentle and easy to be around, she has a calm personality that makes her a wonderful companion for family life. Orli is great with children aged 6 and over and she also gets along well with other dogs of all sizes, including little breeds like Jack Russells and Chihuahuas, plus the household cat, making her a lovely addition to a multi-pet household. This gentle girl enjoys the simple things in life – sleeping on her bed, going for calm walks, riding in the car, splashing around in her shell pool, and having a little play in the yard. Orli is not high energy; she would suit a couple or family where someone is around for part of the day or works from home. She doesn’t need daily walks, just pottering around is fine. With her gentle nature and easygoing personality, Orli will make a beautiful, loyal companion for a family with the time to settle her in and include her in daily life. 🐾 💘

NAME: Chives
TEXT: *I've just gone to foster care! Updates coming soon!* Sweet, happy, adaptable girl Chives is a friendly little lady ready to join your family! She is social, bubbly and friendly to all she meets. A house with a yard for zoomies, and a home who will include her in the daily goings on, eg walkies, naps indoors, and play time, would be great, as she loves to be a part of the action, but is also happy to watch the world go by. Shorter hours alone are best while she first settles in. We know this lovely lady will make a great pet! Meet Chives at Western Sydney.

NAME: Louie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Hi, I've just gone to foster care, check back for updates!* Louie is a gentle, low maintenance, laid back and quiet soul. If you're looking for a laid back senior greyhound, Louie might be perfect for you. Louie enjoys life in the slow lane and is looking for someone to spend quiet time with. Louie is a lovely greyhound who loves mingling with other dogs his size, settles well alone and would love a home with indoor outdoor access where he can independently alternate between exploring outside and resting on beds indoors. A solo pet home is best suited. He is suitable with older/respectful kids and dreams of a backyard/courtyard to snooze in. He would like a flat home without stairs, as he is still learning how to navigate staircases. Louie is a sweet gentleman and he hopes you come to meet him soon. Meet Louie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Pino
TEXT: Meet Pino! Pino is a fun-loving male Greyhound with a happy, playful personality. He loves being around people and is always ready to say hello with a wagging tail and relaxed body language. He really enjoys attention and can get quite excited when he's praised, making him a cheerful and engaging companion. Pino enjoys exploring his surroundings and is curious about what's going on around him. He also has a playful side and loves chasing toys, showing he enjoys having a bit of fun. When meeting other dogs, Pino can get a little bouncy and excited at first but can settle quickly. He could happily live with a medium to large dog and may also be able to live with a suitable small dog after slow, careful introductions. Meet at Western Sydney.

NAME: Milo
TEXT: Meet Milo, Milo is a happy, confident male Greyhound who loves being around people. He has a fun, bouncy personality and is always keen to say hello, happily leaning in for pats and attention. Even though he gets excited, he is able to settle himself and relax once he's had a chance to greet everyone. On walks, Milo is a strong boy and can pull on the lead, especially when he's excited. He will benefit from continued lead training to help him learn to walk more politely, but once he settled, he was much easier to handle. When meeting another dog, Milo was relaxed and friendly. He got a little overexcited during the first greeting and wasn't very aware of his size, but he settled quickly and was happy to move on. He showed more interest in people than the other dog. Milo is a friendly, affectionate Greyhound with a big personality and lots of love to give. He will suit a home that enjoys an active, social dog and is happy to continue helping him with his lead manners. Book a meeting with Milo at Western Sydney.

NAME: Lilly
TEXT: Meet Lilly, Lilly is a sweet female Greyhound with a gentle nature. She really enjoys being around people, especially women, and was happy to come over for a sniff, stay close, and spend time with her handler. She likes human company and has a calm, affectionate personality. Lilly would be well suited to a home with a medium to large dog that can help her continue to grow in confidence. She can be a little shy at times, so a patient home that allows her to settle in at her own pace will help her thrive. Overall, Lilly is a gentle, kind-hearted Greyhound who forms lovely connections with people she trusts. With a calm, understanding home, she has all the makings of a devoted and affectionate companion. Book in at Western Sydney.

NAME: Taz
TEXT: Meet Taz, Taz is a handsome male Greyhound with a gentle, easygoing nature. He is a friendly boy who enjoys being around people, approaching with soft, relaxed body language and happily leaning in for affection. He has a calm, affectionate personality and is lovely to spend time with. Taz showed friendly social skills around another Greyhounds, greeting politely before easily moving on with light guidance. He would be well suited to living with a medium to large dog and may also be able to live with a small dog following slow, thoughtful introductions. Out on walks, Taz has lovely lead manners and walks nicely alongside his handler. Overall, he is a sweet, gentle Greyhound with a kind nature who enjoys people, takes new experiences in his stride, and is ready to become a wonderful companion. Meet Taz at Western Sydney.

NAME: Maui
TEXT: Maui is a super confident, playful, active boy who was born on Christmas Day! He is a couch potato, who loves spending time with other dogs. He suits either a house with a yard, or townhouse with outside access and tall/colorbond fencing. His best suited home has canine or human company, due to being in a multi-dog household with company in his foster home. Maui is a gorgeous confident boy who takes everything in his stride, including car travel, walking nicely on lead and being friendly to all humans and dogs he meets. He has lived in a foster care home and has learnt a lot of the basics of pet life making him a wonderful fit for a family with respectful kids or a fun, active life. Meet Maui at Western Sydney.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Meet Lucy, Lucy is a confident, friendly Greyhound with a happy, easy-going nature. She enjoys being with people and is comfortable meeting new faces, responding well to gentle handling and happily checking in with her handler. She walks beautifully on lead and has a lovely balance of curiosity and calm, taking in her surroundings with a relaxed, wagging tail and soft expression. Lucy has a playful side that shines through when she's engaged with her people. She enjoys interactive games, happily chases toys, and is always ready for a burst of joyful zoomies. Lucy has shown polite manners around other dogs and may be able to live with another medium or large dog. She has also displayed calm, respectful interactions with small dogs and could potentially share a home with a suitable small-breed companion, provided introductions are slow and carefully managed. She may also be suited to a home with children where interactions are supervised and everyone respects her need for rest and personal space. Make a booking at Western Sydney.

NAME: Wave
TEXT: Meet Wave, Wave is a gentle, affectionate Greyhound who loves spending time with people and thrives on kind attention. She is playful, enjoys learning, and responds beautifully to treats and positive reinforcement. She has a sweet nature, comes when called, and is happiest when sharing quiet moments with her people as well as having opportunities for fun and enrichment. Wave has shown lovely social skills with calm, respectful small dogs and may be able to live with a small-breed canine companion if they are a suitable match and introductions are gradual and carefully managed. She would suit a home that is happy to give new friendships time to develop at a comfortable pace. She may also be suitable for a home with children where interactions are appropriately supervised and everyone understands how to give her space when needed. With her affectionate personality, gentle nature, and willingness to connect with people, Wave has all the makings of a wonderful companion for a family or individual looking for a loving Greyhound to welcome into their home. Meet Wave at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Meet Rocky, Rocky is a lovely male Greyhound with a gentle nature and an easy-going personality. He enjoys exploring his surroundings at his own pace and is happy to take in all the sights and smells during his walks. He has a calm approach on lead, making him an enjoyable companion for daily outings. Rocky would thrive in a home with a secure yard where he has room to stretch his legs and enjoy some outdoor time. He would suit a family with older children who understand how to respectfully interact with larger dogs. He has the potential to live with another Greyhound/medium to large dog, provided introductions are slow, positive, and carefully supervised to help everyone settle in comfortably. If you're looking for a relaxed, handsome Greyhound who enjoys life's simple pleasures and will make a wonderful companion, Rocky is ready to find his forever home. Book a meeting at Western Sydney.

NAME: Vaughn
TEXT: Meet Vaughn, Vaughn is a handsome male Greyhound with a big personality! He is a confident, happy boy who enjoys getting out and about, taking in the world around him and sharing his enthusiasm with everyone he meets. His cheerful nature and playful energy make him a fun companion for someone who enjoys an active dog with plenty of character. Vaughn loves being involved in whatever is happening and is always keen to head out for a walk or spend time with his people. He can be very excited when meeting new people or dogs and wears his heart on his sleeve, but with calm guidance he settles in well and enjoys continuing on his way. He is a clever boy who responds well to positive encouragement and enjoys working with his handler. He would thrive in a home with a secure yard where he has space to stretch his legs and enjoy the outdoors. Vaughn is best suited to an owner who is comfortable with larger, stronger dogs and is happy to continue building his leash manners through positive, consistent training. Meet at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jess
TEXT: Jess is a sweet and affectionate girl with a shy side. A family without children is best suited to her friendly but sensitive temperament. She would be best suited to a quieter home environment where she can feel secure. She would also benefit from being the only animal in the home, allowing her to fully relax, build confidence, and focus her affectionate nature on her human companions. Some hours alone are suitable with a yard/courtyard to spend time in. She has shown good toilet training basics. Experienced greyhound owners are recommended to apply. With patience, understanding, and the companionship she clearly enjoys, Jess has all the qualities needed to become a devoted and affectionate family member. Meet Jess at Western Sydney.

NAME: Stacey
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Stacey 🐾 Sweet Stacey is a beautiful black greyhound with a gentle soul and a quiet nature. This lovely girl is looking for a patient and understanding home where she can take her time discovering the joys of life as a much-loved pet. With kindness, consistency, and a little encouragement, Stacey has the opportunity to blossom into a wonderful companion. Stacey is a thoughtful girl who likes to take in her surroundings and understand the world around her before joining in. She may be a little reserved when meeting new people and experiencing new places, but beneath her cautious first impression is a soft-hearted dog who is waiting for someone special to share a life full of love. She enjoys gentle interactions and will benefit from a calm environment where she can explore at her own pace. A predictable routine, quiet encouragement, and plenty of positive experiences will help Stacey grow in confidence. Stacey travels well in the car and is comfortable with her everyday routines. She is good on lead and enjoys quiet walks where she can explore at her own pace. She would appreciate a family who understands that confidence grows through patience and allows her to take each new experience one step at a time. When it comes to other dogs, Stacey prefers gentle introductions. A calm, respectful canine companion may be a lovely support for her, especially one who understands a quieter personality and can help show her the ropes of home life. Perfect Home for Stacey Stacey would suit a calm and caring adopter or foster carer situation with people who enjoy helping a sweet dog find confidence. She would thrive with a patient family who can offer her time, reassurance, and a gentle routine while she settles in. A quieter household where she can relax, learn, and build a strong bond would be ideal. Watching Stacey’s confidence grow and seeing her true personality emerge will be a very special journey for the person who gives her that chance. Stacey is waiting for someone with a kind heart who will give her the time and support she needs to shine. With love, patience, and a safe place to call home, this beautiful girl has so much potential to become a treasured companion.

NAME: Joy
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Joy 🐾 Beautiful Joy is a sweet young greyhound with a gentle heart and a quiet charm that is waiting to shine. This lovely black girl is a little on the thoughtful side and takes her time getting comfortable with new experiences, but with patience, kindness, and a loving home, Joy has every chance to blossom into a wonderful companion. Joy is the type of dog who will appreciate a calm introduction to her new life. She enjoys having the time to observe her surroundings, build trust, and discover that home life is full of safe, happy moments. As her confidence grows, her gentle personality will continue to emerge, and her family will have the special joy of watching her become more relaxed, comfortable, watch her big smile grow and her loving tail wags. She has a soft and sensitive nature and enjoys the reassurance of a steady routine. Joy travels well in the car and is learning to enjoy the little adventures that come with being a much-loved pet. She is comfortable walking on lead and will benefit from continued positive experiences that help her feel secure and confident. Joy also takes comfort from other dogs and enjoys having friendly canine company. A calm, respectful companion could help her feel at ease as she learns about her new world. She has shown lovely manners around smaller dogs and is happy to share her space with gentle friends. Perfect Home for Joy Joy would suit a loving home with people who understand that some of the most rewarding friendships take a little time to grow. A quieter household, a predictable routine, and plenty of gentle encouragement would help Joy settle in beautifully. She would thrive with an adopter or a foster carer who are happy to give her the space and time she needs while celebrating each little step forward. A patient family with or without another friendly dog could be a wonderful match for this sweet girl. Joy is a beautiful reminder that the quiet ones often form the most special bonds. With a little time, love, and understanding, she could become a treasured companion and a much-loved member of the family.

NAME: Ari
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Ari 🐾 If you're looking for a gentle giant with a heart full of love, Ari is ready to meet you! This handsome black greyhound is a friendly, confident boy who enjoys exploring the world before happily settling in for some well-earned pats. With his affectionate nature and soft, wagging tail, Ari has all the makings of a loyal best friend. Ari loves spending time with people and isn't shy about asking for affection. He's a classic greyhound "leaner," happily pressing in for cuddles and enjoying pats all over. His warm, easy-going personality makes him a joy to be around, and he's equally happy simply sharing your company as you go about your day. Curious and confident, Ari enjoys getting out to sniff, explore, and discover new places. He travels beautifully in the car, happily hopping in and relaxing for the journey, making him a wonderful companion for road trips or everyday outings. On walks, Ari is enthusiastic and enjoys taking in all the sights and smells, so he'll appreciate a family who enjoys regular adventures together and can continue helping him polish his lead manners. Ari has lovely social manners with other greyhounds, greeting them politely before happily doing his own thing. He enjoys the company of dogs his own size and has a relaxed, friendly approach to canine companions. Perfect Home for Ari Ari would thrive in a home with people who enjoy an active companion and can continue building on his lead skills while giving him plenty of opportunities to explore. He would be happiest in a home without small pets, where he can relax and shine as the wonderful companion he is. With love, routine, and plenty of affection, Ari will reward his family with unwavering loyalty and lots of cuddles. Ari is ready to find a family who'll appreciate his loving heart, adventurous spirit, and gentle companionship. If you're looking for a loyal friend to share life's everyday moments, Ari would love to meet you.

NAME: Bluebell
TEXT: 🐾 Meet... Bluebell 🐾 If you're looking for a gentle soul with a heart full of love, Bluebell could be your perfect match. This beautiful blue girl is calm, affectionate, and wonderfully easy-going, with a sweet nature that makes everyone she meets feel like an instant friend. Whether she's enjoying a leisurely stroll, soaking up pats, or simply relaxing by your side, Bluebell is happiest just being part of the moment. Bluebell is a lovely companion who adores human attention. She happily comes over when called for a cuddle, leans in for pats, and enjoys spending time close to her people. She has a quiet confidence about her and takes life's adventures in her stride, making her a delight to have around every day. Out and about, Bluebell is a pleasure to walk. She enjoys exploring at a relaxed pace, happily cruising along while checking back in with her person. Her calm, chilled outlook makes walks feel enjoyable and easy, whether you're wandering through the neighbourhood or taking in a peaceful park. Bluebell is also wonderfully social. She is comfortable spending time alongside other greyhounds and has shown a lovely, relaxed attitude around small dogs too, happily going about her day without fuss. Her friendly, easy-going personality shines through in every interaction. Bluebell has a naturally gentle presence and carries herself with quiet grace. 🏡 Bluebell's Perfect Home Bluebell would suit a wide range of homes, from a cosy apartment to a house with a yard, as long as she has loving people to share her days with. Her calm nature makes her an excellent companion for those who enjoy a relaxed lifestyle, while her confidence means she'll happily join you on daily outings and gentle adventures. She'd fit beautifully into a home looking for a loyal, affectionate friend who enjoys both quiet moments and quality time together. Bluebell is ready to fill her new home with love, gentle companionship, and plenty of happy tail wags. If you're searching for a sweet, easy-going best friend, Bluebell can't wait to meet you.

NAME: Ash
TEXT: Meet Ash. Ash is a beautiful blue girl with a happy- go-lucky personality that's guaranteed to brighten your day. She loves being part of the action and is happiest when she's included in whatever her humans are up to. Give Ash a secure backyard and you'll see her true colours shine. She adores the freedom to run around with her tail wagging from pure excitement. Once she has had her fun, she's more than happy to sit back a relax alone or with her humans. She also loves heading out for walks, where she enjoys exploring the world by your side. Playful, affectionate and eager to interact, Ash loves spending time with her people. She comes when her name is called and is always keen to engage, whether it's for a game, a cuddle, or simply to see what you're doing. If you're looking for a fun loving, enthusiastic companion who will happily join in on life adventures and keep a smile on your face, Ash could be the perfect addition to your family

NAME: Myrtle
TEXT: Myrtle is a gentle girl who is great company. She is playful, confident and calm. She comes when called upon in large areas and would make a great companion to anyone.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is a very pretty and pleasant girl, she is extremely affectionate and inquisitive, easy to walk or spend time with in the yard. Is very social and easy around other hounds.

NAME: Little Larry
TEXT: *Hi, I have just gone into a foster home, check back for updates!* At just 26 kgs little Larry is just simply adorable! He is a professional nap enthusiast, soft bed connoisseur, and all-round good boy. 💤 Larry is the kind of dog who believes life is best enjoyed comfy, cozy, and preferably horizontal. Whether it’s a plush dog bed, a sunny patch on the carpet, or your couch if you’re feeling generous, Larry is happiest curled up enjoying one of his many daily snoozes. Don’t let his love of naps fool you though — Larry is also a social sweetheart who enjoys the company of other dogs, especially calm medium to large canine friends. He’s happy to make dog buddies, but he’s equally content flying solo and soaking up all the attention himself. Larry would suit an apartment lifestyle, provided there’s ground-floor living or lift access to make life easy and comfortable for him. He’s a calm companion who doesn’t need constant chaos or adventure, just a loving home, soft bedding, and humans who appreciate the finer things in life… like afternoon naps. Larry is also comfortable being left alone and can gradually work up to full-time hours with the right routine in place, making him a great option for people with busy schedules. Due to his gentle and relaxed nature, Larry would be best suited to a home with children aged 10 years and over. If you’re looking for a loyal couch buddy, champion sleeper, and expert snuggler, Larry may just be your perfect match. ❤️ Meet Larry at Western Sydney

NAME: Lots
TEXT: Hi, I'm Lots! And yes, I have lots of love to give! I have spent time around a 4 year old, and am described as a big lovable puppy. I am bouncy, goofy and have LOTS of charm. I've been known to be an energetic silly sausage! I travel well, walk nicely on the lead, love my play time and would love a backyard to get my energy out during the day. After play time I will have lots of snoozing after I've tuckered myself out. A home without another dog is best as I am simply a goofy puppy at heart. I guarantee lots of amazing memories if you adopt me, especially if you're a family with children and with a backyard, as I aim to please and definitely think of myself as a social butterfly. Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Bluey
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Bluey 🐾 If sunshine could be wrapped up into a greyhound, it would be Bluey! This beautiful white and blue girl is cheerful, affectionate, and wonderfully easy-going. With her gentle nature, love of people, and adaptable personality, Bluey is the kind of companion who makes every day feel a little brighter. Bluey approaches life with quiet confidence and a curious spirit. She enjoys exploring new places with a happy sniff around before settling into whatever adventure comes next. Whether she's relaxing at home, heading out for a stroll, or enjoying a day by the water, Bluey takes it all in her stride with her calm and friendly outlook. People are high on Bluey's list of favourite things! She's always happy to wander over for a cuddle and enjoys being patted all over before contentedly heading off to do a little exploring of her own. She has a lovely balance of affection and independence, making her an easy companion to live with. One of Bluey's biggest loves is the beach—and if there's water nearby, you'll likely find her splashing happily! She enjoys getting out and about, and her relaxed nature makes outings together a pleasure. She travels beautifully in the car, quietly settling down for the ride, and she's a dream to walk on lead, happily taking in the world without fuss. Bluey has wonderful social manners with other dogs. She enjoys saying hello politely before happily doing her own thing, and she's known to enjoy playful outings with dogs of all shapes and sizes at the beach. Her gentle, respectful nature makes her an easy friend to have around. If there's one thing Bluey gets especially excited about, it's dinner time! She's a true foodie who knows when mealtime is approaching and isn't shy about sharing her enthusiasm. Despite her love of snacks, she's wonderfully relaxed and comfortable around her food. Perfect Home for Bluey Bluey's adaptable personality means she'll fit beautifully into many different homes. Whether you're looking for a walking companion, a beach buddy, or a friendly best friend to relax with at home, she'll happily settle into family life. Her friendly, easy-going nature makes her a lovely choice for first-time greyhound owners or anyone looking for a loyal and loving companion. Bluey is ready for a lifetime of love, adventures, and cosy naps. If you're searching for a sweet, adaptable girl with a heart as big as her smile, Bluey would love to become part of your family.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Cindy 🐾 Looking for a happy-go-lucky best friend with a heart full of love? Meet Cindy! This gorgeous black greyhound is full of cheerful confidence, gentle affection, and a wonderfully easy-going nature. With her happy whole-body wiggles and bright enthusiasm for life, Cindy has a special way of bringing smiles wherever she goes. Cindy is the kind of girl who embraces each day with curiosity and joy. She loves heading out to explore, happily sniffing around and taking in all the exciting sights and smells before settling into a relaxed rhythm. Whether she's bounding around the yard or simply enjoying some quiet time nearby, Cindy is wonderfully balanced—always happy to join in but equally content doing her own thing. People are one of Cindy's favourite things! She's quick to wander over for a friendly pat and enjoys spending time with her humans, soaking up affection with her warm and loving personality. At the same time, she's independent enough to happily entertain herself, making her an easy companion to have around the home. Cindy travels beautifully in the car and settles in with ease, making adventures together a breeze. On walks, she can be a little enthusiastic at times, but she's very manageable on lead and enjoys getting out to explore the world alongside her people. She has lovely social manners with other dogs and enjoys polite introductions. Cindy happily walks alongside smaller dogs and isn't fazed if they become a little vocal, showing just how calm and friendly she can be. She's also comfortable around other greyhounds, making her a wonderful companion for homes with a respectful canine friend. Perfect Home for Cindy Cindy's adaptable nature means she'll fit into many different lifestyles. Whether you're looking for a walking buddy, a relaxed companion around the house, or a loyal friend to share everyday adventures, Cindy is ready to settle in and become part of the family. She'd be equally happy as the centre of attention or sharing her home with another friendly dog. Cindy is ready to fill her forever home with wagging tails, gentle cuddles, and endless love. If you're looking for a sweet, cheerful companion who's always happy to be by your side, Cindy would love to meet you.

NAME: Footsy
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Footsy 🐾 If you're searching for a sweet soul with a playful sparkle, Footsy might just steal your heart. This beautiful blue girl is a gentle, thoughtful sweetheart who likes to take in the world at her own pace before letting her fun-loving personality shine. Once she feels at home, you'll discover a happy, affectionate companion with the cutest zoomies and an endearing charm that's impossible not to love. Footsy enjoys life's simple pleasures, whether it's exploring the backyard, stretching her legs for a playful run, or cooling off by standing in her water bucket—a quirky little habit that's guaranteed to make you smile! After a burst of fun, she's more than happy to relax by your side with her calm, easy-going nature. When meeting new people, Footsy can be a little reserved at first, but with a little kindness and patience, her affectionate side blossoms beautifully. Footsy is comfortable travelling in the car and settles beautifully, making her a lovely companion for outings. She's gentle on lead and enjoys exploring her surroundings, becoming more confident as she gets to know new places. She gets along well with other friendly, respectful dogs and is happy to share her space with canine companions who appreciate a gentle introduction. Footsy is interested in meeting smaller dogs and approaches them with curiosity and a polite, thoughtful nature. Perfect Home for Footsy Footsy would flourish in a calm, loving home where she can settle in at her own pace and continue growing in confidence. She'd enjoy a quieter lifestyle with people who appreciate the joy of watching a gentle dog come out of her shell. A friendly canine companion could be a lovely match, or she'd be equally happy soaking up all the love as your special girl. Footsy is ready to find a family who'll treasure her gentle heart and celebrate every little moment as she continues to bloom. If you're looking for a loyal, loving companion with a playful streak and plenty of sweetness to share, Footsy can't wait to meet you.

NAME: Claire
TEXT: Claire is a sweet, placid, and affectionate girl who loves spending time with her people. She has met some small dogs and was polite and friendly in her interactions. Claire has also been introduced to two cats and, surprisingly, was a bit of a scaredy-cat herself! Rather than showing too much interest, she was cautious and respectful around them. With the right introductions and a suitable home environment, Claire may be able to live successfully with a confident, cat-savvy feline companion. She would thrive in a loving home where she can continue to build her confidence and enjoy plenty of affection. ❤️🐾

NAME: Carrie
TEXT: Carrie is a sweet, shy girl who has such a cute friendly side! Carrie likes the simple things, being outdoors, the sunshine, playing with a ball or sunbaking. She also loves water. Carrie is a gentle, middle-aged girl with a calm, independent nature. She walks beautifully on lead and is generally easygoing, though she can be shy. She enjoys quietly exploring her surroundings and is happy doing her own thing, making her a great match for someone looking for a laid back, low maintenance type pet. Carrie is polite around other dogs. Meet Carrie at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jasper (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Jasper has just finished up his successful foster care placement in a full-time apartment home! Jasper is your quintessential low maintenance kinda guy, playful, but shy, and can take time to warm up. An owner who enjoys helping a shy greyhound come out of their shell is the best fit for Jasper. He likes slow adventures, where he can take things in at his own pace. He likes his quiet time and down time, and enjoys settling down when things are chill, and will go to his crate when he wants some time out. A house with a yard, in a quiet part of town, with a low dog population when out and about would suit Jasper perfectly as he can become overwhelmed with too much happening out and about. He loves all things food and puzzle enrichment, so a home that will provide ongoing mental stimulation in lieu of walkies and adventures will be Jaspers best match. Jasper is polite with other dogs his size at the adoption centre, and could live with one, however not a requirement. Meet Jasper at Western Sydney.

NAME: Dave
TEXT: Dave is a lovely boy with a gentle nature and a heart full of love. While he can be a little shy when meeting new people or finding himself in unfamiliar situations, all he really needs is a bit of time and reassurance to feel comfortable. Once Dave starts to trust you, his affectionate personality truly shines. He becomes a devoted companion who loves spending time with his people, soaking up attention and enjoying all the comforts of home. His sweet and loving nature makes every moment with him rewarding, and the bond you build with him is something truly special. Dave is looking for a patient home that will allow him to settle in at his own pace and help him grow in confidence. In return, he will reward you with unwavering loyalty, gentle affection, and plenty of love. If you're looking for a kind-hearted boy who may be a little reserved at first but has so much love to give, Dave could be the perfect addition to your family. ❤️🐕

NAME: Ralph
TEXT: Ralph is a calm and confident Greyhound with a wonderful nature and plenty of charm. He carries himself with quiet assurance and takes life's adventures in his stride, making him a relaxed and easygoing companion. With his friendly personality and gentle manners, Ralph has a way of winning hearts wherever he goes. He's happy to spend time with his people, whether that's joining you for a leisurely walk, relaxing at home, or simply enjoying your company. His steady temperament and adaptable nature make him a pleasure to have around. Ralph's charming character shines through in everything he does. He combines confidence with kindness, creating the perfect balance of independence and affection. If you're looking for a loyal companion with a calm presence and a whole lot of personality, Ralph could be the perfect match. Handsome, lovable, and full of charm, Ralph is ready to bring companionship and happiness to his forever home. ❤️🐕

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Grace is a beautiful Greyhound with a gentle soul and a sweet nature. She can be very shy when meeting new people and experiencing unfamiliar situations, but beneath her reserved exterior is a loving girl just waiting to blossom. Grace is looking for a patient and understanding home where she can settle in at her own pace. She will thrive with someone who can give her the time, reassurance, and gentle guidance she needs to build confidence and feel safe. As she learns to trust, her true personality begins to shine, revealing a loyal and affectionate companion who loves being close to her people. With kindness, consistency, and plenty of encouragement, Grace will continue to come out of her shell and grow into the wonderful dog she is meant to be. For the right person, watching Grace gain confidence and discover the world around her will be an incredibly rewarding journey. If you're looking for a sweet, sensitive girl who just needs a little extra patience and love, Grace could be the perfect addition to your family. ❤️🐕

NAME: Rory
TEXT: Meet Rory 🐾 Rory is a handsome boy with a big heart. Fun, playful, and incredibly sweet, Rory brings joy wherever he goes. He loves spending his days zooming around the yard, playing with his favourite toys, and making new friends both human and canine. Despite his playful nature, Rory has a gentle and affectionate side. He enjoys cuddles, leans in for pats, and is always happy to be close to the people he loves. His friendly personality and easy going temperament make him a wonderful companion for families, couples, or anyone looking for a loyal best friend. Whether he's showing off his playful antics, relaxing on a comfy bed, or greeting everyone with a wagging tail, Rory's charming nature makes him impossible not to love. He is the perfect combination of fun-loving energy and sweet companionship, bringing smiles and happiness to every day.

NAME: Zena
TEXT: *Zena has just finished up in her foster care home & and is available to adopt! She had lived in foster with a Borzoi in an apartment - update below!* "She is really improving and becoming less nervous as the days go by. We have started leaving her by herself a bit more and she can now manage 2-3 hours without problems. We are also exposing her to new situations regularly and she is much calmer than she used to be. I think she is ready for a family of her own, just not a very noisy one! Zena LOVES going for walks/outings and wants to join in every time someone leaves the house. She travels well in the car and walks perfectly on the lead. She ignores small dogs when walking. We have brought her along to various football matches without problem, but she needs a little time to observe from a distance before going closer. She gets on well with our dog and we haven't seen any problematic behaviour around other dogs. Zena is very playful and has started to pick up toys, although she doesn't quite know what to do with them once she's picked them up. She has managed to play tug-of-war with our dog a couple of times and they generally play well together. Overall, Zena is a very affectionate little dog (once she knows and trusts you) that would make a lovely pet, but perhaps in a quieter household." ----------- Zena is a happy, friendly girl, who would suit a nurturing, calm household to really thrive into the cheeky, confident girl we've seen here at the adoption centre! She can take a little time to adapt and feel comfortable in new environments and requires understanding pawrents willing to take new things slow. A home without kids would support her confidence the best. Zena socialises well with other dogs around her size and she doesn't mind if it's dog or human, but she would love some company during the day. Zena's favourite activity is settling down in a cozy area while enjoying a Kong or a food puzzle, since treats are her favourite thing! She is phenomenal with her training here at GAP HQ - she has learned how to navigate stairs, responds to her name, knows "down", "touch" a hand target, "shake" and even "sit" which is a tricky one for most greyhounds! What a clever girl! Zena is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre so let us know if you are interested in taking her home!

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Meet Willow 🐾 Willow is a beautiful, friendly greyhound with a heart full of love and a personality that will keep you smiling every day. Since spending time in a home environment, Willow has settled in wonderfully alongside other household greyhounds and has shown just how easily she can adapt to family life. She has also been socialised with small dogs and enjoys their company when introduced appropriately. Willow is convinced she's a lap dog and will happily seek out cuddles and affection whenever she gets the chance. She's an incredibly people-oriented girl who loves being involved in whatever her humans are doing. In fact, she's quite the office assistant and enjoys helping with paperwork, making her the perfect work-from-home companion and loyal desk buddy! This lovely girl is crate trained and sees her crate as a safe and comfortable place to relax. She also loves car rides and is always ready to jump in for an adventure. Willow has met a cat and showed appropriate interest. She could suit a home with a cat, provided the cat is confident and experienced with dogs, and that slow, careful introductions are followed to ensure everyone feels comfortable and safe. With her sweet nature, affectionate personality, and easy-going attitude, Willow is ready to find a family who will cherish her as much as she will cherish them. If you're looking for a loving companion who enjoys cuddles, companionship, and being part of daily life, Willow could be the perfect match. ❤️ Willow is ready to trade her kennel for a couch and become someone's much-loved best friend. 🐾

NAME: Keithy
TEXT: Keithy is very social and sweet. He comes when called, loves to play and have a run around. Keithy gets along well with other dogs, has native birds and other animals around the property that he is not bothered by.

NAME: Helena
TEXT: Meet Helena 💖 Helena is a gentle, calm girl who is ready to find a loving home of her own. Sweet-natured and affectionate, she loves nothing more than receiving pats, scratches, cuddles, and the occasional kiss from her favourite people. Helena is very friendly and easy-going, getting along well with other greyhounds and small dogs alike. She's a pleasure to walk, is good on lead, and enjoys relaxed strolls around the neighbourhood. She has also been around children and takes it all in her stride with her calm, gentle nature. Having spent time in a backyard environment, Helena has adapted well to pet life and is happiest simply being part of the family. She's not looking for anything fancy, just a comfy bed, plenty of love, and a home where she can enjoy being a cherished companion. 🐾

NAME: Strike
TEXT: Meet Strike, a very friendly, easy-going boy with a lovely nature and a happy outlook on life. He enjoys spending time with people and is always ready for a pat, some attention, and a bit of fun. How handsome he is with his tuxedo markings and white paws 🐾🐾🤍🖤 Strike has spent time playing in the backyard with children aged 9 and 12, and he loves joining in the fun. He'll happily have a burst of energy, enjoy a game or a zoom around the yard, and then settle down for a well-earned rest. He's the perfect mix of playful and relaxed, and gets along with small and big dogs alike. When he's not playing, Strike is content to potter around beside you, keeping you company as you go about your day. His calm, affectionate personality makes him an easy dog to have around and a wonderful companion to brighten your day.

NAME: Em-Jay
TEXT: Meet Em-Jay 🩵 a happy, smoochy boy with a gentle nature and a love for ear scratches and pats. He enjoys a good run around the backyard, but he’s mostly a quiet, easygoing companion who’s happiest relaxing nearby, playing in his shell pool, or simply enjoying the day with his people. Em-Jay loves his street walks and takes in the world at his own pace. He can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once he gets to know you, he’s very happy to soak up affection and attention. He enjoys inside time, happily relaxing on his bed, as you can see! Having lived a quiet life in a rural town, Em-Jay would suit a calm home where he can enjoy companionship, downtime, and being part of everyday life - whether that’s gardening, pottering around the yard, or relaxing at home together. He’s happy as an only dog or could live with a calm female dog, such as a Whippet. With his sweet nature, loving smooches, and gentle companionship, Em-Jay is ready to find a home where he can truly belong.

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Meet Willow – Your Happy, Playful Companion! 💗 Willow, affectionately known as "Will," is a sweet, loving, and happy girl who is the perfect mix of playful and affectionate. She loves spending time with her people, especially when there's a game to play! Her favourite toy is her Kong, and she happily joins her two teenage human friends (aged 14 and 16) for afternoon exercise, making her an excellent companion for an active family. She's a pleasure to walk, is good on the lead, and responds well to her name. Willow is also a confident, curious girl around the home. She's comfortable with everyday household sounds and enjoys exploring her surroundings. One of Willow's greatest strengths is her loving, friendly nature. She enjoys meeting new people and gets along well with both male and female greyhounds. She has shown respectful manners when meeting small dogs and also travels well in the car, making outings and adventures easy. Willow would thrive in a family home with older children who can enjoy her playful side, or with a couple or individual who can give her the time and companionship she thrives on. All she asks for is love, a comfy bed, daily walks and someone to share life's adventures with. ❤️🐾

NAME: Alma
TEXT: Alma may be small for a Greyhound at just 24kg, but she has a big heart and an even bigger capacity for love. This sweet and gentle girl has a calm, quiet nature that makes her a wonderful companion to have around the home. She is content to relax by your side and enjoys simply being part of the family. Alma is a friendly and social girl who enjoys spending time with people. She has shown herself to be affectionate and loving, happily accepting attention and companionship from those around her. She has also been polite and well-mannered with children, making her a lovely option for families with calm and respectful kids. While Alma is happy to enjoy the comforts of indoor life, she would love having a yard where she can stretch her legs, explore and soak up the sunshine. It doesn't need to be a large space—even a small yard would make this little lady very happy. If you're looking for a gentle, easy-going Greyhound with a sweet personality and plenty of affection to share, Alma could be the perfect addition to your family. 🩷🐾

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Our Handsome Goofball! Looking for a best friend who will make you smile every day? This gorgeous black and white Greyhound might just be your perfect match. With his striking good looks, happy personality and lovable quirky nature, he's impossible not to adore. He’s a friendly and affectionate boy who loves being around people and is always ready for a cuddle, a pat, or simply to share your company. This charming gentleman has a wonderfully goofy side and is guaranteed to keep you entertained with his funny antics and endearing personality. He approaches life with enthusiasm and a wagging tail, always happy to make new friends wherever he goes. One of his favourite things in the world is water! He loves to dip his paws in water. Goofy is social and well mannered, but thinks he is a small dog so can be a little full on around his smaller friends, he would prefer a medium to large breed friend or if he has his own little back yard he may even prefer to be the centre of your attention and an only dog. Above all, he is a genuinely happy dog who wakes up every day ready to embrace life. If you're looking for a loving, fun-filled companion with a big heart, a quirky personality and plenty of affection to give, this handsome Greyhound is ready to steal your heart.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: *I'm in foster in the Inner West in an apartment and I am available to adopt!* Foster update: "She is doing sooo well, her toileting is so good! She'll hold it until we get downstairs and outside. She has slept on her bed all night with no issues, she's a huge cuddle bug and LOVES to be touching us at all times. She loves taking the lift, which she looks at herself in the mirror. She's been such a joy! Little Emma has been settling in to her foster home wonderfully. Her progress since day 1 vs now has been consistent and steady and we’ve been ticking off little milestones as she goes which is beautiful to see. She’s much more relaxed and confident in the home (roaching and sleep-groaning up a storm). We’ve noticed a big change in her comfort level, and she’s really starting to show her personality, particularly in these last 2-3 weeks. She’s lovin home life! She has recently started sleeping in until we wake up which has been a lovely sign that she’s feeling more secure in her routine. She also sleeps in her own bed in the bedroom, which is truly so polite of her. Given that we live in a 1 bedroom apartment this feels like great progress and she seems really good at settling herself. Emma is perfectly clean indoors and has been doing well with her toilet routine. She happily toilets outside during her regular walks and outings and sleeps throughout the night without any issues. She’s patient and lets you get her ready for walkies with no hassle. She’s very happy with moderate exercise and then spends the rest of the day relaxing. Emma is incredibly sweet, gentle and affectionate and has no problem making every person she meets fall in love with her. We’ve noticed her slowly starting to play with toys a little more (albeit short lived) and gets so shy when you catch her doing it, super cute. Emma thrives on predictable routine and gets a handle on it pretty quickly. While settling in she lets you set the pace while figuring out how to cuddle up to you as close as possible almost instantly. Continuing a consistent routine will likely help her settle quickly into her forever home. She’s responded really well to predictability, patience and tons of affection! She also is a really social dog so if matched with the right forever home, we really believe having a furry companion she gets along with would be beneficial for her. She is also great on car trips, she relaxes and settles almost instantly and half the time you forget she’s even there, a stress-free road trip buddy!" Meet Emma at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bobby
TEXT: Bobby is a charming male Greyhound with a confident, playful personality and a zest for life. In environments he knows well, he is happy, outgoing, and loves to enjoy himself, bringing plenty of fun and character wherever he goes. His playful nature makes him a delight to spend time with, and he thrives when he has opportunities to engage with both his people and his surroundings. Bobby is comfortable around medium to large dogs and enjoys canine company. In fact, he would do best in a home with a compatible canine companion who can provide friendship, confidence, and help him settle into family life. Having another dog around would give Bobby the social connection he enjoys and help him feel more secure when his people are busy. While Bobby is learning the routines of home life, he has shown that he can settle nicely for short periods. With ongoing guidance, enrichment, and a suitable companion, Bobby has every opportunity to continue developing his independence and household manners. Bobby is ready to find a family who will embrace his playful charm, support his continued learning, and give him the companionship he craves. Book a meet at Western Sydney

NAME: Onyx
TEXT: This is Onyx! If you're looking for a fun-loving companion with a big personality, Onyx is ready to steal your heart. This handsome black boy is full of enthusiasm and greets every day with wagging tail and a smile. Onyx travels well in the car, making him an excellent companion for adventures both near and far. He always excited to meet new people and isn't shy about showing his affection- don't be surprised if he pops up for a few happy licks to say hello! Playful, social and bursting with confidence, Onyx loves stretching his legs with a round of zoomies before settling down to enjoy time with his people. His friendly nature and zest for life makes him a joy to have around, and he is always keen to be part of the action. If your after a loyal,affectionate greyhound with plenty of personality love to give, Onyx could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Crystal
TEXT: Hello Crystal. Crystal is a stunning blue girl with a sparkling personality to match her looks. Full of confidence and charm, she loves meeting new people and is always ready to find a new friend. Affectionate, playful and people- focused, Crystal thrives on human companionship and is happiest when she is a apart of the action. She travels beautifully in the car and walks calmly on a lead, taking in the sights and surrounds of the world around her with curiosity. When its time to let loose, Crystals fun-loving nature shines. She absolutely adores the freedom to stretch her legs, racing around with joyful zoomies and bounding through the backyard with an infectious zest for life. Crystal would suit an active family or individual who can provide her with regular opportunities to play, explore and enjoy life to the fullest. With her friendly nature, loving personality and playful spirit, Crystal is ready to bring endless happiness to her forever home.

NAME: Indy
TEXT: Meet Indy! Indy is a beautiful blue girl with a gentle nature and a quiet charm that's impossible not to love. While she can be a little shy when meeting people, it doesn't take long for her sweet personality to shine through. Once she feels comfortable she will happily seek out your company and become a loyal companion. Indy travels beautifully in the car and is a dream to walk, making her an easy addition to any home that enjoys getting out and about. She loves letting loose with a few playfull zoomies in the backyard before settling down to relax and enjoy the comforts of home. With her calm temperament, kind heart and easy going nature, Indy is looking for a patient family who will give her time to blossom. In return, she will reward you with a quite companionship and plenty of love.

NAME: Dove
TEXT: *Dove has just gone to a foster care home* Just like her name suggests, Dove is ready to spread her wings and begin an exciting new chapter as a much-loved family pet. This beautiful Greyhound has a gentle soul and a heart full of affection. Dove is happiest when she's with her people, happily accepting pats, leaning in for cuddles, and enjoying the simple pleasure of your company. Her loving nature makes her an easy dog to adore. Dove is social with other Greyhounds and enjoys their company. She is also suitable to live with respectful children, thanks to her calm and gentle temperament. As Dove spreads her wings into pet life, she'll be looking for a family who can help her navigate this new world with patience and encouragement. Every new experience is another chance for her confidence to grow, and with a supportive home beside her, she's sure to flourish. A house with a secure yard will give Dove the perfect balance of space to explore and a cosy place to come back to for a well-earned snooze.
