If you're ready to help Dove spread her wings and watch her blossom into a cherished companion, she'd love to meet you. Dove is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Charlotte
TEXT: This beautiful blue girl is friendly and affectionate. She is happy to meet new people, new critters. Charlotte also enjoys a walk and is very easy to walk with on the lead. She would be a great addition to your life since she is such good company and easy going.

NAME: Ben
TEXT: Meet Ben – Your Fun-Loving Foodie! If you’re looking for a happy, outgoing companion with plenty of personality, Ben could be your perfect match. Full of playful, puppy-like energy, Ben loves nothing more than stretching his legs, chasing toys, and making the most of every adventure. Like his brother Bill, Ben never raced and has spent his life living in an apartment with a differently abled owner alongside another dog, so he has experience as a much-loved companion in a home environment. He’s friendly, social, and enjoys being involved in whatever his people are doing. One thing you’ll quickly discover about Ben is his enthusiasm for food! He absolutely loves mealtimes and tasty treats, making him a delight to train and an eager participant in learning new things. With his affectionate nature, playful spirit, and love of life, Ben would thrive with an active family or individual who can give him plenty of exercise, enrichment, and, of course, a few delicious snacks along the way. If you’re after a cheerful best friend who will keep you smiling every day, Ben is ready to meet you.

NAME: Cherie
TEXT: Meet Cherie, a sweet and gentle girl with a calm, easy going nature. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, it doesn't take long for her confidence to shine through. Once she feels comfortable, Cherie is affectionate, playful and loves spending time with her people. She enjoys playtime, walks beautifully on lead and has a relaxed, no nonsense personality that makes her a delight to have around the home. Cherie would be well suited to a young family looking for a loyal and gentle companion who will reward a little patience with endless love and companionship.

NAME: Merle
TEXT: Meet Merle 💛 Merle is a sweet, gentle girl with a kind nature who is looking for a calm, understanding home where she can truly blossom. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, once you've earned her trust, she'll reward you with quiet loyalty and plenty of love. She loves spending time outdoors, whether she's playing with a ball, relaxing in the sunshine, or enjoying the company of her German Shepherd friend. Merle has also been enjoying her walks and is happy passing dogs of all sizes. Merle has been wonderful with visiting grandchildren aged 10 and over who understand how to give her space and let her come to them. A calm, predictable environment with gentle introductions to new experiences will help her continue to build confidence. Merle would thrive in a quieter home with patient adopters who are happy to let her settle in at her own pace. She enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and is perfectly content quietly exploring her surroundings or could happily share her home with a friendly medium-large canine companion. 🐾❤️

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear, Bear is an adorable young Greyhound with a happy, friendly nature that's hard not to love. He's a real people dog and is always keen to come over for a hello, greeting everyone with loose, wiggly body and plenty of enthusiasm. Bear has a playful side and has a great time running around the yard with his toys. He enjoys exploring, having fun and making the most of his time outside before happily settling again. On walks, Bear is easy to handle and has lovely manners on lead. He enjoys taking in his surroundings with plenty of sniffing and exploring but stays polite and relaxed while doing so. Around other Greyhounds, Bear has shown calm, friendly social skills, offering gentle sniffs and interacting politely. Meet Bear at Western Sydney.

NAME: Kelly
TEXT: Meet Kelly, Kelly is a lovely girl with a fun, gentle nature. She loves people and really soaks up any attention she's given! Toys are one of Kelly's favourite things. She loves carrying them around, playing games and will often bring them back to you for another throw. She's confident, curious and enjoys being involved in whatever is going on. On lead, Kelly is polite and easy to handle. She moves calmly around other dogs and has shown appropriate social skills. When meeting other dogs, she has shown good manners, offering polite sniffs and responding well to gentle guidance to move on. If you're looking for a friendly, playful Greyhound with great manners, Kelly is an easy dog to fall in love with. She'll happily join you for a walk, enjoy a play with her toys, then settle down nearby, ready for the next bit of attention.

NAME: Bill
TEXT: Meet Bill – Your Adventure Buddy! If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a zest for life, Bill is ready to steal your heart. This handsome boy is full of playful, puppy-like energy and absolutely loves stretching his legs with a good run or chasing after his favourite toys. Bill is friendly, outgoing, and thrives on being part of the action. His confident, extroverted nature means he’s always keen to make new friends and join in on whatever you’re doing. Whether it’s an adventure outdoors or a game in the backyard, Bill is happiest when he’s active and spending time with his people. Unlike many greyhounds, Bill has never raced. He’s enjoyed life as a much-loved companion, living successfully in an apartment with a differently abled owner and another dog. This experience has given him excellent house manners and shown that he can adapt beautifully to home life. Bill would love a family who can match his enthusiasm for life and provide him with plenty of opportunities to play, explore, and, of course, chase a toy or two. In return, you’ll gain a loyal, affectionate companion who will bring endless fun and smiles to every day.

NAME: Simon
TEXT: Simon is in foster care & available to adopt! Our foster care superstar Simon is a beautifully natured greyhound who is currently living with 2 greyhounds and small dogs (cavoodles). Simon would love an adults only home, with a townhouse/backyard to enjoy. He requires a multi-dog household to keep his confidence growing. He is shy by nature, and would love a structured home, in a quiet area (he is currently in suburban South Sydney). A home with maximum 2 adults is required as a busier home with lots of humans is an overwhelming thing for Simon. Simon will take some time to trust you, as he took a few weeks to trust his foster carers. Simon has grown his confidence around busier areas while being on a dual lead with the other greyhound, so he definitely needs a doggie friend/s by his side. Simon still gets spooked by loud noises, but can shake it off and carry on now that he has spent longer in foster and has his dog friend with him. He seeks comfort from the other greyhounds, so a home with a greyhound (or a greyhound and other breeds) is the best match. His foster carers leave Simon with the other dogs for their full time working schedule. A word from the fosters: "He understands that he needs to toilet outside, will take him outside after dinner, point down to the backyard and say “go toilet” and he will do it every night before we go to bed.. his toileting is excellent 10/10, can’t fault it (don’t think there’s been a single accident in the house since he first came to us.) He’s not afraid to approach Erin or myself for a pat, when we first had him here, he wouldn’t come near me when I would get home from work, would always be standing in the background while I gave love to Wanda, Finn & Coast.. now he’s trying to push through them all trying to get love from me and I love it!, sometimes he now even sleeps on the bed with us of a night. Simon has shown us that he’s fine around 2-3 people, but I feel he does find large groups of people overwhelming. Simon does get on perfectly fine with Wanda, Finn and Coast and has no problem sharing his space with them, has shown no signs of aggression whatsoever towards any of them. His new people will need to be patient with him, as he is on the shy side, he will take time to get comfortable in a new environment while he adjusts but once he comes out of his shell he will approach people for a pat/cuddle and is a very sweet/cute boy." Simon is a beautiful boy who has really come out of his shell with us and has come a long way since he first came to us.. he doing so well! 😊 If you're a quiet, understanding home with greyhound experience, another greyhound/others, enquire to meet Simon by appointment (with his foster family) at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rowdy
TEXT: Meet Rowdy! The handsome social butterfly with a heart full of love and a nose for treats. He is a dog social boy - friendly with big and small dogs and would enjoy a home with a medium to large dog. This confident and friendly guy absolutely adores people and will charm his way into your heart (and maybe your snack stash) in no time. Rowdy is super trainable and eager to learn, especially if food or toys are involved – a home that is interested in furthering his training and development is ideal. He’d thrive in a home with a yard to explore. Rowdy is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Bang Bang
TEXT: Meet Bang Bang, don't let his name fool you- Bang Bang is a big, gentle soul and even bigger heart. This handsome black beauty is friendly, affectionate and loves spending time with his people. Bang Bang enjoys getting out for leisurely walks and is a pleasure to have on a lead, making him a wonderful companion for regular adventures. At home he just as happy stretching out in the backyard, soaking up the sunshine or relaxing after a stroll. He has interacted well with large dogs and older children, making him a great fit for a family looking for a calm, easy-going companion. with his gentle nature, handsome looks and a love for the simple things in life, Bang Bang is ready to become a much loved member of his forever family.

NAME: Microman
TEXT: Meet Microman, a charming little greyhound with a gentle soul. Microman is a shy boy when meeting new people, but once he feels safe and settled, his sweet, funny nature shines through. He forms strong bonds with those he trusts and loves being close to his people, including gentle kids 7+, especially when he can relax indoors or curl up in the comfort of his crate with his soft toys, which is his happy place. Like many greyhounds, Microman enjoys short bursts of playful energy, and one of his favourite things is playing with his fellow retired greyhounds or chasing a ball. He's social with other greys and would thrive in a home with a confident greyhound companion to help him feel secure and show him the ropes. He doesn't like baths much! Microman is looking for a quiet, patient household that will give him the time he needs to settle in and build confidence at his own pace. In return, you'll be rewarded with a loyal, affectionate and quirky companion who will keep you smiling with his funny antics.💛🐾

NAME: Lizzy
TEXT: Meet Lizzy! 🩷 Lizzy is a lovely greyhound with a sweet, easy-going personality that's sure to win hearts. She gets along wonderfully with other dogs and has been great with all of my dogs, making her a fantastic companion for a home with canine friends. She's relaxed and easy to walk on lead, enjoying gentle outings by your side without any fuss. Whether it's a stroll around the neighbourhood or a quiet day at home, Lizzy is happy just being with her people. Lizzy isn't suitable for a home with cats, so she'll need a feline-free family where she can thrive. If you're looking for a gentle, friendly Greyhound who is ready to settle into family life, Lizzy could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Jen
TEXT: Meet Jen, Jen is a wonderfully affectionate girl who absolutely adores people. Once she gets to know you, she's happiest curled up on the couch, usually lying across your lap. She's very people-focused and enjoys being close, soaking up pats and spending time together. Jen is looking for a home where she can be the only pet to soak up all of the attention. In quieter environments, Jen truly shines. She is more relaxed, highly engaged with her handler, and readily offers positive interactions, making it easy to see her sweet and affectionate personality. For someone looking for a devoted companion who loves nothing more than sharing the couch and being close to her people, Jen has so much love to give. She will thrive in a calm home that understands her needs and will be rewarded with an incredibly loyal, affectionate best friend. Book a meet at Western Sydney!

NAME: Britney
TEXT: Meet Britney, a beautiful little girl with the sweetest, gentle nature. Calm, affectionate and easy-going, Britney is happiest enjoying the simple things in life - being inside, lounging in the yard with her greyhound friends, soaking up some sunshine, or heading out for a leisurely walk. Britney can be a little shy when meeting new people, but in a short time quickly blossoms into a loving companion who adores gentle pats and being around her people. She is friendly by nature and has been great with children 7-12 years who understand how to give her a little space while she settles in. While she has the occasional playful bursts of energy, Britney is mostly a quiet, relaxed girl. She walks beautifully on lead and especially enjoys outings with her Staffy friend, making her a lovely walking companion. Britney is both house-trained and crate-trained and would thrive in a calm household where someone is home more often than not, or with a friendly medium to large canine companion.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: If you're looking for a BFG (Big Friendly Giant), meet Jack. He is 40 something kgs of love and pure charm. He is super friendly, loves any and all humans, and would be great for families. Older kids would be best suited as he is large and might forget his size during zoomies! He can happily live alongside another medium to large size dog, another dog with large dog breed experience (or another greyhound) would be a great fit, as he can be silly and inappropriate (we think he hasn't learnt he's the biggest dog in his cohort yet). Jack can live in a house/townhouse and doesn't mind a few hours alone as a solo pet per day, and could work up to longer with a dog friend and structure. This happy chappy loves treats, training, and toys, and loves quiet moments of love with his humans. He has genuinely been a team favourite at the GAP HQ, because he will stand out in the crowd not only in size but with his handsome, charming nature. Meet Jack at Western Sydney.

NAME: Chester
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Chester 🐾 Chester is a handsome black Greyhound with a soft, gentle nature and a wonderfully easygoing presence. He’s the kind of boy who brings calm wherever he goes, happily trotting along through life with a relaxed outlook and a quietly affectionate heart. Sweet, sooky, and full of charm, Chester is a lovely companion who enjoys the simple pleasures in life. At home, Chester is a low-key, content boy who enjoys his downtime just as much as his little moments of activity. He’s known for his sweet quirks, like happily playing with his bowl after dinner, and he has a comforting, homely energy that makes him easy to be around. He even enjoys the background hum of a radio, adding to his cosy, relaxed lifestyle. Chester walks beautifully on lead and is naturally gentle, making him a pleasure to take out and about. He enjoys sniffing his surroundings, having a little trot and run, then settling back into an easy rhythm by your side. Travel is just as simple for him — he hops in, settles down, and takes everything in his stride. With people, Chester is affectionate and loving. He enjoys pats, leans in for attention, and has a soft, sooky way of connecting that makes him very endearing. He’s happiest when he’s close to his humans, sharing calm, relaxed moments together. When it comes to other dogs, Chester is a friendly boy who has experience walking alongside other Greyhounds and sharing space comfortably in familiar settings. On walks, he can be enthusiastic when meeting smaller dogs, and over time he settles nicely and is able to focus on his surroundings and enjoy his walk. In the home, he truly shines in a calm, steady environment where things feel predictable and peaceful. One of Chester’s lovely qualities is his gentle, easy nature combined with a playful spark showing his happy personality peeking through his calm exterior. 🏡 Chester’s Perfect Home Chester would love a calm, relaxed home where he can enjoy gentle walks, cosy downtime, and plenty of companionship with his people. He would thrive in a peaceful environment where life moves at an easy pace, whether with a couple, an individual, or a family with older, respectful children who enjoy a calm, affectionate dog. Chester would suit a home as the star of the show, or could also share his home with a calm, polite larger dog who matches his easygoing style. If you’re looking for a sweet, soft-hearted boy with a calm soul and a lot of love to give, Chester is ready to quietly steal your heart. 💛

NAME: Suzie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Suzie 🐾 Suzie is a gorgeous red fawn Greyhound girl with a bright, joyful spirit and a heart that loves connection. She has a happy, easygoing nature and a beautiful way of leaning in for affection, soaking up pats, and greeting her favourite people with big smiles and lots of love. She’s the kind of girl who makes you feel instantly at ease with her warm, friendly presence. Confident and curious, Suzie enjoys exploring the world. She likes to take in her surroundings and sniff out new adventures. Her outlook on life is relaxed and positive, making her a lovely companion for everyday outings and quiet moments alike. Suzie walks beautifully on lead, shifting between a light, easy tension and a relaxed slack lead as she enjoys her strolls. She’s comfortable in new environments and travels like a pro, settling calmly and comfortably when it’s time to rest and relax. People are absolutely Suzie’s favourite. She adores attention, happily comes over for pats, and often leans in close to soak up every bit of affection she can get. Her warm, social personality makes her a truly delightful companion who thrives on human connection. Suzie is happy to walk alongside calm, polite canine companions and can enjoy seeing other dogs while out and about. In her home life, though, she truly shines when she has her own space and can relax as the only dog, where she can fully unwind and enjoy being the centre of her family’s world. This is where her affectionate, easygoing nature really blossoms. 🏡 Suzie’s Perfect Home Suzie would love a loving home where she can enjoy walks, plenty of affection, and quality time with her humans. She would thrive in a calm environment where she can truly relax and shine, whether that’s with a couple, an individual, or a family with older, respectful children. Suzie would be happiest as the only dog with a family who appreciates her happy, friendly style. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate girl with a sunny personality and a whole lot of love to give, Suzie is ready to fill your home with warmth and joy. 💛

NAME: Megs
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Megs 🐾 If you're looking for a gentle soul with a heart full of love, Megs might just be your perfect match. This beautiful red fawn Greyhound is a sweet, soft-natured girl who enjoys taking life at her own pace. She may be a little reserved when meeting someone new, but once she feels comfortable, her affectionate and cuddly personality shines through, rewarding you with gentle pats, quiet companionship, and plenty of loving moments. Megs is the kind of dog who enjoys exploring the world with calm curiosity. She likes to take her time, having a good sniff and soaking up her surroundings before relaxing into new experiences. As her confidence grows, so does her happy, relaxed body language, making it a joy to watch her blossom. Around the people she knows and trusts, Megs is an absolute sweetheart. She's a gentle, "sooky" girl who loves affection and enjoys staying close to her favourite humans. Her calm nature makes her a lovely companion for peaceful days spent together. Walking with Megs is a pleasant experience, as she has lovely lead manners and is happy to stroll alongside you without pulling. She also travels beautifully, settling happily in the car or crate. When it comes to other dogs, Megs appreciates polite introductions and enjoys having the space to get to know new canine friends in her own time. She has experience walking alongside other Greyhounds and is comfortable sharing her space with familiar companions. Once she's had the chance to settle, she's happy to investigate and interact at a pace that suits her. Physically, Megs is a gorgeous red fawn girl with a graceful build and an irresistibly gentle expression that perfectly matches her kind personality. She is now ready to enjoy the next chapter of her life as a much-loved family member. A Home Made for Megs Megs would thrive in a calm, relaxed home where she can settle into a steady routine and continue building her confidence. She'd love a family or individual who enjoys peaceful walks, cosy evenings, and giving her the time to show just how affectionate she can be. A quieter household would suit her beautifully, allowing her sweet personality to flourish at her own comfortable pace. Megs has so much love to give and is ready to find a family who will cherish her gentle heart. If you're searching for a loyal, loving companion who will quietly become your very best friend, Megs can't wait to meet you.

NAME: Pablo
TEXT: Pablo currently shares a yard with Missy without issue during the day, he walks great on the lead and is happy to meet new people and explore new places. He gets along with all dogs he meets and given his relaxed and laid back nature he could fit in to most living arrangments.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: This pretty girl is very sweet and affectionate. She is confident and inquisitive in new places and happy to make new friends. She currently lives well with Pablo in a residential yard.

NAME: Tammy Lynne
TEXT: This charming girl has been destined for pet life given her beautiful playful and affectionate nature, she gets along well with all people and children. She does well on her own, and is confident and social.

NAME: Bindi
TEXT: *I have just gone into a foster home, check back for updates!* Affectionate, kind-hearted & active girl Bindi is looking for her forever home. Despite her age, she is all the things a young dog is: outgoing, ultra friendly and always smiling ear to ear. Bindi is the ideal companion, proving age is no barrier to affection and fun. A true toy enthusiast, Bindi absolutely loves playing and keeping herself entertained. Because of her excitement around toys, we recommend a home with children aged 10 years and over, as she may mistake a child's toys for her own during playtime! Bindi is social with other medium to large dogs and enjoys making canine friends, making her a wonderful companion for outings and adventures. She could happily live with an owner who works full-time, provided she has appropriate outlets for her energy, such as enrichment activities, interactive toys, and regular exercise before and after work. She is also well suited to apartment living, provided there is lift access or the apartment is on the ground floor. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Zippy
TEXT: Meet Zippy, a fun loving-boy with a real zest for life! Whether he's stretching his legs with a burst of zoomies, heading out for a walk or simply relaxing by your side, Zippy embraces everyday with enthusiasm. He just as happy spending time indoors as he is enjoying the outdoors, and he loves being with his people. While Zippy can be a little shy when meeting new faces, don't let that fool you. With a little patience and kindness, his gentle affectionate nature quickly shines through, rewarding you with a loyal companion who forms strong bonds and with those he trust. If you're looking for an active yet sensitive greyhound who will thrive in a loving home willing to let him settle in at his own pace, Zippy could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Mack
TEXT: Mack is a striking black and white gentleman who is ready to swap racing life for a loving home. After 24 starts on the track, he decided racing simply wasn’t for him anymore and is now looking forward to enjoying life at a much more relaxed pace. NAME: Neptune
TEXT: *I am in foster care* Introducing our special, beautiful blue boy Neptune, also known as Nepi, Nippy and Good Boy! Neptune has been in foster care for a few months. When Neptune first came home, he was very shy. He has come out of his shell slowly, and requires ongoing confidence building and an owner who will be his champion, protector and advocate. We are looking for a home with another dog for Neptune and a family who can love Neptune for the journey of confidence building that he is on. He would suit a house with a yard/outdoor space so he can flee the scene when needed. He is now coping with all things pet life, and growing everyday. He can be left for full time hours outdoors, he prefers now to sleep indoors, after initially being too scared to come inside. He doesn't bark and loves to be inside - only if you are with him. He was quite reluctant to be touched, but now loves pats, and stands next to you for back scratches. When he meets new people, his foster carer asks Neptune to decide whether he wants them to pat him. In everything, his foster carer allows it to be his decision and at his pace. Neptune loves food, prefers to eat outside on his own, and loves his after breakfast treat every morning of chicken fillet jerky. He knows the word “treat”! He also loves brisket bones. He gets a lot of confidence from other greyhounds and even smaller dogs. Loves being around them. He is very sweet and gentle natured. If you are someone loving, compassionate, who shows empathy, patience and understanding, who will love our very special boy, we know he will make the most loving and loyal companion. His foster carer has loved him unconditionally and he loves her back. If you are an experienced greyhound/experienced shy dog owner, with another doggie companion for Neptune to thrive with, please get in touch! You can meet Neptune and his foster carer at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bingo
TEXT: Bingo is a male greyhound with a calm and independent nature who enjoys taking in the world around him. He is naturally curious about his environment and tends to spend his time exploring, observing, and investigating new surroundings. While he may not immediately seek out human interaction, he becomes increasingly relaxed as he settles and gains confidence in his environment. Around small dogs, Bingo has shown appropriate social skills and good self-control. He may initially display curiosity and interest, particularly when first noticing a smaller dog, but he settles quickly as he gathers information. Bingo also displays polite manners around medium and large dogs. He is capable of offering gentle greetings and then moving on without lingering, demonstrating a balanced and respectful social style. Overall, Bingo is a thoughtful, easy-going greyhound who combines quiet independence with gentle social skills. As he becomes comfortable in new situations, his relaxed and steady temperament shines through. He would suit a home that appreciates his calm nature and allows him the freedom to explore, observe, and settle into family life at his own pace. With time and patience, Bingo is likely to become a loyal and rewarding companion. Meet Bingo in Western Sydney.

NAME: Jade
TEXT: Jade is a polite, social, affectionate and loving girl. She shows off her beautiful personality around new people, greeting everyone with a happy smile. She is friendly around other dogs and is best suited to a home with medium or large size dogs. She is a confident girl who would enjoy a home with respectful kids and a backyard to play in. Jade is a beautiful, happy and engaged girl who can't wait to meet you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rana
TEXT: Meet Rana! Rana is a gentle and sensitive female greyhound who approaches the world with a quiet and thoughtful nature. She can be cautious in unfamiliar situations and prefers to take her time becoming comfortable with new environments, people, and experiences. Rather than rushing into things, Rana carefully observes her surroundings and gains confidence gradually as she feels safe and supported. She enjoys exploring at her own pace, often taking in her environment through calm investigation and sniffing. While initially reserved, Rana remains close to her handler and appears to take comfort from having a familiar person nearby. Her gentle demeanour and soft nature suggest she will benefit from a patient home that allows her to settle in and build trust on her own terms. Rana is a kind-hearted and sensitive greyhound who will thrive in a calm and understanding home. With patience, gentle guidance, and time to settle, she is likely to develop into a loyal and affectionate companion. Her polite nature, gentle social skills, and quiet presence make her a lovely candidate for a family seeking a sweet and thoughtful greyhound to welcome into their lives. Meet Rana at Western Sydney

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear! Bear is a gentle and thoughtful nature boy who is gradually learning to navigate new environments with confidence. He is a little shy when meeting new people but warms up quickly and will approached when called, as he becomes more familiar with those around him, his confidence grows and his relaxed, easy-going nature begins to shine through. He has demonstrated lovely manners around other dogs and appears to enjoy canine company. Bear is polite in his interactions, showing interest without being overbearing, and is able to move on calmly after greeting. His body language is generally relaxed and appropriate, particularly around larger dogs and other greyhounds. Overall, Bear is a sweet, gentle companion with a calm temperament and polite social skills. He would be well suited to a home that understands his sensitive nature and provides him with the time and encouragement to build confidence. In return, Bear offers a quiet, affectionate presence and all the makings of a wonderful family companion. Meet Bear at Western Sydney

NAME: Harper
TEXT: Harper is a friendly, affectionate girl who loves people, pats, and being part of family life. After spending the past year living as a much-loved pet on a farm, she's ready to find her forever home. She enjoys walks with the family, including outings with young children, and is equally happy joining Mum for a run. Harper has great manners around livestock and can calmly walk past chickens and ducks on lead without becoming over-excited. Harper gets along well with other dogs, including a retired greyhound, a Blue Heeler and a Mini Schnauzer. She loves toys, backyard playtime, visitors, and car trips. With her gentle nature, playful spirit, and love of companionship, Harper is ready to become a family favourite or someone's perfect best friend. ❤️🐾

NAME: May
TEXT: May is a happy, affectionate girl who loves people and will happily come up to you for pats and cuddles. She enjoys spending time with her family and her sweet nature makes her a wonderful companion and a joy to have around. May loves playing in the backyard, especially when there's a ball involved! She has enjoyed spending time with grandchildren aged 10–12 years and has also been around a 2-year-old child with supervision. She would fit beautifully into a family environment or make a loyal companion for someone looking for a loving friend, on her own or with another grey or small dog, getting along nicely with Mini Schnauzer. May travels well, walks nicely on lead, and takes life's adventures in her stride. With her affectionate personality and easy-going nature, May is ready to bring happiness and companionship to her new home.

NAME: Dot
TEXT: 🤍 Meet Dot! Dot is a gentle soul with a sweet and thoughtful nature. She can be a little reserved when faced with new environments or unfamiliar people, preferring to quietly observe before her confidence begins to shine through. With patience and understanding, Dot forms strong bonds and becomes a loyal companion. She absolutely loves her walks and enjoys spending time exploring alongside her people. Dot would be best suited to a calm, quiet home with a patient family who can give her the time and reassurance she needs to settle in and flourish. 🐾

NAME: Frog
TEXT: 🐸 Meet Frog! Frog is a playful, interactive boy who loves being involved in whatever his humans are doing. Incredibly people-oriented, he's happiest spending time by your side—whether that's heading out on an adventure or leaning in for a cuddle. Affectionate by nature, Frog isn't shy about handing out plenty of loving licks! With his friendly personality and adaptable nature, he would fit well into a variety of home environments and is ready to become a devoted companion.

NAME: Princess
TEXT: 👑 Meet Princess! Princess is a fun-loving girl with a bubbly personality and a heart full of affection. A true social butterfly, she loves making new friends and thrives on human companionship. Confident and outgoing, she's comfortable navigating stairs and enjoys exploring her surroundings. Princess would be best suited to an active home with a backyard where she can stretch her legs, play, and be part of the family adventures. With her sweet nature and zest for life, she's sure to bring plenty of joy to her new home.

NAME: Cliff
TEXT: Meet Cliff! 🐾 Cliff is a playful, fun-loving boy who brings plenty of joy wherever he goes. Curious and social, he loves engaging with both people and toys and is always keen to be part of the action. He enjoys his walks, exploring new surroundings, and having a good run around when given the chance. The backyard is Cliff's little oasis, where he can play, sniff, and enjoy the outdoors. After the fun is done, he's just as happy to kick back, relax, and enjoy a well-earned snooze. With his friendly personality and balanced nature, Cliff would make a wonderful companion for a lucky family.

NAME: Rhys
TEXT: Meet Rhys! 🐾 Rhys is a sweet-natured boy who is looking for a patient and understanding home where he can settle in at his own pace. While he may take a little time to find his feet, once he's comfortable you'll discover a loyal companion who loves being part of the family. Rhys will do best with older kids. With kindness, patience, and plenty of reassurance, Rhys will blossom into your very best mate, rewarding you with his gentle nature and unwavering companionship.

NAME: Darcy
TEXT: Meet Darcy! 🐾 Darcy is a happy, easy-going boy who loves nothing more than spending time with his people. He's great on walks, making him a wonderful companion for daily adventures, and he's always happiest when he's by your side. Darcy is a clever lad who comes when called by name and enjoys being involved in whatever you're up to. With his friendly nature and loyal personality, he's ready to find a home where he can share plenty of love, companionship, and happy moments.

NAME: Timmy
TEXT: Meet Timmy! 🐾 Timmy is a playful, happy boy who loves being involved in whatever you're doing. He enjoys sticking by your side and makes a wonderful companion, whether you're heading out for a stroll or relaxing at home. Easy to walk on the lead,, Timmy has a cheerful nature that's sure to bring a smile to your face. With his friendly personality and loyal spirit, he's ready to become someone's very best mate🐶

NAME: Obi Wan Kenobi
TEXT: This is Obi-Wan Kenobi — a brave Jedi knight using the Force to steal hearts across the adoption centre. Obi-Wan Kenobi loves his walkies and might even do a little happy dance when he sees his lead! Loves an adventure, making him a great fit for an active family who enjoy long walks through the galaxy. He is perfectly behaved indoors at the adoption centre. Gentle, affectionate, and loves chilling out, Obi has the quintessential greyhound personality — laid back with moments of playfulness. Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks a family who will respect his Jedi calmness but also embrace his playful side. He’s suited for homes with a peaceful vibe and a little space to run around. Apply for our special boy Obi — and may the peace, paws, and happiness be with you! 🌟🐾

NAME: Timmy
TEXT: Timmy is a handsome, charismatic blue brindle guy! Timmy has spent a short amout of time in a home and his carers have said he is a big cuddly teddy bear of a dog with a goofy side! He is a dream to walk on the lead, loves to collect his toys on his bed, is a quick learner and is hilarious when he plays with his squeaky toys. They found he loves to nap and relax and didn't mind being left alone up to 3 hours if he gets a nice sniffy walk beforehand, but would propably prefer a home where someone is around fairly often to keep him company. Timmy would be suitable to live with older/experienced kids, as Timmy can get excited and forget his size in the heat of the moment. He can live with another dog his size however he doesn't need the companionship. We have also noticed Timmy is a smart boy here at GAP HQ and loves his food. He can even do stairs! So come and meet Timmy at the Western Sydney adoption centre. He can't wait to meet you!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: With a name like Bruce, you'd expect a true-blue Aussie character and this handsome greyhound doesn't disappoint. Easy-going, friendly, and always up for a stroll, Bruce has the kind of laid-back attitude that would fit right in at a backyard barbie or a lazy Sunday arvo. Bruce travels well in the car, walks beautifully on lead, and takes new experiences in his stride. He enjoys meeting people, happily stopping for a pat and a chat, and is especially social with other greyhounds and larger dogs, greeting them with enthusiastic tail wags. If you're looking for a loyal mate with a relaxed "she'll be right" outlook on life, Bruce could be the perfect addition to your family. Bruce is available at Western Sydney

NAME: Uno
TEXT: Uno is a unique and sensitive Greyhound looking for a special home that can appreciate him for exactly who he is. He is a quirky boy with a gentle nature who takes a little time to feel safe and comfortable in new environments and around unfamiliar people. While he may initially come across as shy and reserved, Uno begins to show his sweet personality once trust has been built at his own pace. Uno is searching for a calm, patient, and understanding home that can support his individual needs and allow him the time he requires to settle in and gain confidence. He thrives with gentle handling, consistency, and a quiet environment where he feels secure. Uno would be best suited to an adult-only household where life is calm and predictable. He is happy to coexist with other Greyhounds and may enjoy the quiet companionship of another calm canine friend. Uno may not be the kind of dog who rushes into new friendships, but for the right person willing to give him time and understanding, he has the potential to form a deeply rewarding bond. He is a truly special boy looking for someone who will see the beauty in his quiet and quirky nature. Find Uno at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rex
TEXT: Rex is a people-loving greyhound who thrives on attention and connection. If you’re looking for a companion who enjoys being part of your day and happily soaks up affection, Rex will be right by your side. He’s highly motivated by food, which makes him responsive and engaged, and he settles beautifully in his crate when it’s time to relax. While toys aren’t really his thing, human company certainly is. Rex has socialised well with other greyhounds and could share his home with a compatible medium to large canine friend, though he would be just as happy as the only dog. He would be suitable for a family with respectful children and has shown a calm and affectionate nature in his interactions with people. Rex has demonstrated that he settles best indoors and enjoys the comfort of home life. A townhouse with at least a small courtyard would be ideal, giving him a bit of outdoor space to stretch his legs and unwind. Initially, Rex may be best suited to a home where he has someone home more often than not, while he adjusts, but he has shown an encouraging ability to self-settle. With gradual progression and routine, his capacity can continue to build. Rex is a warm, affectionate boy who is ready to enjoy the comforts of pet life. With structure, guidance and plenty of love, he will make a devoted and rewarding companion.

NAME: Oaklee
TEXT: Oaklee is a happy, outgoing Greyhound with a playful spirit and a real zest for life. He loves spending time with people and thrives on interactive games, adventures, and new experiences. Wherever he goes, Oaklee brings fun, enthusiasm, and positive energy. While he enjoys staying active and making the most of every day, he also appreciates quiet moments to relax and unwind. With his friendly nature and balanced temperament, Oaklee is the perfect mix of playful companion and laid-back friend.

NAME: Vince
TEXT: Vince is a handsome male Greyhound with a confident and easy-going personality. He settles well into new environments and enjoys exploring his surroundings, taking everything in with curiosity and confidence. Whether he’s out on a walk or meeting new people, Vince carries himself with calm and polite manners. He walks beautifully on lead and is a pleasure to have by your side. Vince enjoys human interaction and happily approaches people for attention, often leaning in gently for a scratch and some affection. His friendly and relaxed nature makes him a lovely companion to spend time with. Vince would be best suited as the only animal in the home, where he can enjoy all the love, attention, and comfort for himself. He would thrive in a home that can continue providing him with companionship, routine, and opportunities to explore the world around him. With his confident personality, lovely manners, and affectionate nature, Vince is ready to become a loyal and cherished companion for a very lucky home. Meet Vince at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ritchie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Ritchie 🐾 If you're looking for a gentle soul with a heart of gold, Ritchie may just be your perfect match. This handsome fawn Greyhound is a sweet, thoughtful boy who likes to take in the world at his own pace. With his calm nature and quiet charm, Ritchie has a lovely way of winning people over once he feels comfortable. Ritchie is the kind of dog who enjoys getting to know his people first. He's a gentle and sensitive companion who appreciates a kind approach, and once he's settled in, he happily leans into affection. There's something incredibly special about a dog like Ritchie, and watching his personality shine through. While Ritchie is a calm and sometimes reserved boy, he's definitely not a couch potato. He enjoys his walks and likes to explore his surroundings, taking in all the interesting sights and smells along the way. Every now and then, he'll delight you with a joyful burst of zoomies, showing off his playful side before settling back into his easy-going rhythm. Ritchie walks beautifully on lead and travels well in the car, making him a wonderful companion for outings. Whether it's a stroll through the neighbourhood or a drive to a favourite walking spot, he's happiest simply spending time with his people. He has lovely manners around other dogs, greeting small dogs politely before happily continuing on his way, and he's comfortable sharing space with other Greyhounds. His relaxed, respectful nature makes him a pleasure to have around. At around four and a half years old, Ritchie is at a wonderful stage of life where he enjoys a balance of activity and relaxation. He appreciates the chance for an occasional zoom around a secure yard, and is equally happy unwinding at home afterwards. His handsome fawn coat and gentle personality make him an easy dog to fall in love with. Ritchie's ideal home is one that appreciates his thoughtful nature and enjoys sharing life's simple moments together. He'd love a family who enjoys regular walks or a yard to zoom around in and a relaxed home environment. If you're looking for a gentle, loyal Greyhound with a playful streak and a heart of gold, Ritchie would love to meet you and become part of your family. 🐾💛

NAME: Rodger
TEXT: Rodger is a typical boy who likes his time looking after the yard, chasing balls and going on walks. He is also a sucker for a cuddle and some affection. He would also make a good supervisor for when you are in the yard.

NAME: Atlas
TEXT: Atlas is a handsome boy with a gentle nature and a heart that’s ready to bond deeply with his future family. While he can be a little nervous when meeting new people and situations, he is willing to engage and quickly shows his sweet personality once he feels comfortable. An owner-centred dog, Atlas loves having his people nearby and will thrive in a home where he can build a close connection with his new family. He is crate trained, enjoys the comfort of his own space, and settles well with a little patience and routine. Like many hounds, he can be a bit awkward at times, which only adds to his charm and lovable character. Atlas enjoys playtime, especially when a squeaky toy is involved, and has shown himself to be friendly and appropriate around a whippet. He is in good condition, travels well, and is ready to leave his racing days behind in search of a loving forever home. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who will reward your patience with unwavering affection and companionship, Atlas could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Frank
TEXT: Frank is a happy, friendly boy who is ready to find a family of his very own. With his good-natured personality and affectionate nature, he's sure to bring plenty of love and laughter to his future home. Frank enjoys spending time with people and is always happy to be part of the action. Whether it's joining you for outdoor adventures, relaxing in the yard, or simply hanging out with his family, Frank is happiest when he's included. Frank is medium to large dog friendly, pending a successful meet and greet. Frank would be best suited to a home with children aged 10 years and older who can respectfully interact with him and understand his boundaries. A home with a secure yard would be ideal for Frank, giving him space to stretch his legs, play, and enjoy the outdoors. He would thrive with a family that can provide regular exercise, companionship, and plenty of opportunities to be involved in daily life. Meet Frank at Western Sydney adoption centre

NAME: Hudson
TEXT: *I've just gone into a foster care home and I am available to adopt!* Notes from foster: "Just a quick update to let you know that Hudson is doing well. We have been keeping things very low-key and allowing him to settle in at his own pace. He is such a good boy with his toileting. He is also very keen for breakfast and dinner and eats everything in his bowl, so he definitely has a good appetite! He showed us his playful side and had a lovely play with the toys, including doing a couple of zoomies, which was great to see. He is a lovely, gentle boy, and we are looking forward to seeing more of his personality emerge." Hudson is a handsome boy who is ready to find a patient and understanding family to call his own. While he's still learning the ropes of pet life, Hudson is making great progress and would thrive in a home that can help him continue building his confidence. Hudson is M-L dog-friendly and would greatly benefit from having a calm, well-adjusted canine companion in the home. A friendly dog buddy can help show him the way, provide reassurance, and make settling into family life much easier. He would be best suited to a home with a secure yard where he can stretch his legs, enjoy some outdoor time, and explore his surroundings safely. A house with space to move around will help him feel comfortable and give him opportunities to exercise and unwind. In his new home, Hudson will benefit from a gradual settling-in period and a consistent routine. Initially, he'd do best with shorter periods alone while he adjusts to his surroundings. As his confidence grows and he becomes comfortable in his new environment, Hudson should be able to work up to spending longer periods on his own. If you're looking for a sweet dog who just needs a little guidance and a chance to shine, Hudson could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Fran
TEXT: Meet Fran 🐾 Fran is a sweet, friendly, and very pretty greyhound who absolutely loves people. She has a warm, social nature and enjoys spending time with her humans as well as getting along nicely with small dogs. This lovely girl is a big fan of treats, which makes her a great candidate for ongoing training—and she may even enjoy learning a few fun tricks! Fran walks beautifully on the lead, making outings together a pleasure. She’s also a clean and quiet housemate, settling in nicely and bringing a calm, gentle presence to the home. With her affectionate personality and easygoing nature, Fran would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loving and well-mannered friend 💕

NAME: Dash
TEXT: Meet Dash 🐾 Dash is a handsome blue male greyhound and, quite simply, a very good boy. He has a playful and cheerful nature, always ready for some fun—especially when toys are involved! One of Dash’s cutest quirks is his love of carrying his bed around 😊 He likes to take it with him during the day, always very carefully, making sure he has the perfect spot ready for a cosy sleep at night. Dash is friendly and social, getting along well with both small dogs and other large dogs. He loves human company just as much and is always happy to soak up plenty of pats and attention. With his playful spirit, gentle heart, and easygoing nature, Dash would make a wonderful companion for a home looking for a fun and affectionate addition.

NAME: Min Min
TEXT: Meet Minnie (Min Min) 🐾 Minnie—affectionately known as Min Min—is a sweet and gentle girl who may be a little shy at first, but she quickly warms up to those who show her kindness and patience. Once she feels safe, her lovely personality shines through. She’s been living in an apartment-style environment and is a clean, easy housemate, making her a wonderful fit for indoor living. Minnie enjoys a little burst of zoomies to stretch her legs, then is more than happy to curl up in her bed and relax. She loves her walks, and Min Min loves a trip to the beach, where she can take in all the sights and smells. Minnie would thrive in a quiet home where she can feel secure and spend time with her people. With a bit of ongoing training and routine, Minnie has the potential to be comfortably left alone for a few hours at a time. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving companion who enjoys both a little fun and plenty of relaxation, Minnie could be the perfect match 💕

NAME: Boots
TEXT: Meet Boots 🐾 Boots is a slightly older and wiser female greyhound with a calm, gentle nature. She’s at a lovely stage of life where she’s settled, easygoing, and ready to enjoy the quiet comforts of a loving home. Boots would thrive in a peaceful environment and may be happiest as an only dog, where she can truly relax and enjoy her surroundings. She would make wonderful company for a retired single person or couple looking for a loyal, low-key companion. Affectionate and loving, Boots enjoys her downtime and would prefer a home without small, busy dogs who might disturb her well-earned rest. Don’t let her age fool you — Boots still has many years of love to share. If you’re looking for a sweet, settled girl to share your days with, Boots could be the perfect match 💜

NAME: Red
TEXT: Meet Red 🐾 Red is a beautiful blue male greyhound with a gentle heart. He can be a little shy at first, but with some patience and kindness, his sweet nature truly shines. Once he feels safe and comfortable, Red becomes a loyal and loving companion. He absolutely loves the company of other greyhounds and enjoys spending time with his favourite stuffed toy. While he’s very social with his own kind, small, yappy dogs can feel a bit overwhelming for him, so slow, thoughtful introductions are important. Red is looking for a calm, patient foster carer or adopter who can give him the time he needs to adjust to family life. With the right support and understanding, he will flourish into a devoted and affectionate friend. If you have a gentle home and a kind heart, Red would love to meet you 💙

NAME: Bub
TEXT: Meet Bub! Say hello to Bub, a sweet-natured older girl who’s ready to enjoy the simple pleasures of retirement. Bub is looking for a quiet, peaceful home where she can soak up the sun, enjoy some gentle pats, and claim a soft, cosy bed as her own. With her graceful charm and soft eyes, Bub has a spring in her step, but she’s very low-maintenance when it comes to exercise – a short burst of energy in the yard, a few short strolls and a bit of backyard sunbathing are all she needs to be content. She would thrive as an only dog, but she’s also happy to share her space with a male greyhound companion. Bub is a great match for full-time workers if there’s a secure backyard where she can relax during the day. She would also suit a calm household with older children who respect her quiet nature. If you're after a gentle soul who’s past the puppy chaos and just wants to be your loyal companion, Bub might just be the girl you’ve been waiting for. ☀️ Loves: Sunbaking, soft beds, peaceful vibes 🏡 Best home: Quiet environment, backyard, solo or with a male greyhound 💙 Personality: Calm, sweet, gentle, quietly affectionate 🦴 Exercise needs: Minimal – a yard for a quick zoom, a gentle stroll, she’s more nap than zoom Let Bub bring serenity, love, and a little sparkle into your life.

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: Jasper is a friendly and confident Greyhound who absolutely loves being around people. He thrives on affection and human interaction and is happiest when he’s included in everyday life with his family. Jasper enjoys being part of the action and will happily seek out attention and cuddles from his favourite humans whenever he gets the chance. With his social and outgoing nature, Jasper is a lovely companion to have around the home. He enjoys company and brings a warm, affectionate presence wherever he goes. His confidence and friendly personality make him an easy dog to bond with, and he loves feeling connected to the people around him. Jasper is social with other Greyhounds and would likely enjoy the companionship of another calm canine friend. He would benefit from a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs, relax outdoors, and enjoy time with his family. Sweet, affectionate, and full of personality, Jasper is ready to find a loving home where he can continue being included, adored, and spoiled with all the attention he deserves. Meet Jasper at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a beautiful 3-year-old Greyhound with a calm, gentle nature. Bear is social around other dogs and could happily live with other Greyhounds or medium-sized dogs. He may also be able to live with smaller breed dogs if the match is right and introductions are handled slowly and thoughtfully. He walks very well on lead and enjoys getting out for daily strolls before returning home for a long nap and some quiet time with his family. A home with older children would suit Bear best, as he would appreciate a calm and respectful environment where he can feel comfortable and settled. He would also love a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs, relax in the sunshine, and enjoy some outdoor time. Bear is a sweet, adaptable boy who has so much love to give. With his gentle temperament and lovely manners, he is ready to become a cherished member of a lucky family. Meet Bear by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Azzi
TEXT: 🤍 Meet Azzi Azzi is a beautiful older gentleman with the sweetest soul and a gentle nature that’s impossible not to love. He’s calm, affectionate and happiest simply spending time with his people, making him the perfect loyal companion to share your days with. Great with small dogs, Azzi has a kind and easy-going personality that would suit a home looking for a relaxed best friend. With his soft eyes and loving nature, this lovely boy is ready to enjoy the retired life full of comfort, companionship and plenty of love.

NAME: Jake
TEXT: Jake, also known as “Taw Commander,” is a striking young boy bursting with personality, enthusiasm, and charm. Extremely social with people, Jake thrives on human interaction and forms strong bonds with his handlers, listening well and loving being part of the action. A playful and energetic lad, Jake would suit an active home that can keep up with his zest for life. While he absolutely adores playtime, he can be a little unaware of his own size and strength, so he would be best matched with medium to large canine companions. He’s already proven himself capable of making great doggy friendships — his best mate is a Rottweiler! Jake has been acclimated to life inside the home and is looking for a family who will include him in their daily adventures, whether that’s walks, outings, or relaxing together after a fun-filled day. With his stunning looks, affectionate nature, and larger-than-life personality, Jake is sure to make an unforgettable companion.

NAME: Arlo
TEXT: Arlo is an affectionate boy with a beautiful brindle coat. He’s a soft, social soul who adores being around people and thrives on gentle attention. At almost two years old, he’s in that perfect stage—playful and curious but already calm and well‑mannered. This sweet boy has a patient, gentle nature that makes him well-suited to families with children. He enjoys being involved in family life and loves soaking up pats, ear scratches, and cuddles from little humans. He also loves to play with other medium to large dogs. 🏡 Ideal Home Arlo would thrive in a home that: Enjoys daily walks, playtime, and plenty of affection Understands the needs of a young greyhound—soft beds, gentle routines, and occasional goofy antics ❤️ Why You’ll Love Him Arlo is all heart. He’s the kind of dog who bonds deeply, follows you with those big soulful eyes. Whether he’s snoozing in the sun, trotting happily beside a dog buddy, or leaning in for a cuddle, Arlo brings warmth and joy everywhere he goes.

NAME: Foxy
TEXT: Foxy is a happy, playful and handsome blue boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for pats and cuddles. He enjoys his walks and is great on the lead, making him a lovely companion for an active family. Foxy has spent time both indoors and outdoors and been around the family children aged 9 and 12 years daily, as well as the 2.5-year-old under supervision. He’s friendly and social with other dogs too, getting along well with a pet dachshund, a pointer, and other greyhounds. Tigress has been his yard mate. With his affectionate nature, playful personality, and easy-going temperament, Foxy would suit a family looking for a fun, loving companion to include in everyday life.

NAME: Tokyo
TEXT: Tokyo is a stunning girl with a gentle soul. Initially shy, once she learns to trust you she forms a beautiful bond and looks to her favourite person for comfort and companionship. She loves stretching her legs and zooming around open spaces, but is equally happy curling up on the couch for a peaceful afternoon. Tokyo would thrive in a calm, quiet home with someone patient enough to let her blossom at her own pace. In return, she’ll reward you with loyalty, affection, and her striking good looks.

NAME: Eddy
TEXT: Eddy is a sweet, gentle and quiet boy looking for a family to thrive in. He might be going a little grey in the face but he is full of cuddles, life and happiness and can't wait to have a family to share his life with. He warms up with those he's confident with and would do best with a backyard/courtyard for sunbaking and sniffing the breeze with the occasional zoomie. He would suit a home with respectful/quiet kids and even a doggie friend or two! Eddy hasn't seen a lot of the world yet and would thrive with a home who is looking to show him all things pet life. He is very eager to please, friendly and sweet... Eddy can't wait to meet you and become a beloved family pet! Eddy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jackson
TEXT: Meet Jackson🐾 A joyful boy with a big personality and an even bigger smile! Full of life and always ready to brighten your day, Jackson has a fun-loving nature that will keep you smiling. Whether he’s being goofy, bouncing around happily, or just enjoying the moment by your side, this sweet guy brings a whole lot of happiness wherever he goes.

NAME: Mumbles
TEXT: Meet Mumbles 😄 A happy, friendly boy with the funniest personality and plenty of charm. While he loves being around his people and making you smile with his goofy nature, he’s just as happy relaxing by your side and enjoying the quieter moments too. Mumbles is the perfect mix of fun companion and goofy best friend.

NAME: Freddy
TEXT: Meet Freddy 😄 The fun-loving goofball guaranteed to keep you smiling. With his cheeky personality and playful nature, Freddy loves being by your side and getting involved in whatever you’re doing. Whether he’s making you laugh with his silly antics or soaking up attention from his humans, this happy boy brings plenty of personality wherever he goes. Freddy is the kind of companion who will quickly become your shadow and your daily dose of entertainment.

NAME: Chubbs
TEXT: Meet Chubbs 💙 Chubbs is a gentle soul with a beautiful smile and an even sweeter personality to match. This lovely boy is happiest simply being by your side, whether it’s joining you for a stroll, relaxing at home, or soaking up affection from his humans. With his calm nature and companionable personality, Chubbs is the kind of dog who will quickly become your loyal best friend.

NAME: Achilles
TEXT: Meet Achilles Achilles is a fun-loving boy who brings the perfect mix of playful energy and laid-back charm 💙 He loves soaking up pats, spending time with his people and having a bit of fun, but he’s just as happy stretching out for a nap and enjoying the quiet life afterwards. With his sweet nature and easy-going personality, Achilles would make a wonderful companion and could also live with small dogs.

NAME: Umar
TEXT: Umar is a confident and outgoing greyhound with a fun-loving personality and a zest for life. He enjoys being part of the action and is always eager to explore his surroundings, making him a wonderful companion for an active household. As a strong and enthusiastic walker, Umar will benefit from a family who can continue guiding him on lead and enjoy getting out and about with him. He thrives in environments where he has space to move, so a home with secure yard access would suit him perfectly. Whether he’s stretching his legs outdoors or taking in the world around him, Umar enjoys keeping busy and being involved in daily life. Umar is social and comfortable around people, happily spending time alongside his humans, although he tends to show his affection in a more independent and relaxed way. He enjoys companionship without being overly demanding and would suit a home that appreciates his easy-going nature. With his bright personality, confident outlook, and active spirit, Umar is looking for a home that will enjoy all the wonderful qualities he has to offer while giving him the space and lifestyle where he can truly thrive. You can meet Umar in Western Sydney.

NAME: Alvin
TEXT: Alvin is a gentle and sensitive greyhound looking for a quiet and calm household where he can relax and feel safe. With his quiet nature and sweet personality, Alvin would thrive in a peaceful household with a family who appreciates the softer side of life. He would be best suited to a home with a secure yard where he can stretch his legs, lounge in the sunshine, and enjoy his own space. Alvin enjoys relaxing and is happiest in an environment that is calm and predictable. While Alvin can be a little shy when meeting new people, with patience and kindness he gradually warms up and shows his affectionate and gentle nature. He is a quiet, timid boy initially, but once he feels comfortable, he becomes a lovely companion who enjoys simply being near his people. Because Alvin can be shy around young children, he would be best matched with a household with older children or adults only. A quieter home environment will help him continue to build confidence and feel secure. If you are looking for a calm, sweet-natured companion who enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and just needs a little time to blossom, Alvin could be the perfect addition to your family. Alvin is at Western Sydney.

NAME: Dua
TEXT: Meet Dua — a sweet, sensitive soul with a goofy streak that will keep you smiling every day. Initially a little shy, Dua quickly shows her true colours once she feels safe: affectionate, funny, playful, and always ready for a cuddle with her favourite human. Too slow for the racing world but perfectly suited to family life, Dua still loves to zoom around the yard and entertain everyone with her silly energy and lovable personality. She enjoys exploring new environments with a trusted companion by her side and is a very clever girl who likes to keep herself busy. Dua is searching for a calm, quiet home where she can truly relax and enjoy the simple things in life. She would thrive with another calm dog for company and companionship. Due to her impressive problem-solving skills and history of finding creative escape routes just to visit her hound friends, Dua will require a secure, fully fenced yard. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend who will make you laugh, snuggle close on the couch, and bring endless love into your life, Dua may just be your perfect match.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a sweet, dog social boy with a sweet personality to match his handsome looks. His happy personality is hard not to fall in love with, and he would suit a home with respectful kids. He lights up every room he enters with his infectious energy and signature grin. Whether he’s heading out for a walk, playing with his favourite toys, or simply soaking up attention, Charlie approaches life with enthusiasm and charm. Charlie enjoys having company around him and would love a home where he can be part of the daily routine and included in family life. One of Charlie’s greatest joys is playtime, especially when squeaky toys are involved. With his good looks, playful spirit, and affectionate nature, he’s sure to make a wonderful addition to a lucky family. Meet Charlie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry is a confident, goofy greyhound with a big personality and an even bigger love for people and has spent time around children and small dogs and would be happy mingling with them but not living along side. He’s friendly, affectionate, and always keen for pats, sniffy walks, and hanging out with his humans. He travels beautifully in the car, settles calmly in a crate, and is generally an easy-going lad. He’s social, gentle and full of cheeky charm. Henry is ready to find a home full of comfy couches, snacks, and a family to adore him. Meet Henry at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bolt
TEXT: Bolt is a gentle, sweet-natured greyhound with a soft soul and plenty of love to give. While he can be a little reserved when first meeting new people, it doesn’t take long for his affectionate side to come through once he feels comfortable. He’s the kind of dog who builds strong bonds with his people and absolutely blossoms in a calm, supportive environment. He would thrive in a home with a calm medium to large breed dog to keep him company and to build his confidence. Bolt is wonderful to walk and has lovely lead manners, making outings together an easy and enjoyable part of the day. He would be happiest in a home with older children who can respect his gentle nature and give him the space he needs to settle in at his own pace. For someone willing to give him a little time and reassurance, Bolt will reward them with trust, loyalty, and the quiet kind of love that feels extra special because it’s earned. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Kermit
TEXT: Meet Kermit — a loving and affectionate grey with a big personality and an adventurous spirit. Kermit loves exploring the world around him and would thrive with a family who enjoys an active lifestyle and can include him in plenty of fun and daily activities. Curious, social, and full of enthusiasm, he’s always ready to see what’s happening next. Kermit is incredibly people-focused and absolutely adores affection. He can get a little over the top with his excitement, often jumping up for cuddles, kisses, and attention because he simply loves being close to his humans. His playful and affectionate nature makes him a wonderfully entertaining companion who brings plenty of energy and joy into a home. Because of his enthusiastic personality and lively approach to affection, Kermit would be best suited to a family or active household rather than an older adopter. With the right home, he’ll make a loyal, fun-loving companion who will happily shower his people with love every single day.

NAME: Chewy
TEXT: Meet Chewy — a confident and engaging grey who navigates the world with calm curiosity and an easygoing nature. Chewy enjoys taking in her surroundings and approaches new experiences with quiet confidence, making her a relaxed and enjoyable companion to have by your side. She’s a social girl who likes being involved in family life and forms lovely connections with the people around her. Whether she’s joining in on daily activities, exploring the backyard, or simply relaxing close to her family, Chewy brings a calm and steady presence wherever she goes. Chewy would be well suited to a family home with a yard where she can enjoy space to wander, explore, and unwind. With her confident temperament, gentle curiosity, and engaging personality, Chewy is sure to make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a loyal and easygoing grey to share life with.

NAME: Jane
TEXT: Meet Jane — a shy but absolutely adorable girl with a gentle nature and a calm, sweet personality. While she may take a little time to feel comfortable in new surroundings, Jane has all the makings of a loving and loyal companion for a family willing to give her patience, kindness, and reassurance. Jane is a very chilled girl who enjoys a peaceful environment and would thrive in a home where she can settle in at her own pace and gradually build confidence. With a loving and caring family by her side, she is sure to blossom and show more of her affectionate personality as she learns to feel safe and secure. Her relaxed and easygoing temperament makes her well suited to a variety of living situations, whether that’s a house with a yard to enjoy or a quieter unit complex lifestyle. Jane would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a gentle, low-key grey to share life’s quieter moments with.

NAME: Duke
TEXT: Meet this gentle boy — a sweet and sensitive grey who is looking for a patient and caring adopter to help him feel safe and settled in his new home. While he may be shy at first, with a little time and understanding he begins to build trust and show his lovely personality. Once he gets to know someone, his confidence grows and he becomes a much more relaxed and engaging companion. As he settles in, his playful side starts to shine through, and he enjoys having fun and interacting with those he feels comfortable around. Watching him come out of his shell and gain confidence is incredibly rewarding, and he forms strong bonds with the people who give him the time and reassurance he needs. He has also handled stairs well, showing he can adapt confidently to different home environments. This lovely boy would thrive in a calm, supportive home where he can continue building his confidence at his own pace and enjoy the companionship and security of a loving family.

NAME: Adrian
TEXT: Meet Adrian — a very social and engaging grey with a confident, easygoing nature that makes him a pleasure to be around. Adrian enjoys interacting with people and naturally draws others in with his friendly personality and calm confidence. He’s the kind of companion who settles in quickly and enjoys being included in everyday life. Adrian has shown himself to be very confident in different situations, including being comfortable and capable with stairs, which makes him adaptable to a wide range of living environments. Whether in a busy family home, a quieter household, or a unit setting, Adrian’s relaxed and adaptable temperament means he is likely to thrive wherever he goes. He has also been exposed to younger children and has shown himself to be comfortable around them, making him a lovely option for families looking for a gentle and social companion. With his affectionate nature, confidence, and ability to fit easily into different lifestyles, Adrian is ready to bring companionship, warmth, and plenty of happy moments to his future home.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet Blaze — a confident, outgoing boy with a fun-loving spirit and a heart full of adventure. Blaze loves exploring the world around him and is always eager to see what’s happening, whether it’s heading out for a walk, discovering new places, or joining in on family activities. He’s a social and engaging companion who enjoys being around people and quickly wins everyone over with his friendly nature and charming personality. One of Blaze’s favorite things is playing fetch, and he’ll happily spend time chasing after toys and bringing them back with enthusiasm. He’s playful without being over the top and knows how to enjoy both active moments and relaxed downtime. Blaze also gets along beautifully with other greys, making him a wonderful addition to a home with canine companions or regular doggy playdates. With his confident nature, affectionate personality, and easygoing social skills, Blaze is the kind of dog who brings warmth, fun, and companionship wherever he goes.

NAME: Ernie
TEXT: *Ernie has just got to foster - stay tuned for updates!* Meet Ernie! a sweet and quiet boy who is looking for a calm home where he can truly flourish. This handsome lad loves all the important things in life – tasty treats, fun toys, spending time with other dogs, and forming strong bonds with his favourite people. Once he feels comfortable, he enjoys being close to those he trusts and will reward your patience with plenty of affection and goofiness Ernie is looking for a family to call his own and would best suit an adult only family or a family with teens aged 16 and over. A home with a yard is preferrable so that he can he can have the space he needs to settle in He can be a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing unfamiliar situations, so he'll need a quiet, understanding home where he can settle in at his own pace. His ideal family will be willing to help build his confidence through gentle encouragement, positive experiences, and lots of reassurance. Ernie has shown that he can use stairs, loooves his bed and will even start to get the zoomies when he starts to show his personality. It will be a highly rewarding journey for whoever adopts our special boy Ernie. He loves lying on blankets in the garden, sitting in his shell pool and cuddling you once he knows you. Meet Ernie by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Tilly is a sweet and affectionate greyhound with a calm nature and a love for family life. A true water baby, she absolutely loves swimming in the dam and would thrive in a home where she can enjoy outdoor adventures and plenty of companionship. Tilly is polite and relaxed around other dogs, both big and small, and has experience living around farm animals, puppies, and children. Her gentle temperament and adaptable personality make her a wonderful candidate for a variety of homes. She loves affection, enjoys being close to her people, and responds well to her name when called. Tilly’s loving and easy-going nature shines through in everything she does, making her a beautiful companion both at home and out exploring. Tilly is now searching for a caring forever family who will cherish her kind heart, playful spirit, and love of life.

NAME: Nugget
TEXT: Nugget is an absolute goofball who is guaranteed to keep you smiling every single day! This fun-loving greyhound has a big personality and an even bigger love for life, he’s always ready to be right in the middle of whatever’s going on. Full of playful energy, Nugget thrives on interaction and loves being part of the action. Whether it’s a game, a walk, or just hanging out with his people, he’s happiest when he’s included. His silly antics and cheeky charm make him endlessly entertaining, and he’s always finding new ways to make you laugh. Despite his playful nature, Nugget also has a sweet side and enjoys spending time with his humans, soaking up attention and companionship. He’s the kind of dog who brings joy, laughter, and a whole lot of personality into the home. If you’re looking for a fun, lively companion who will keep life exciting and full of love, Nugget is your guy

NAME: Betty
TEXT: True to her name, Beautiful Betty is an absolute delight, inside and out. This gorgeous greyhound is bursting with love, joy, and a personality that lights up every room she enters. Betty has a zest for life that’s simply infectious. Whether she’s doing happy zoomies, exploring her surroundings, or soaking up attention from her favorite humans, she approaches each day with enthusiasm and charm. Her affectionate nature means she’s always ready for cuddles, leaning gently in for pats and sharing her sweet, loving presence. She thrives on connection and will quickly become the heart of any home. Betty’s warmth, playful spirit, and gentle soul make her the perfect companion for someone looking for a dog who brings both fun and comfort in equal measure.

NAME: Sue
TEXT: Meet Sue, a gorgeous 6-year-old black greyhound with a gentle soul and the sweetest little tail wag. This lovely middle-aged lady enjoys quiet exploring, friendly sniffs with other greyhounds, and slowly warming up to her people once she feels comfortable. Sue walks beautifully on lead and has a calm, easy-going nature, though loud environments can make her a little unsure. She’s friendly with other greyhounds and has shown manageable behaviour around small dogs, but she is not suitable for a home with cats. Sue is currently uncomfortable with crates and may need patience and reassurance with transport and confinement. With her soft nature and adorable personality, she’ll make a lovely companion for someone looking for a sweet and gentle best friend. Meet Sue at Western Sydney.

NAME: Fin
TEXT: Fin is a gorgeous girl looking for a calm, secure home to call her own. She can be quite shy when she first meets you but she responds beautifully to gentle encouragement, comes when called, and gradually relaxes over time. Fin is friendly with big and small dogs, walks lightly on lead, enjoying a sniff around gently and quietly. Once she warms up she likes to do zoomies and likes toys and treats.
