She is affectionate with other dogs big and small, greeting them softly and politely. Her best suited doggie pal is a medium to large breed. Due to her sensitive nature, she would be best suited to a quieter home without young children. With patience and reassurance, this lovely girl has all the makings of a gentle, perfect greyhound to be your new best friend. Meet Fin at Western Sydney.

NAME: Wanda
TEXT: Wanda is a gorgeous girl full of plenty of excitement. Pretty girl Wanda is friendly with other greyhounds, though a calm and tolerant companion would suit her best as she has a vibrant streak when around other dogs. She just wants to have fun with them! Being middle aged she is a perfect blend of calm, perky, but laid back when she needs to be. She is also suitable as a solo pet with shorter hours alone at the start of her pet journey. This gorgeous girl is full of love and can't wait to become a pet. If you have a small fully fenced garden, another dog her size, or older fun loving kids for this playful outgoing girl, get in touch with Western Sydney!

NAME: Bullet
TEXT: Meet Bullet — a very social greyhound with a friendly, easygoing nature and a love for being part of the action. With medium energy levels, he’s well suited to an active lifestyle, happily joining in on daily walks, outings, and family routines while still knowing how to relax at home. Bullet has been living in a house environment over the past two months and has adapted well to home life. He’s also been interacting with children, showing a comfortable and sociable temperament that makes him a great candidate for a family setting. With his outgoing personality and balanced energy, Bullet is a wonderful companion for those looking for a dog who can keep up with an active routine while also enjoying downtime surrounded by his people.

NAME: Kirra
TEXT: Meet Kirra — a gentle, small black greyhound with a quietly curious soul. At first, she can be a little reserved, taking her time to understand new surroundings and build trust. Kirra would benefit from some continued training and patient guidance to help her grow in confidence and truly come out of her shell. Once she feels safe and comfortable, though, Kirra’s personality begins to shine. She reveals a playful, fun-loving side that’s full of charm and warmth. Whether it’s engaging in a game, exploring her environment, or simply sharing a moment with her person, Kirra brings a sweet and joyful energy that makes her incredibly special. With the right support and a loving home, Kirra has all the makings of a loyal, affectionate companion who will reward patience with endless moments of connection and delight.

NAME: Bob (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Not only is this blue fawn boy an absolute stunner, but he has an incredible personality to match! Meet Bob the 5-year-old greyhound! Bob is an outgoing and confident boy who would be a great match for someone looking for an adventure buddy. He loves a good walk and is amazing at walking on the longline, making him a fantastic and easy walking partner. Bob also LOVES his toys and will gladly trade out a walk for a play session in the backyard if you don't feel like going out some days! He is a very intelligent and food-driven boy and has picked up early training quickly, having already mastered longline recall, "down", "off" and is working on a few more fun cues! Bob is quite happy to spend the day alone and is suitable for full-time workers, as long as you are willing to spend some quality time with him and make up some enrichment activities before heading off for the day. Bob is friendly with other medium-large dogs and would be suitable for hanging out regularly with canine friends, but would prefer to live as the only dog in the home so he can have all the treats, toys and love to himself. Older kids/teens are also suitable, but a home without young children is best. We just know Bob is going to make the best companion! He is waiting for you at our Western Sydney Kennels.

NAME: Pete
TEXT: Pete is a gentle boy who is social and fun. He plays well with young kids, he knows his name and comes when called. Pete can do stairs and likes playing with toys. You would never feel lonely with Pete in your life.

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: ** Poppy is currently in foster-care** Poppy is a gentle, goofy girl who’s stealing hearts while living her best foster life with a golden retriever buddy. She’s incredibly well-mannered, toilet trained, and even knows her basic commands – she’ll sit, lay down, and patiently wait for the go-ahead before eating. What a superstar! This gorgeous girl loves snuggles, going for walks, and being around her people. She’s got a curious nature and thrives on companionship, both human and canine. Poppy would do best in a home with another friendly dog to keep her company and help her continue building confidence. She has no problems with resource guarding and doesn't mind sharing her food and toys. While she’s mostly chill, Poppy does get a little sooky when you leave the house – but she settles down pretty quickly. Ideal Home: A secure backyard with fencing (a must for this curious girl!) Another friendly dog would be a bonus No cats or staffys, please An active lifestyle – she loves walks and adventures A home where someone is around a bit more often than not

NAME: Shadow (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Hello, I have just gone to foster care! I'll have some updates soon!* Little 3 year old girl Shadow can't wait to meet you! This adorable, 3-year-old girl is new to pet life and can be a little nervous at first. She is an active and curious greyhound who is learning about the world around her. Out and about, she enjoys exploring her surroundings, happily sniffing, investigating, and showing an interest in everything going on around her. A house with a backyard would be a great fit so she can retreat if needed. A home with another medium/large dog would suit her too. She has a fun, playful side and will happily chase after toys, showing off her light, bouncy side when she’s feeling excited. With people, she is shy but friendly and we are sure she will blossom into a perfect pet. A home with older kids is best as she has her shy moments. She is most relaxed around other greyhounds, happy to move along without fuss. With her playful energy, curiosity, and friendly nature, this girl is ready to become a fun and engaging companion in her new home. Meet sweet little Shadow at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jack (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Jack is a gentle, shy and thoughtful greyhound. He will meet you with a gentle wagging tail, with polite manners and will lean in for love. Once he knows you he warms up quickly. He’s been seen carrying toys around and is happy to explore what’s around him which we think is so sweet. He would suit a house with a courtyard to backyard size outdoor area to roam around. Jack has previously been around children aged 12 and 7 and has also spent time around a Labrador, showing he can live alongside kids and other dogs when interactions are calm and respectful. With other greyhounds he’s easygoing with a quick sniff and move on, he responds well to recall and could improve further with training and exposure. Jack is a sweet gentle boy who would love to meet you. Ps did we mention he has an adorable overbite?! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Benny (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Whether it's posing for photos or playing with toys, Benny has an amazing personality he can't wait to share with you. He has continued to embrace training, responding very well to positive reinforcement techniques. His ideal home would be one who enjoys an active dog, who enjoys engaging in play (eg toys!) and structured routines. His food drive is high which makes him easily motivated but boundaries around human items is best. Overall, he is a lovely, resilient, and confident boy who always gets the excited wiggles whenever he sees staff at the centre. He loves food BUT! He loves toys more, and is a very motivated and eager to please type boy. He engages with enrichment like a champ, showing off his skills as he works through puzzle toys and snuffle mats, keeping him entertained while you're gone. He can coexist nicely with other greyhounds and can be rehomed along side one, but doesn't seem to need a dog friend in his life and would be comfortable as a solo pet. A home without young kids would suit Benny as he does like to check out what treats or toys might be in your hands! A quieter suburb with space for him to run around would be perfect. Benny dreams of a townhouse/backyard with an outdoor area, and would be happy to show you his skills on staircases if you have stair access. As a solo pet, shorter hours alone at the start are best as he learns resilience. Meet this handsome boy at Western Sydney.

NAME: Pb
TEXT: PB is a distinguished gentleman with a wonderful zest for life. He carries himself with a calm confidence but still has plenty of enthusiasm for getting out and about, making him a great match for someone who enjoys an active lifestyle. He would be best suited to a home with a yard where he can stretch his legs and enjoy the outdoors, balanced with time spent relaxing alongside his people. PB brings a lovely mix of maturity and energy—happy to join in on adventures, then settle in like the true gentleman he is. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who appreciates both activity and downtime, PB could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Polly
TEXT: Polly is a gentle greyhound who just needs a little time and patience to show her true self. She can feel unsure around new people and unfamiliar surroundings, so she’ll do best with an understanding adopter who’s willing to let her settle in at her own pace. With kindness and consistency, Polly gradually builds her confidence—and when she does, it’s incredibly rewarding to see her personality shine. She becomes engaging, affectionate, and enjoys connecting with her people in her own sweet way. For someone willing to give her that extra time and reassurance, Polly will blossom into a loyal and loving companion.

NAME: Star
TEXT: Star is a bright, playful greyhound with a confident and social nature that makes him an instant favourite wherever he goes. He thrives on interaction and enjoys being part of the action, whether that’s playtime, walks, or simply hanging out with his people. Adaptable and easygoing, Star would fit well into just about any home environment. His confidence helps him settle in quickly, and his friendly personality means he’s always ready to make new friends. He also knows his own name and responds well, which is a great foundation for further training. With his cheerful energy and affectionate side, Star is the kind of companion who brings fun, warmth, and loyalty into everyday life.

NAME: Albatross
TEXT: Albo is a charming boy who likes to stretch his legs in the yard, he has been living in a rural environment surrounded by native and domestic animals. He is happy to be left alone and plays well with children. Intelligent and active he would make the perfect training partner. He is not only handsome but is eager to please and would excel in a dog sport such as sprint dogs, agility or even fly ball with the correct training and acclimation.

NAME: Guthro
TEXT: Meet Guthro 🐾 Guthro is a handsome black greyhound with a gentle, affectionate nature and a wonderfully endearing personality. At five years old, he is a calm, people-focused boy who thrives on connection and companionship. Guthro walks nicely on lead and is easy to go along with, happily moving with you while also taking time to follow interesting scents and explore his surroundings. He enjoys a good sniff and has a playful side, occasionally enjoying little bursts of energy and zoomies. He is very human-oriented and loves affection, often leaning in for pats and happily soaking up attention. Guthro forms strong bonds with his people and enjoys being close, showing a soft and trusting nature. He is also comfortable being handled and is easy to interact with in a calm, gentle way. Guthro is social and relaxed around other greyhounds, particularly enjoying the company of calm dogs. He is also known to enjoy the company of female dogs and generally settles well in social settings when things are calm and balanced. He would suit a home where he can form a close bond with his people, ideally with someone who enjoys a loyal, affectionate companion. Guthro is well suited to a relaxed household where he can enjoy both cuddle time and gentle daily walks, and he will thrive with someone looking for a true “one-person style” bond. With his loving nature, soft personality, and playful charm, Guthro is a very special boy ready to become a deeply devoted companion.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Meet Penny 🐾 Penny is a beautiful black greyhound with a bright, friendly personality and a lovely zest for life. At just over three years old, she is a confident and social girl who brings warmth and enthusiasm wherever she goes. Penny is very comfortable on lead and enjoys her walks, moving along with a happy, wagging tail as she explores the world around her. She is curious and engaged in new environments, happily sniffing and taking everything in while remaining relaxed and easygoing. She is highly people-oriented and loves human interaction, happily soaking up pats, cuddles, and attention. Penny has a very affectionate and engaging nature, making her a joyful companion who thrives on connection. Penny is social with other greyhounds and travels well alongside them. She has a generally easygoing approach to her surroundings and is a confident, adaptable young dog. She would suit a loving and active home that can enjoy her friendly, outgoing nature and include her as part of daily life. Penny is well suited to family environments and has experience being handled by children. She will thrive with people who appreciate a sociable, affectionate dog who enjoys being part of the action. With her sweet temperament, confidence, and love of people, Penny is a truly delightful companion ready to bring happiness and energy to her new home.

NAME: Spud
TEXT: Meet Spud 🐾 Spud is a striking black greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger zest for life. At just over three and a half years old, he is an energetic, confident, and affectionate boy who brings enthusiasm and joy wherever he goes. Spud is a very social and people-focused dog who loves interaction and is always excited to say hello. He is bouncy, engaging, and full of personality, often greeting people with happy enthusiasm and a wagging tail. On lead, he is strong and lively, enjoying his walks with plenty of energy and curiosity, and will thrive with someone who enjoys an active lifestyle. He is highly confident in new environments, happily sniffing, exploring, and taking everything in stride. Spud also travels well and enjoys the company of other greyhounds, showing friendly and social behaviour when out and about with his peers. Spud has a skin sensitivity that may require occasional management, particularly during wetter seasons, but he is otherwise in good health with a lovely coat and bright, clear eyes. He will suit an active home that can match his energy and enthusiasm, where he can enjoy plenty of exercise, structure, and positive engagement. Spud may be too enthusiastic for smaller animals, so a pet-free home or one experienced with managing high-energy dogs would be ideal. With his affectionate nature, playful spirit, and boundless enthusiasm, Spud is a truly lovable companion who will bring fun, energy, and plenty of personality to the right home.

NAME: Apple
TEXT: Apple 🐾 is a vibrant black greyhound with a big personality and an even bigger love for life. At just over three and a half years old, she is full of energy, confidence, and enthusiasm, bringing a fun and lively presence wherever she goes. Apple is an outgoing and social girl who absolutely adores people. She greets the world with a wagging tail and a joyful, bouncy attitude, always ready to say hello and be part of the action. On lead, she is confident and eager, enjoying her walks with plenty of excitement and curiosity as she takes in her surroundings. She thrives in new environments, happily exploring, sniffing, and engaging with everything around her. Apple also gets along well with other greyhounds and larger dogs, travelling comfortably alongside them and showing relaxed, friendly behaviour. She has shown a positive, manageable interest in smaller dogs, responding well and remaining engaged and happy. At home, Apple will suit an active household that can embrace her zest for life and continue to guide her as she channels her enthusiasm. She would love owners who enjoy getting out and about and can provide both physical activity and mental enrichment to keep her happy and fulfilled. With her confident nature, affectionate personality, and playful spirit, Apple is a wonderfully engaging companion who will bring energy, fun, and plenty of smiles to the right home.

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Meet Jett 🐾 Jett is a striking black greyhound with a sensitive nature and a gentle soul. At nearly four years old, Jett is still building his confidence and will truly flourish in the right supportive home. Jett is a thoughtful boy who is very aware of his surroundings and benefits from a calm, predictable environment. Once he has time to settle, he shows his softer side and begins to relax, taking comfort in routine and familiarity. He travels well and has lovely manners around food and his belongings, making him an easy companion in day-to-day life. He enjoys the company of other greyhounds and larger dogs, where he feels comfortable and at ease. Jett would benefit from a confident canine companion or a home that can continue to gently build his confidence at his own pace. With patience and understanding, he will continue to grow into a more relaxed and secure dog. Jett would be best suited to a quiet, low-traffic home with owners who can provide a calm and consistent environment. He will thrive with people who are happy to give him the time and space he needs to settle in and feel safe. A home without small pets or young children is recommended. With kindness, patience, and a steady routine, Jett has all the potential to become a deeply loyal and rewarding companion.

NAME: Boof
TEXT: 🐾Meet Boof 🐾 A handsome black greyhound with a calm, gentle presence and an independent streak. At just over four years old, he has settled into a relaxed and confident nature, taking life in stride and enjoying things at his own easy pace. Boof is a lovely walking companion, moving beautifully on lead and taking in the world with quiet curiosity. He enjoys a gentle sniff and explore, all while remaining composed and unbothered by his surroundings. At home, Boof is very comfortable in his own company and is happiest simply sharing space with you, making him a wonderful match for those who appreciate a more laid-back, undemanding companion. He adapts well to new situations, travels comfortably, and shows lovely manners around food. Boof also socialises nicely with other greyhounds and larger dogs, displaying relaxed and easygoing behaviour. Boof would be well suited to a calm household, including apartment living, where he can enjoy a peaceful routine of short walks and plenty of rest. He’ll thrive with owners who value a low-maintenance, independent dog. With a little guidance around smaller pets, Boof will make a gentle, quietly rewarding companion.

NAME: Kaique
TEXT: This young boy is very handsome, extremely friendly and affectionate. He is great company, good around young kids and social with other hounds. He would make a great family addition.

NAME: Ned
TEXT: Ned is a pleasant young hound. He did not race and has always been destined for pet life. He may come across shy at first however he warms up quickly and is great company. Ned has previously displayed some signs of not enjoying being on his own without other dogs or people for company and thus would suit a home with another medium to large sized dog to play with. Some of his favorite activities include playing with Kongs and Licky matts, puzzle toys, munching on frozen carrots and being with his friends.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Meet Gus – a laid-back, affectionate greyhound with a love for the simple pleasures in life. Gus is a friendly, easy-going boy who takes everything in his stride. He has a calm, chilled nature and is happiest when he’s by your side, soaking up attention and enjoying a good pat. His affectionate personality makes him a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal and loving friend. One of Gus’s favourite things is a car ride – he’s always keen to hop in and join you on an adventure, whether it’s a quick trip or a longer outing. At home, he’d love nothing more than his own comfy couch to stretch out on, along with a yard where he can have a play and enjoy some fresh air. Gus is the kind of dog who fits easily into a home, bringing a relaxed and loving presence wherever he goes. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate boy to share your days with, Gus could be just the one.

NAME: Harvey
TEXT: Harvey is a handsome male greyhound who is nearly 6 years old and has a wonderfully cruisy, easy-going nature. He takes life in his stride and settles quickly into new environments, making him a very adaptable companion. Harvey is polite and relaxed around small dogs, showing a calm and easy-going attitude when meeting them. He enjoys getting out and about, especially if it involves a car ride, which he absolutely loves. On warmer days, Harvey likes to cool down by dipping his paws in water – a simple pleasure that suits his laid-back personality. At home, he’s happiest relaxing on his bed and enjoying the comforts of a quiet space. With his gentle nature and relaxed outlook, Harvey would make a wonderful addition to a home looking for a calm, easy companion to share life’s everyday moments.

NAME: Boondy
TEXT: Boondy is a calm, cuddly boy who has been described as an all-round great dog and a lovely companion. He thrives on human connection and would much rather spend his time with his people than anything else. He enjoys the water and isn’t one to pass up the chance for a dip in a pool, making him a fun addition to a home that enjoys relaxed outdoor time. Boondy has been socialised with small dogs and, while he was happy to say hello, he showed little interest beyond that, preferring the company of humans. He loves getting out for a walk, though he can be a little strong on the lead at times, so he would suit a confident person who can continue to guide him. With his gentle nature and affectionate personality, Boondy is ready to find a home where he can be loved, included, and enjoy the simple things in life.

NAME: Flynn
TEXT: Meet Flynn 🐾 Flynn is a handsome young blue greyhound with a gentle nature and a big love for people. At just over two years old, he’s at a wonderful stage of life where he’s ready to leave his racing days behind and settle into a relaxed, loving home. He’s a happy, smoochy and social boy who truly enjoys human company, happily leaning in for pats and attention whenever he gets the chance. Flynn is a confident and easygoing dog who enjoys exploring his surroundings and having the occasional burst of playful zoomies before settling down again. He has a lovely balance of playfulness and calm, making him an easy companion to have around the home. He also travels very well, remaining relaxed and content in both the car and crate, which will make outings and trips with him an enjoyable experience. He can be a little strong on the lead to begin with, but he settles quickly and walks along well, and with some ongoing guidance and consistency he will continue to improve. Flynn gets along well with other greyhounds and would likely do well either as an only dog soaking up all the attention, or in a home with another medium to large, calm canine companion. Flynn would thrive in a loving home where he can be part of the family, with access to a secure yard for the occasional zoomies and owners who can continue to guide him as he transitions into pet life. With his affectionate personality, relaxed nature and willingness to engage, Flynn is a lovely young greyhound who will make a loyal and rewarding companion.

NAME: Amber
TEXT: Amber is a stunning quiet girl, she is sweet and affectionate, has lived around kids and has also had exposure to domestic and native animals. She also shares her space well with the other hounds.

NAME: Hanno
TEXT: Meet Hanno - your gentle giant with the softest soul 💛 Hanno is a big, beautiful boy with an even bigger heart. True to his gentle nature, he absolutely adores people and will happily rest his head on your lap for pats, cuddles, and all the love you can give. He has a sweet, easygoing temperament and is just as happy playing with his toys as he is lounging around and soaking up a quiet moment with you. Whether it’s a little playtime or a lazy afternoon on the couch, Hanno is simply content being by your side. If you’re looking for a calm, affectionate companion Hanno might just be your perfect match 🐾

NAME: Archie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Archie Archie is a confident and curious greyhound who enjoys getting out and exploring the world around him. On walks, he is easy to handle, happily moving along at a relaxed pace while taking in all the sights and smells. He’s a friendly boy who will say hello and enjoys attention, though he’s just as content following his nose and exploring his surroundings. Archie has a more independent nature, making him a great match for someone who appreciates a dog that enjoys both company and doing his own thing. Archie travels calmly and has shown himself to be relaxed in new environments, taking everything in stride. Archie would be best suited to a home without small dogs or cats, where he can feel comfortable and focus on his walks and daily routine. If you’re looking for a laid-back, independent greyhound who enjoys exploring and living life at his own pace, Archie could be a great addition to your home.

NAME: Elvis
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Elvis Elvis is a happy, confident greyhound who brings a fun and enthusiastic energy to everything he does. He enjoys getting out and about, approaching the world with curiosity and excitement, always keen to explore what’s around him. On walks, Elvis can be strong on lead at times, especially when something catches his interest, but he settles into the outing and enjoys a good wander. He’s an engaging companion who likes to be part of the action and see what’s going on. Elvis is very people-friendly and loves affection. He’ll happily come up for pats, wagging his tail and staying close to soak up the attention. He’s also been around children and has shown a positive, social nature. He travels calmly and is comfortable in new environments, taking things in stride while still enjoying the excitement of getting out and about. Elvis would benefit from a home that can continue to guide him on lead and support his enthusiasm. Elvis would be best suited to a home without small dogs or cats, where he can comfortably enjoy his surroundings and focus on his adventures. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate greyhound who enjoys being out and about and loves a good cuddle, Elvis could be a great match.

NAME: Rhino
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Rhino Rhino is a confident and independent greyhound with a calm, relaxed demeanour. On walks, he enjoys exploring at his own pace and can be a little strong on lead, showing his enthusiasm for new sights and smells. He approaches the world with curiosity, sniffing and investigating everything around him with quiet confidence. Rhino is an independent thinker who loves to explore and take in his surroundings. He enjoys pats and attention when it’s offered, and is happiest when allowed to discover the world at his own pace. Rhino is a calm and easy-going companion who adjusts well to new environments. He’s happy to share space with small dogs, giving them plenty of room while he goes about his own relaxed explorations. If you’re looking for an independent, confident greyhound who enjoys gentle walks, quiet exploration, and a relaxed lifestyle, Rhino could be a great companion to share your home and adventures with.

NAME: Libby
TEXT: Libby is a gorgeous girl with a playful spirit and the sweetest nature. She loves having fun, whether that’s zooming around the yard or sharing gentle moments with her people. Libby is especially comfortable around other medium to large dogs and enjoys their company, making her a great match for a home with larger canine friends. True to her cheerful personality, Libby has a cheeky habit of jumping up when she gets excited, it’s her way of saying hello and showing how happy she is to see you. With a little guidance, this enthusiasm will easily turn into beautifully polite greetings. Affectionate, lively, and full of charm, Libby is sure to bring laughter, love, and plenty of tail wags to her forever home.

NAME: Hunter
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Hunter 🐾 Hunter is a lovely, easy‑going greyhound who is ready to find his forever home. He has been well socialised with children as young as 2 years old and would suit a home with polite, dog‑savvy kids who understand how to interact respectfully with dogs. Hunter loves getting out and about and enjoys his daily walks. He walks nicely on lead and is inquisitive without being overwhelming, making him a pleasure to handle. He also has a fun side — especially when water is involved — and happily splashes around whenever he gets the chance! He gets along well with other dogs and would be happy living with a canine companion or as an only dog with regular social interaction. Overall, Hunter is an adaptable, relaxed, and friendly boy who will settle easily into a range of home environments. Hunter is looking for a home where he can enjoy his walks, spend time with his people, and be included as part of the family.

NAME: Digger
TEXT: Meet Digger, a playful and confident 5-year-old greyhound who loves being part of the action. Digger is an energetic and friendly boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings and having fun while staying responsive and easy to manage. He’s confident, playful, and happy to come when called. He’s affectionate and loves a pat, often seeking out attention from his humans. On lead, Digger is excitable but controllable, making walks enjoyable for those who like a happy, lively companion. He travels well in the car and is relaxed during outings. Digger gets along well with other greyhounds and has been exposed to small dogs on his property, showing no interest in them. With his confident, playful nature and love for pats, Digger is ready to join a loving home and bring joy every day.

NAME: Dixon
TEXT: Meet Dixon, a sweet black greyhound with a calm and gentle personality. Dixon is a relaxed and easygoing boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings at his own pace. He’s confident but calm, taking new environments in stride and happy to sniff around while staying composed. He’s affectionate and approachable, happily coming over when called and enjoying quiet attention. Dixon gets along well with other greyhounds and shows no interest in small dogs, preferring to keep his own space. On lead, Dixon is well-mannered and relaxed, making walks enjoyable. He also travels calmly in the car. Dixon would thrive in a home where he can enjoy a calm, stable environment, with people who appreciate his gentle and easygoing nature.

NAME: Duke
TEXT: Meet Duke, a stand out greyhound with a laid-back personality and a heart of gold. Duke is the definition of an easygoing companion. Often described as a bit of a “dude,” he takes life in stride with a relaxed, happy attitude. He enjoys having a sniff and a wander but is just as content to cruise along and take things slow. He’s friendly and approachable, happily coming up for pats and enjoying quiet affection. Duke has a calm, gentle presence that makes him a lovely dog to have around the home. On lead, Duke is relaxed and easy to handle, walking along without fuss. He travels well and remains calm in the car, making outings simple and stress-free. Duke is social with other greyhounds and truly stands out for his incredibly calm nature around small dogs, making him a great candidate for homes with smaller canine companions. If you’re looking for a chilled, low-maintenance companion with a sweet and gentle nature, Duke could be your perfect match.

NAME: Cracker
TEXT: Meet Cracker, a handsome 7-year-old greyhound with a big personality and a love for people. Cracker is a confident and cheerful boy who enjoys getting out and about, happily exploring his surroundings with a wagging tail and a bouncy, upbeat attitude. He brings a fun energy to his walks and loves being part of the action. He’s incredibly people-focused and engaging, often approaching for pats and happily sticking around to soak up the attention. Cracker thrives on interaction and would make a wonderful companion for someone who enjoys a social and affectionate dog. Cracker walks well on lead and travels nicely in the car, making him an easy addition to day-to-day life. He’s confident in new environments and takes everything in stride. He gets along well with other big dogs and has previously been around small dogs in a home environment. However, he can become very overexcited, so he would be best suited to a home without small pets where he can remain calm and comfortable. If you’re looking for a confident, affectionate, and fun-loving companion who will keep you company and bring a bit of joy to your day, Cracker could be the perfect match.

NAME: Frankie
TEXT: Meet Frankie, a fun-loving greyhound with a happy personality and a playful spark. Frankie is a confident and easygoing boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings, happily sniffing and taking everything in. While he’s generally calm and relaxed, he also has a playful side and loves the occasional burst of zoomies, adding a bit of joy and energy to his day. He’s a friendly and approachable dog who will come over with a wagging tail to say hello and enjoy a pat. Frankie has a lovely nature and strikes a great balance between being affectionate and independent. On lead, Frankie is confident and responsive, walking nicely without pulling and happy to slip straight into a walk. He travels well and remains calm in the car, making him an easy companion for outings. Frankie gets along well with other greyhounds and shows calm, friendly behaviour around small dogs. If you’re looking for a cheerful, well-mannered companion with a playful streak and a friendly nature, Frankie could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Dave
TEXT: Meet Dave, a handsome greyhound with a confident nature and a friendly, easygoing personality. Dave is a relaxed and happy boy who enjoys getting out and about, exploring his surroundings with a wagging tail and curious nose. He takes new environments in his stride and brings a calm confidence to everything he does. He’s an affectionate companion who will happily come over for pats and enjoys spending time with his people. Dave has a lovely balance of independence and friendliness, making him an easy dog to have around. On lead, Dave is confident and can be strong at times, but he responds well to guidance and settles nicely with consistent handling. He travels well and is relaxed in the car, making him a great companion for outings and adventures. Dave has great social skills and gets along well with other big dogs. He has also lived with small dogs and showed calm, friendly behaviour during assessment, making him a fantastic option for homes with smaller canine companions. If you’re looking for a confident, friendly, and well-rounded companion who will enjoy both exploring the world and relaxing by your side, Dave could be the perfect match.

NAME: Holly
TEXT: Meet Holly, a beautiful 3.5-year-old greyhound with a bright, happy personality and a love for life. Holly is a confident and cheerful girl who approaches everything with enthusiasm. She loves to explore her surroundings, happily sniffing and taking it all in, while remaining calm and self-assured in new environments. She is incredibly people-focused and full of joy, when you call her name, she’ll come bounding over with a wagging tail, ready for pats and attention. Her affectionate and playful nature makes her a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loving and interactive dog. Holly walks well on lead with a confident, happy attitude and travels beautifully, even hopping into the car on her own. She’s an easy dog to take along on outings and will happily join in whatever you’re doing. She gets along well with other greyhounds and shows curiosity in small dogs. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate, and confident companion who will greet you with excitement and brighten your day, Holly could be the perfect match.

NAME: Albert
TEXT: Meet Albert, a gentle and people-loving greyhound who is ready to settle into a relaxed home life. Albert has already had a taste of home living and absolutely thrives in it. He enjoys trips to the beach, loves a splash in the water, and is happiest when he’s close to his people. Affection is his favourite thing, he’ll happily come over for pats, respond to his name, and stay nearby to soak up all the attention he can get. He is a calm and easygoing boy who travels well and walks beautifully on lead without pulling. In new environments, Albert is relaxed and confident, enjoying a quiet explore but always happiest when he can check back in with his humans. Albert gets along well with other greyhounds and shows good general manners. He can be unsure around small dogs, particularly if they enter his personal space. He would be best in a home where he gets to soak up all the attention. If you’re looking for a loyal, affectionate companion who will stick by your side, join you on outings, and happily relax with you at home, Albert could be the perfect match.

NAME: Sean
TEXT: Meet Sean, a handsome 3.5-year-old greyhound with a calm, confident nature and a quietly affectionate personality. Sean is an easygoing boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings at a relaxed pace. He’s confident in new environments and takes everything in stride, happily sniffing and observing the world around him without becoming overwhelmed. While he may not be overly demanding of attention, Sean will happily come up for a pat and enjoys gentle affection. He has a lovely, independent streak balanced with a sweet, approachable nature. On lead, Sean can be a little eager at first, but he settles quickly and walks along nicely once he’s into the rhythm. He travels well and remains calm, making him a good companion for everyday life. Sean is relaxed around both large and small dogs and is happy to quietly go about his own business. If you’re looking for a relaxed, low-maintenance companion with a gentle nature and a quiet confidence, Sean could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Johnny
TEXT: This boy is inquisitive and affectionate, great with young kids and social with other hounds. Lives around farm animals and wasn't bothered by the cat living on the property.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: This pretty boy is confident and inquisitive, he likes playing in the yard and going on walks. He has been with small kids his whole life and is very gentle and obedient with them. He has had exposure to farm animals and some natives.

NAME: Marley
TEXT: This young gent has grown up around farm animals with visits from local natives. Has small children around daily helping with his daily routine. Gorgeous boy.

NAME: Yazzi
TEXT: This dynamic girl is very social and confident, she has had exposure to farm animals and the odd visit from the local native critters. Since she is so confident and social she would adjust to many different lifestyles.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Meet Lucy, a joyful and affectionate 5-year-old greyhound who is ready to find her forever home. Lucy is full of personality and absolutely adores people. She thrives on human interaction and will happily seek out attention, often greeting you with excited little jumps and a constantly wagging tail. Her enthusiasm for life is contagious, she truly “loves everything” and brings a bright, happy energy wherever she goes. She travels beautifully, showing a relaxed and positive attitude around vehicles, and walks well on lead with manageable excitement. Lucy is confident in new environments and takes everything in stride, making her an easy companion to bring along on daily adventures. Lucy would suit a home where she has plenty of company, as she forms strong bonds with her people and doesn’t enjoy being left alone for long periods. She will thrive in a household that can give her the attention and companionship she craves. While Lucy is friendly with other greyhounds and larger dogs, her excitement can be a bit much for smaller dogs, so she would be best suited to a home without small pets. She’s a loving, lively girl who just needs the right family to share her big heart with. If you’re looking for a happy, people-loving companion who will greet you like you’re the best part of her day, Lucy might be your perfect match.

NAME: Skippy
TEXT: Meet Skippy, the greyhound who never quite figured out he isn’t a kangaroo. With springs for legs and joy in his heart, Skippy bounds everywhere he goes, whether he’s leaping across the yard, bouncing into your arms, or boinging from room to room just to say hello. This super-friendly boy is the embodiment of good vibes. He greets every human like a long‑lost friend, every dog like a potential playmate, and every day like the Best Day Ever. Skippy's tail wags with such enthusiasm it could almost power a small wind farm. Skippy brings sunshine, silliness, and a whole lot of love wherever he goes. If you're lucky enough to share life with him, get ready for bouncy greetings, warm snuggles, and endless joy.

NAME: Bart
TEXT: Bart is a handsome confident boy who prefers being a lone ranger. He is confident and happy on his own and not big on sharing his space with other animals. He is loyal and would make a perfect companion for someone who needs a low maintenance mate to keep them company at home.

NAME: Sandra
TEXT: Sandra is a sweet girl looking for a patient and understanding family to help her settle into life as a cherished pet. While she may need a little time to adjust to new surroundings and experiences, Sandra has all the potential to become a wonderful companion. Sandra is medium to large dog friendly and would benefit greatly from having a calm, confident canine companion in the home. A friendly resident dog could help show her the ropes and provide reassurance as she learns about family life. A quiet, calm home environment would suit Sandra best, allowing her to settle at her own pace. She would thrive in a home with a secure yard where she can stretch her legs, enjoy her favourite zoomies, and safely explore her surroundings. While the yard doesn't need to be large, Sandra enjoys having space to play and burn off energy. She thrives on companionship and would love a home where her family is around regularly to include her in daily life. Sandra will be happiest with adopters who can provide plenty of company, and are home often to provide affection, and opportunities to spend quality time together. As Sandra continues to navigate pet life, she would be best suited to a home with older, respectful children who can understand her need for patience and gentle interactions while she settles in. With kindness, consistency, and plenty of encouragement, Sandra is sure to blossom into a loyal and loving companion. If you're looking for a deserving dog to welcome into your family and help discover the joys of pet life, Sandra may be the perfect match. Come meet Sandra at Western Sydney Adoption Centre

NAME: Max
TEXT: Meet Max 🐾 Max is an energetic, fun-loving boy who’s always ready for action! He absolutely loves playtime and will happily keep himself (and you!) entertained with his toys and zoomies. Full of life and personality, Max brings a playful spark to every moment, but he also has a sweet, affectionate side and enjoys spending time with his humans. Max is the perfect mix of outgoing and loving. If you’re looking for a happycompanion who will keep you smiling, Max is your guy!

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Meet Jett 🖤 Jett is a confident, fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. He absolutely adores being around his humans and will happily follow you wherever you go, just to be part of the action. This cheeky boy loves his toys and is always up for a play, bringing a playful and energetic vibe into the home. Jett’s loving nature makes him a wonderful companion, whether it’s playtime or just relaxing by your side. If you’re looking for a loyal, affectionate, and entertaining best mate, Jett is your guy!

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a bold and spirited boy who brings a fun, lively energy wherever he goes. Full of personality, he loves to stretch his legs and show off his playful side with a good burst of zoomies. He’s a strong, active boy who will thrive in a home that enjoys getting out and about. Hank would suit someone who can match his enthusiasm. Behind his energetic nature is a sweet, loyal companion who enjoys being around his people and settling in once he’s had his fun. With the right home, Hank will be a rewarding and entertaining addition to the family 🐾

NAME: Phoenix
TEXT: Phoenix 🐾 Meet Phoenix, a confident and fun-loving boy with a big personality to match! This clever lad comes straight over when called, always eager to be part of the action. He absolutely loves his toys and brings a playful, energetic vibe wherever he goes. Phoenix is full of life but equally full of love - he thrives on attention and will happily soak up pats and affection from his people. With his bright nature and loyal heart, Phoenix would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a happy, active, and devoted best mate.

NAME: Gemma
TEXT: Meet Gemma Gemma is a sweet little girl with a beautiful nature and a cheeky personality to match. This lovely lady has a gentle heart but also a playful, fun side that will keep you smiling. Gemma loves being around people, though is also fine being on own. With her gorgeous looks and lovable personality, Gemma is sure to steal hearts wherever she goes. She would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a beautiful girl with a mix of sweetness and cheeky charm. 🐾

NAME: Chester
TEXT: Meet Chester a sweet and gentle boy who is looking for a loving home where he can truly shine. Chester has a calm and affectionate nature and enjoys being close to his people. He’s the kind of companion who will happily sit by your side, enjoying quiet moments and soaking up all the attention you can give. With his kind personality and loving heart, Chester would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal friend to share their days with. All he needs is a caring home where he can feel safe, loved, and part of the family.

NAME: Jess
TEXT: Jess is a lively and affectionate dog who loves getting out and about. She’s great on the lead and enjoys exploring with her people. Jess has a playful personality and absolutely loves to run around and have her zoomies when the mood strikes. She can be a little skittish around new or loud noises, so she would do best with a patient and experienced owner who can help her build confidence and feel secure. Jess has had good socialisation with a cattle dog and enjoys canine company when introductions are done properly. With the right home, guidance, and plenty of love, Jess will make a loyal and entertaining companion.

NAME: Muza
TEXT: Maza is a sweet and gentle girl . She can be a little shy at first and prefers to stick close to her favourite humans, but once she feels comfortable, her affectionate and playful side shines through. She gets along well with other dogs, both small and large, and enjoys joining in on gentle play. Maza travels well in the car and is very food-motivated, which makes training and bonding with her easy. Once she opens up, she’s full of fun and love, making her a loyal and delightful companion.

NAME: Ace (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Ace! I walk nicely on the lead and warm up after I get to know you. I like toys, and am described as friendly and calm. I would be happy to live with another dog after a meet and greet with them. As I can be shy, a dog who can help me come out of my shell could be a good match for me! As I have not experienced much of pet life yet, a home willing to take it nice and slow with me is best suited. A home with older/respectful kids would suit me best, as well as a house with a backyard for me to spend time in. Meet me at Western Sydney.

NAME: Thunder
TEXT: Thunder is a playful, funny, confident and friendly boy. He has an upbeat personality, and would love a home with toys, fun, and adventures! In his preperation to become a pet, he has learnt crate training, swimming in pools and dams, seen things like mowers, vehicles, and has been around kids 2-6 years old. He can be eager to get going on walks so a family who can walk a stronger dog is best suited. He could live with another doggie his size, however not a requirement. He is bouncy, friendly, and fun loving. A home with a backyard and shorter hours alone when he first settles in would be a great fit for Thunder. Meet Thunder at Western Sydney!

NAME: Patchy
TEXT: Hi, I’m Patchy — a young, gentle boy looking for a calm, nurturing home. I’d love a backyard where I can relax and have some quiet time, in a peaceful neighbourhood with a family who understands that I may take a little time to settle in. I’m naturally quiet and curious, and once I feel safe my sweet personality begins to shine. Because I’m a sensitive soul, a home without children or lots of hustle and bustle would suit me best. Meet me by appointment in Western Sydney. 🐾

NAME: Georgia
TEXT: Georgia is currently in foster care and has been for a couple of months, a message from her carer: Affectionately known as Scratty Snootles, Georgia is a gentle, sweet-natured greyhound who has spent the past eight weeks discovering all the best parts of pet life – comfy sofas, cosy snuggles, interesting sniffy walks, tasty sardines, and long naps in sunny spots. When Georgia first arrived in foster care, she was a very timid girl who found the big world a little overwhelming. With patience, kindness, and plenty of reassurance, she has slowly begun to blossom, revealing glimpses of her wonderfully quirky and endearing personality. Every day brings a little more confidence, and it has been a joy to watch her come out of her shell. Georgia will thrive with a family who understands that building trust takes time. She is looking for a calm, patient home where she can continue her journey at her own pace, supported by people who will celebrate the small wins along the way. Once she feels safe, her affectionate and playful side shines through. She has done well with her canine foster siblings following careful introductions and enjoys a quick burst of zoomies around the garden before settling in for a well-earned snooze. Curious and intelligent, Georgia loves exploring new places and walks beautifully on lead. She is also a big fan of car rides and is always happy to hop in for an adventure. Georgia would be best suited to a quiet, relaxed household where her people are home for much of the day. She is not suitable for a home with cats or chickens and would be happiest with respectful older children. Sweet, sensitive, and full of potential, Georgia is a truly special girl who is ready to find a family willing to give her the time and love she needs. In return, they'll gain the most loyal of companions and the privilege of watching this beautiful girl continue to flourish. 🩷🐾

NAME: Ferrari
TEXT: Don’t let her name fool you - Ferrari is a gentle, quiet girl with a soft and reserved nature. She may take a little time to come out of her shell, but with patience and love, her sweet personality truly begins to shine. Ferrari has a stunning black and white coat that makes her just as beautiful on the outside as she is on the inside. She would suit a calm home where she can settle at her own pace and build confidence in a safe, loving environment. With the right home Ferrari will be a loyal and affectionate companion who will quietly steal your heart 🐾

NAME: Stewy
TEXT: Stewy is a happy, excited boy who brings fun and energy wherever he goes! He’s playful, full of personality, and absolutely loves a good round of zoomies to burn off his enthusiasm. This lively lad enjoys engaging with his people and will happily come over for pats, attention, and of course — cuddles. After a burst of play, he’s more than ready to snuggle up and soak in the affection. Stewy would suit a home that enjoys an interactive, playful companion and is ready to embrace his joyful spirit. If you’re looking for a dog who will make you smile every single day, Stewy might just be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Licorice
TEXT: Licorice is a big, sooky boy with an even bigger heart. He absolutely loves being around his people and thrives on companionship, affection, and attention. If you’re looking for a loyal shadow who wants to be part of everything you do, Licorice is your guy. He enjoys an active lifestyle and will happily join you for walks and playtime, but his new family will need to be mindful of his leg and ensure his exercise is appropriate and not overly strenuous. A balanced routine that keeps him engaged without overdoing it will suit him best. Licorice can be prone to separation anxiety, so he would do best in a home where someone works from home or is around for much of the day. Alternatively, a well-matched female dog friend could help keep him company and build his confidence when left alone. Due to his size and excitability, Licorice would be best suited to a home with older children who can handle his enthusiasm and help maintain calm, consistent boundaries.

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Meet Tilly Sweet 💕 Tilly Sweet is a placid, gentle girl with a heart as soft as her name. She has a calm and loving nature, making her a wonderful companion for a family looking for a sweet and steady presence in their home. While Tilly may be a little timid when first meeting new people or entering a new environment, she warms up beautifully when given a calm, reassuring space to settle in. Once she feels comfortable, her playful side shines through — she absolutely loves a good zoomie around the yard and enjoys spending time playing with her favourite toys. Tilly would suit a semi-active household where she can enjoy both relaxed downtime and some fun bursts of activity. She’s treat motivated, which makes training a rewarding experience and a great way to continue building her confidence. She could be workable with a small dog companion and would do best with a slow, gentle introduction to a cat. Tilly is suitable for a home with children of all ages, especially in an environment where interactions are calm and respectful as she continues to grow in confidence.

NAME: Messi
TEXT: Messi is a confident, excitable and friendly boy. He would love a home with a yard where he can explore and smell all the interesting things in his new world. He enjoys time with people and would love a home that is willing to share adventures with him and continue teaching him about the best things in life. Messi would be happy to live with another dog who is happy to play and explore but also relax together. He enjoys going out for walks and would love to get some nice treats from a family ready to share their life with him. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Rocco
TEXT: *I have just gone into a foster home - stay tuned for updates* Update from Foster: "Overall, Rocco is doing really well and has settled in nicely. He is a very quiet, gentle and well-behaved boy. He enjoys being around people, especially my father, and always greets us when we come home. We’ve started taking him for a walk every morning and evening, he has settled into that routine really well. He enjoys spending time in the backyard and sometimes has a little run around. We left him at home for about two and a half hours for an appointment. He stayed inside the house and was fine. He was very happy to see us when we got home and came to greet us at the front door. Since he discovered treats, he waits very patiently on his bed until we give him one." Rocco is a sweet and affectionate gentleman who can be a little shy at first but quickly decides he wants to be your cuddle buddy. He is a gentle middle-aged boy who has spent time with children and other dogs who respectfully shared space with him. Rocco has been getting used to the daily grind, walking in busy park areas meeting people and seeing dogs but he would also love a quiet yard to laze around in the sun. Rocco would be best suited to a canine companion who is quiet and calm like he is and also would prefer to live with calm, older children. He would love someone home to settle him in and spend time with him getting him used to your world and helping him grow his confidence and show his sweet, affectionate nature. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Barney
TEXT: *Barney has just gone into a foster home - stay tuned for updates!* Updates from foster: "It’s only been a few days but Barney has settled in really well and is making great progress. Some of the things we’ve observed include: He is good with other dogs and respects their boundaries. He is initially shy and hesitant when meeting new people or in new environments, but he becomes comfortable quite quickly once given a little time. He is food motivated. He is learning to use stairs and is picking it up quickly. He is comfortable using a lift. He is a real velcro dog and loves affection and being close to his people. He sleeps well through the night. He walks well on lead when accompanied by another dog and appears to follow our greyhound Millie around a far bit. He loves playing with toys and enjoys chasing after them. He is a very good boy and super gentle. Having another greyhound I believe has been really helpful for him. He has been alone for 5 hours with another greyhound in the home and is becoming more comfortable and playful." If Barney's sweet and soulful eyes have caught your attention, keep reading to find out if you could be the perfect fit for our special guy, Barney. Barney is available to a home who can nurture a shy greyhound out of their shell. Barney requires a special home with a quiet lifestyle and a backyard with secure fencing where he can retreat to and enjoy the peace and quiet away from people when he needs it. A home without children is a must for our shy Barney, however a calm, wise and understanding dog of any size (small or large) would be a lovely companion to help him build his pet skills and help him adapt to his new life with his forever family. If you are someone who can provide a shy dog the structure, support, and ongoing confidence training that he needs to thrive as a pet, we'd love to hear from you. Barney is available for fostering or adoption by discussion with GAP team. We can't wait to hear from Barney's perfect family!

NAME: Leggy
TEXT: This handsome fellow is currently sharing a yard with another greyhound and spending time playing with a little Italian greyhound. He is very sweet and affectionate, loves to play and loves affection. Would be an excellent supervisor while your working in the yard.

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Luna is an energetic girl that enjoys a yard where she can cut loose in the morning and bust out some zoomies. Then like most greyhounds she's done, finished gone for the day and happy to cuddle up and relax. She shares a yard with Bubba and good left alone.

NAME: Malley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Malley! I've been learning lots of things about the world while I wait to be adopted. I am super friendly and will make a sensational first impression, if I do say so myself! I am very charming and think you will just love me! I know what a lounge is, how to navigate those weird things called "stairs", and have enjoyed spending time in an open crate, and spending time indoors, too. I'm a good traveller, I also love toys and treats and my handlers call me a big softie! I would prefer short hours alone as a solo pet and a slow intro to the big wide world as my horizons slowly expand as a pet with you. If you thought you might like a big affectionate softie like me simply reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre :)

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful active boy who loves to go on adventures max is suited to full time workers max loves older kids as he loves to play with toys and can sometimes forget his size with younger children. despite his energy max walks very well on lead max requires a larger fenced area to ensure he stays in the backyard all day as he can sometimes want to go and hang out around the neighbourhood. max is a clean and healthy boy and would suit your more active lifestyle

NAME: Lilo
TEXT: Lilo loves to feel the earth under her feet and be in the yard but she does also like affection and being close the ones she loves. She likes the water and cooling down on hot days. She will inspect new people she meets and will come around once she approves.

NAME: Stitch
TEXT: Stitch has lived around farm animals and native animals most of her life so she is unbothered by a lot of things. She may get excited but she calms down quite quickly. She is very confident and happy and would love a yard to look after.

NAME: Rapunzel
TEXT: Rapunzel loves any form of affection. She will come to you when called, she is confident and not bothered by much in life.

NAME: Geno
TEXT: Meet Geno, a sweet and happy boy who's sure to steal your heart with his wagging tail and bright eyes, as he loves nothing more than receiving pats from everyone he meets. Geno is a sociable pup who revels in the company of other dogs. His friendly demeanor means he'll quickly become a beloved member of any dog-friendly household. He's a fan of good meals and thoroughly enjoys his food. One of Geno's most endearing qualities is his love for the water. Geno loves to splash in his paddle pool and Geno is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a mix of play and relaxation. If you're looking for a sweet, happy dog who's as charming as he is friendly, Geno could be the perfect match for you. With Geno, every day is an opportunity for fun, affection, and shared experiences.

NAME: Dex
TEXT: Meet Dex, the strikingly handsome and robust canine companion who loves for water and has a zest for life, Dex is the ideal pet for those who appreciate an adventurous soul . Dex exudes strength and charm, preferring the company of larger dogs who match his playful energy and enthusiasm. Whether he's splashing around in a pool, pond, or simply enjoying a sunny day outdoors, Dex is happiest when he's with his big-sized friends. Toys are another passion of Dex's; he enjoys the simple pleasures of tug-of-war or a good game of fetch. His playful antics with his toys will surely keep you entertained. While he adores the companionship of big dogs, he prefers a home without small dogs to ensure everyone's comfort and harmony. Dex's energetic nature would thrive in a home with an active lifestyle, spacious yard, or access to dog-friendly outings. Embrace the adventure and heartwarming fun that Dex brings to every day. Are you ready to welcome a strong, water-loving, toy-enthusiast into your life.

NAME: Kota
TEXT: 🌸 Meet Kota - A Gentle Soul Looking for a Patient, Loving Home Kota is a very special girl with a soft heart and a sensitive spirit. She may take a little while to warm up, but once she trusts you, she forms deep, meaningful bonds that make every moment worth the wait. 💗 A Sensitive, Quiet Beauty Kota can feel a bit unsure in new environments, and she prefers to take things slowly. She’s not the kind of dog who rushes into new situations, she observes, thinks, and opens up at her own pace. But beneath that initial shyness is a truly affectionate, loyal companion. 🏡 Needs a Calm, Patient Home Kota will thrive in a warm, gentle, and patient household where she can feel safe and loved. She’ll do best with people who understand that trust takes time, and who are happy to give her the space and reassurance she needs to blossom.

NAME: Rodney
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Rodney 🐾 Rodney is a stunning black Greyhound with a cheeky sparkle in his eye, and a playful personality that's impossible to resist. Full of enthusiasm and always ready for his next adventure, Rodney brings plenty of joy wherever he goes. Behind all that playful energy is an affectionate boy who absolutely melts for pats and loves spending time with his favourite people. Confident and friendly, Rodney settles into new places with ease and is always happy to make new human friends. He greets people with a wagging tail and enjoys being close, whether it's joining you on a walk, exploring somewhere new, or relaxing together after a day of fun. Rodney loves getting out and about, making him a wonderful companion for someone who enjoys daily walks and sharing life's adventures. He can be a little eager when something exciting catches his attention, but he's quick to settle and is a delight to have by your side. He also travels beautifully, happily hopping into the car before settling down for the ride. Rodney dreams of being your one and only! While he's familiar with spending time around other Greyhounds, he'd be happiest in a home where he can enjoy all the love, cuddles, and attention for himself. He's ready to become your loyal shadow, best friend, and favourite adventure buddy. One of Rodney's unique little features is a slightly extended toe on one of his back feet from an old ligament injury. It doesn't slow him down one bit, and he happily enjoys walks, playtime, and all the comforts of pet life. 🏡 Rodney's Perfect Home Rodney would love a relaxed home where he can enjoy daily walks, fun adventures, and plenty of quality time with his people. As the only dog, he'll soak up every bit of love and attention while building a wonderful bond with his family. He'll thrive in a quieter household, whether that's with adults or a family with older, respectful children who will enjoy including him in their day-to-day adventures and giving him plenty of affection. If you're searching for a fun-loving companion with a big heart, a playful streak, and endless affection to share, Rodney might just be your perfect match. 💛

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Shelby is a very energetic greyhound who’s always ready to go. She’s best suited to an active lifestyle with plenty of opportunities to burn off her energy and enjoy structured play. If Shelby is rehomed with another dog, she’ll need an experienced owner and a canine companion who can truly match her energetic play style. She plays hard and would do best with a confident, compatible dog who enjoys the same level of activity. A secure backyard is a must for Shelby, giving her the space she needs to run, play, and unwind. In the right home, Shelby will thrive as a fun, lively companion for someone who loves an active dog.

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: Lenny is a beautiful male greyhound who knows exactly what he likes—and he likes his own space. He’d be happiest as a solo dog, where he can fully relax and enjoy being the center of attention. Out and about, Lenny is perfectly fine around other dogs and handles public settings well, but he’s not a fan of other dogs getting too close in his personal bubble. Because of this, he’s best suited to a home where he can have his space respected. Lenny would thrive in a semi-active household and is accustomed to being handled by kids, making him a great option for a family that understands dog boundaries. He’s a lovely boy with lots to offer the right home.

NAME: Roger
TEXT: Roger is a handsome black greyhound with a calm, easygoing vibe. He’s a pretty chill dude who enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and doesn’t ask for much beyond comfort, kindness, and a good routine. Roger would do best as a solo dog or with a female canine companion. He can be workable with small dogs and even cats, given the right introductions and management. His laid-back nature makes him a great match for full-time workers or a family looking for a low-key, affectionate dog. If you’re after a gentle, uncomplicated companion who’s happy to go with the flow, Roger might just be your guy.

NAME: Fang
TEXT: Fang is a striking white and red brindle male greyhound with a gentle, sensitive nature. He walks nicely on lead and enjoys getting out for calm, relaxed strolls. When first meeting new people, Fang can be a little nervous and appreciates a slow, patient approach. He will come over for pats, but prefers things to be taken at his pace — once he feels safe, he settles beautifully and shows his sweet, trusting side. Fang had a calm interaction with a small dog, enjoying a polite sniff before disengaging, and he showed lovely manners around other greyhounds during his assessment. He would do best in a home that understands shy dogs and is happy to let him build confidence in his own time.

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: *Romeo is in a foster care home in the Inner West and he is available to adopt! Foster Update: Romeo is super happy, affectionate and playful pup (no resource guarding or sleep startle observed). He is quite confident and outgoing at home. When he’s asleep he is angelic and when he is awake, he is effervescent. He has settled in quickly, he knows where his beds are and has a sleep bed and a play bed, he figured out very quickly where his toys live and how to dig the goat horn his favourite toy out of the basket. Romeo is a quick learner and has now mastered indoor and outdoor steps. He is responding to his name most of the time. His playful antics make us laugh to no end. He is happy to pass dogs on a footpath without much notice. Favourite things about him: His beautiful soulful eyes, his stunning looks, his mischievous personality, his independence and his affectionate behaviour. *Romeo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment with his foster carer*

NAME: Lou
TEXT: If you're looking for a friendly and outgoing companion, check out Lou! Lou has recently spent time in foster care where he mastered going to markets and meeting all the stall holders. Lou is a sweet, people-focused boy who enjoys routine, gentle companionship, and having his humans within eyesight. He walks beautifully on lead, took inner-city living in stride during foster care, and happily relaxed at cafés, pubs, and markets. He’s polite with other dogs on walks, enjoys calm play with other greyhounds, and absolutely adores squeaky toys and fetch. Lou is independent but affectionate, active in the mornings, and a cosy snoozer by evening when he has a comfortable spot to unwind. He will do best in a house with yard access, as smaller apartments made it difficult for him to fully settle and find his own space. When sharing a home with a medium–large dog, he benefits from structure around resting places and clear routines to keep everyone comfortable. Lou is a loving, joyful companion who thrives when given room to relax, predictable guidance, and a household that enjoys his mix of active playtime and peaceful downtime. Read below to see what Lou's foster carers had to say about him! "Lou is a beautiful boy with a lot of love to give. He walks very very well on the lead, ignores most birds and bush turkeys. He is not very interested in saying hi to other dogs and will respectfully walk straight past them. He loves squeaky toys with a passion and plays fetch with them with so much joy. He is a master of stairs. He would benefit from living in a house with a backyard, as our small apartment was a bit tight for him (he likes a safe space). In saying that he still wants to be within eyesight of you. He’s an independent but people loving doggie. He would benefit from an active owner - he is full of beans and loves longer walks and play time. He is most active in the mornings and is up for cuddles and play time, in the evening he likes to curl up and snooze independently." Apply now to meet Lou from our Western Sydney program.

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Keith is a handsome black greyhound with a touch of grey that only adds to his character — and don’t let it fool you, he’s still as active as ever. He’s social with smaller dogs and has a very easy-going, engaging nature that makes him a joy to be around. Keith loves company and would likely benefit from having a canine friend at home to share his days with. With his relaxed attitude and friendly personality, Keith would make a wonderful, loyal companion.

NAME: Lukey
TEXT: Lukey is a gorgeous brindle greyhound with a friendly, easygoing nature. He’s social with smaller dogs and enjoys getting out and about with nice walking manners. Lukey is very engaging with people and absolutely loves his cuddles, happily leaning in for affection. He also has a playful side that comes out once he’s comfortable, making him a lovely mix of fun and calm. Lukey would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a sweet, affectionate greyhound with a bit of sparkle.

NAME: Arrow
TEXT: Arrow is a striking black male greyhound with loads of energy and a playful spirit. He’s still building his confidence and engagement with people, but once he feels comfortable, he really enjoys pats and quiet affection. Arrow is a very active boy who loves to play and would suit a home ready to match his enthusiasm. At this stage, he’s not suitable to live with small dogs. On lead, Arrow can become excited and will benefit from some initial training and guidance to help him settle into walks. With patience, structure, and a bit of fun, Arrow has all the potential to shine.

NAME: Streak
TEXT: Streak is a handsome black male greyhound with a gentle, charming nature. He offers a polite introduction to new situations and is very workable, including being comfortable around small dogs. Streak travels well and settles easily, making him a great companion for outings or adventures. He enjoys a good burst of zoomies when the mood strikes, but he’s just as happy to slow down for cuddles afterward. Very engaging with people, Streak loves human attention and forms sweet connections with those around him. He’s a wonderful mix of playful energy and affectionate calm.

NAME: Maestro
TEXT: Foster Update "He is so affectionate and loving and a bit goofy, all around a lovable boy!" and more below: - He loves to be near you or see where you are. I have left him at home for short stretches and a couple of times for longer stretches, but I haven't left him for a full workday. I think he could work up to this over time, but he would prefer to be in a home where people are around more frequently. He's not fussed about who is home, just likes any human being there. - He is friendly towards everyone and fine with meeting new people. - He doesn't really like walks right now. I have been working with him on this consistently. He will do okay in quiet areas and is good on the lead. - Huuuuuge couch potato. I usually can't get him out of bed until the afternoon, not even for breakfast! I think it's because he's a bit of a night owl; he has been more active late at night. - Super unphased by all animals. Not fussed about dogs coming up to him, barely flinches when he walks past houses with reactive dogs in them. ---------------- Maestro is a happy, big-hearted dog who knows how to enjoy the good things in life. His three greatest loves are food, affection, and toys, and he approaches all of them with pure enthusiasm. Treats are the fastest way to his heart, but cuddles and playtime come in a very close second. Maestro prefers shorter hours alone while he settles in and would prefer human companionship at the start of his adoption journey. He has shown within a fortnight in foster he can already settle for 6 hours on his own. Maestro is a friendly, social guy who does well with other dogs and enjoys their company. Whether it’s a shared walk, a play session, or just hanging out together, he’s comfortable having canine friends around. Come meet Maestro and see if he’s ready to make beautiful music with your family. 💛🐾

NAME: Louie
TEXT: Louie is a happy boy who strikes the perfect balance between playful and laid-back. He loves zoomies and playing with toys, but he’s just as content relaxing and doing his own thing when it’s time to unwind. Louie is food motivated, which makes him a fun and rewarding boy to work with. He’s small-dog workable and enjoys human connection, while also being perfectly fine spending time independently. Due to his enthusiastic spirit, Louie would be best suited to a family with older children. A semi-active lifestyle will suit Louie well — one that includes playtime, daily outings, and plenty of chill time at home. If you’re looking for a greyhound with a great mix of fun and flexibility, Louie could be a wonderful addition to your family. 🐾

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is a handsome black male greyhound who may be a little shy at first, but with a few gentle cuddles and some reassurance, he quickly comes out of his shell. Once settled, his sweet and affectionate nature really shines. Ace walks beautifully on lead, making daily outings calm and enjoyable. He also has a playful side and loves spending time with his toys, happily entertaining himself or joining in for a game. He’s a well-mannered boy around other dogs and is good with larger breed dogs. A big plus is Ace’s excellent disengagement skills, making him small-dog and cat workable with appropriate introductions and management. His thoughtful, responsive nature shows just how well he listens and adapts to his environment. Ace would thrive in a patient, loving home that understands he just needs a little time to feel safe—once he does, you’ll be rewarded with a loyal, cuddly companion. If you’re looking for a gentle greyhound who blossoms with kindness and affection, Ace could be your perfect match 🐾

NAME: Nosey
TEXT: Nosey is a gorgeous black greyhound with a big heart and a happy-go-lucky personality. He’s a confident, cheerful boy who brings a lovely balance of playful energy and laid-back chill to everyday life. Suited to a semi-active lifestyle, Nosey enjoys his walks and playtime but is just as content relaxing at home. He’s confident on lead, making outings easy and enjoyable, and he absolutely loves his toys. Add food into the mix and you’ve got his full attention—Nosey is very food motivated, which makes training a breeze. Nosey would do well with a full-time worker or as a solo dog, as he’s comfortable spending time on his own once settled. He’s adaptable and would suit a variety of adopters looking for a friendly, easygoing companion. Due to his prey drive, Nosey is not suited to living with smaller dogs or cats, but he more than makes up for it with his affectionate nature and joyful spirit. If you’re looking for a confident, fun-loving greyhound who knows how to switch between play mode and relaxation, Nosey might just be your perfect match 💛

NAME: Solly
TEXT: Solly is a striking young man with a personality that’s equal parts energetic and laid-back. He thrives on an active lifestyle—think brisk walks, playtime, and the occasional burst of zoomies to burn off his youthful energy. After he’s had his exercise, Solly transforms into a mellow cuddle enthusiast, always ready to relax with a wagging tail and plenty of affection.
