His gentle nature would likely fit well into a family environment, and he also might be suited for homes with full-time workers as long as he gets his daily dose of activity. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who can keep up on walks and then happily settle down for some quality downtime, Solly might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a friendly, playful, and affectionate male greyhound who enjoys being part of everyday life. He loves cooling off with a paddle in the pool on warm days and is always happy to jump in the car for an outing. Charlie thrives on spending time with his people and would suit a family who can include him in adventures, playtime, and fun activities. Charlie walks very well on a lead and is calm and reliable when out and about. He has confidently been walked by children aged nine years and older, making him a lovely option for a family with older kids. With his easy-going nature and love of companionship, Charlie would make a wonderful addition to the right home.

NAME: Dan
TEXT: Dan is a handsome 6-year-old male greyhound with a need for speed—he’s very fast and loves to run! When he’s not showing off his racing skills, Dan enjoys taking it easy and lazing around. He’s great with other dogs and relaxed around children, making him a wonderful companion for families. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly boy who loves both adventure and chill time, Dan is your guy!

NAME: Ollie
TEXT: Friendly, playful, and full of charm! Ollie is a sweet and sociable greyhound who loves making new friends—both human and canine! He’s playful without being over-the-top, and his gentle nature makes him a joy to be around. One of Ollie’s cutest quirks? When he gets excited, he likes to “nibble” your hands with his nose—a little affectionate nudge that will melt your heart. He’s looking for a loving home where he can enjoy cozy naps, fun play sessions, and plenty of attention. Ollie would thrive with someone who appreciates his affectionate personality and is ready to share lots of cuddles. Why you’ll love Ollie: Calm yet playful temperament Loves people and enjoys gentle interaction Unique and adorable habit of nudging hands when happy If you’re ready to welcome a loyal companion who will brighten your days, Ollie is waiting to meet you!

NAME: Bev
TEXT: Bev is a lovely girl who lives in a rural setting. She lives amongst domestic animals and has no shortage of roos, wombats, echidnas and birds coming past.

NAME: Fiama
TEXT: This special girl loves getting outside just so she can soak up the sun. She knows her name well and is good when left alone in the yard. She has grown up around kids and plays well with the other greyhounds.

NAME: Hamish
TEXT: *On adoption trial* Hi, I'm Hamish, a gorgeous blue fawn boy. I can walk up and down stairs, and loves a snuggle once I get to know you! I have been described as calm and well behaved, with a lovely nature. I'm a great traveller and would be happy to settle in the car for road trips. I'm calm and a bit playful around other dogs and would suit a home with another dog my size/medium to large size. Meet me at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Astro is a heart-melting, affectionate boy looking for a forever home full of love, snuggles, and good company. While he's great with dogs of all sizes, he requires a home without another dog in the home but would thrive with doggy play dates and group walkies. He settles well in a crate and has shown to know his name and learning recall. This sweet soul is very cuddly and affectionate – a true Velcro dog who wants to be near his people. Whether it's curling up on the couch, following you around the house, or gently resting his head on your lap, Astro’s love knows no bounds. He’s a great inside dog with lovely house manners, making him a perfect match for someone who is home more often than not. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend who gives as much love as he gets, Astro is your guy. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Panda
TEXT: Panda is a very tidy dog who is easy to train and fit in. He is confident and very affectionate. He loves to play and loves to wipe out and relax by your side. He is comfortable on his own which would make him suitable for fulltime workers or a busy family. Panda can do stairs and is very gentle and friendly boy.

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Meet Benny🐾 Say hello to Benny, our big-hearted greyhound with an even bigger personality! This handsome lad is full of life, energy, and affection — the perfect mix of fun and love. Benny absolutely adores people and thrives on human company. Whether he’s greeting you with a wagging tail or leaning in for pats, he’s sure to win you over in seconds. Benny would love a family with a backyard where he can stretch his long legs, zoom around, and play to his heart’s content. After playtime, he’s more than happy to flop down and relax, enjoying some quiet time — he’s quite independent when he wants to be! When it comes to other dogs, Benny can be a bit selective with male dogs, so he’d likely be happiest as the only dog in his new home (as long as he has that backyard and plenty of human love, he’ll be in heaven!). If you’re looking for a big, goofy, affectionate companion who’ll make you smile every day, Benny is your boy. He’s ready to fill your home with love, laughter, and a few joyful zoomies!

NAME: Stella
TEXT: Meet Stella🌟 Say hello to Stella, a gorgeous greyhound with a heart as big as her smile! This social butterfly absolutely adores her canine friends and loves nothing more than a good play session with her doggy pals. Stella isn’t fazed by much — she takes everything in her stride with her calm, easy-going nature. Whether she’s out on an adventure or lounging at home, Stella is simply happy to be part of the fun. She’s a big fan of her humans too! Pats, ear rubs, and cuddles are always on her wish list, and she’ll happily follow you around or curl up at your feet once playtime is over. When she’s not making friends, Stella enjoys playing with her toys or just relaxing in a comfy spot nearby. With her affectionate personality and playful charm, she’s the perfect all-round companion. Stella’s dream home is one where she can share her days with loving humans (and maybe a furry friend or two) who will give her the love and attention she so happily returns.

NAME: Vern
TEXT: Vern is a gentleman who walks nicely on the lead, who is confident and happy around new people and happy to go gentle walks around the block everyday. A fenced backyard and a home who will include him in daily activities would be a great fit for him. Vern has a positive and welcoming nature which would see him suit a family with children. Meet Vern by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Affectionate boy Teddy is a sweet boy who walks gently on the lead and will greet you with a gentle tail wag. He is a calm, loving and sooky boy looking for someone to dote on him. He's easy to walk and has an easy going nature. He is friendly around other greyhounds and would suit a home with another dog. This cutie is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack🐾 Say hello to Jack, a cheerful and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to find his forever family! Jack has grown up around children and is wonderfully gentle and patient with them — he loves being part of family life and joins in with whatever’s going on, always making sure everyone is happy and safe. This lovely boy gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and enjoys having a playmate who can keep up with his energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs at times, so he’d benefit from some calm, positive socialisation to help him feel more confident with them. Jack’s playful side really shines when he’s surrounded by his toys. He loves tossing them around, chasing after them, and showing off his collection to anyone who’ll watch! Between play sessions, Jack takes his role as “family supervisor” very seriously, checking in regularly with his people to make sure all is well before settling down again with a big grin and wagging tail. With his happy, affectionate nature and gentle heart, Jack would make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a fun, loving dog to share their days with. He’s full of character, always up for a bit of play, and even happier just to be near his humans. If you’re searching for a loyal, joyful friend who’ll bring laughter and love into your home, Jack is your guy. He’s ready to meet his forever family — and he can’t wait to check in with you! 💛🐶

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith🐾 💛 Say hello to Keith, a stunning boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This charming boy has grown up surrounded by children, so he’s used to family life and all the noise, laughter, and cuddles that come with it. He’s gentle and patient with kids, always happy to join in on playtime or relax nearby while they do their thing. Keith is an excellent traveller, he hops into the car with ease and settles down quietly for the ride. Whether it’s a trip to the countryside or a quick run to the shops, he’s the perfect co-pilot who loves to be part of the action. When it comes to other dogs, Keith gets along beautifully with larger breeds and enjoys having a playmate of similar size and energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs and would benefit from some gentle, supervised socialisation. True to his greyhound nature, Keith is a lovely mix of playful and laid-back. He adores his bursts of energy in the garden or at the park — chasing toys, stretching those long legs, and showing off his zoomies, but he’s just as happy curling up for a snooze on the sofa afterwards. He’s got the balance just right! Keith would suit most family environments, especially those looking for a single dog who can be the centre of attention. He thrives on affection and companionship and will reward his new family with endless loyalty, love, and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Bj
TEXT: Meet BJ🐾 BJ is a wonderful male greyhound who’s great with all dogs and would fit perfectly into a home with children. He’s had positive experiences around kids before, making him a calm and gentle companion for family life. This affectionate boy absolutely loves pats and cuddles — he’s always ready to lean in for some extra love and attention. BJ also enjoys a splash in shallow water, happily cooling off and having fun when the chance arises. With his friendly nature, love for affection, and easy going temperament, BJ is a fantastic all-rounder who will bring warmth and happiness to any household. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who thrives in a family environment and gets along with everyone, BJ could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a playful, sweet-natured boy with a cheeky streak and a big heart. He’s lived with a young cattle dog puppy and showed plenty of patience, and he currently shares his life with a couple of toddlers who climb all over him—he doesn’t mind a bit! Jack LOVES his toys (especially fetch!) and is super treat-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze. He’s all about having a good play, then flopping onto a comfy bed for a well-earned nap. Jack’s also been known to “reorganise” shoes around the house—just his way of helping with interior design! If you’re after a fun-loving, kid-friendly companion with a mischievous grin and a heart of gold, Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Burt
TEXT: Burt is a total character who thrives on human attention and isn’t shy about making sure you notice him! He can pull like a pro at first on walks, but give him a little time and he settles right down. Burt gets along with other greyhounds at home but prefers to be the king of his castle—he’s got a strong “mine” vibe when it comes to his food and toys. He’s great with kids of all ages and has plenty of experience being a patient, lovable buddy. Burt’s looking for someone who’s home most of the time to keep him company and soak up all his charm. Cats aren’t really his cup of tea, so a feline-free home would suit him best. Ready for a lively, loyal companion? Burt’s your guy!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a calm and quiet lady who walks well on lead and prefers a relaxed lifestyle—perfect for someone looking for a low-key companion. She enjoys a little play with toys now and then, plus the occasional zoomie to remind you she’s still got some pep in her step. Bertha is best suited as a solo dog and would be a wonderful match for someone who wants a peaceful friend to share their days with—especially if you work from home and can keep her company. While she’s not a fan of cats, Bertha’s easy-going nature makes her a sweet and steady companion for the right home.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a confident, energetic guy who walks beautifully on lead and loves to bound around with enthusiasm. He’s super engaging with people and thrives on treats—perfect for training and bonding! While Jimmy enjoys playing with other greyhounds during his outings, he prefers to be the only dog in the home to keep things calm and comfortable. Jimmy requires a cat-free home/small animal home. All-in-all Jimmy will require an experienced greyhound owner. Jimmy would shine in an active household where he can join in on plenty of adventures and daily fun. If you’re looking for a lively, loyal, Jimmy is your guy!

NAME: Hammer
TEXT: Ready to nail the perfect companion? Meet Hammer 🐾 Hammer is the ultimate all-rounder—a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who gets along famously with other dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether it’s a tiny terrier or a big labrador, Hammer’s easy going nature means he’s ready to make friends wherever he goes. This lively boy absolutely loves his zoomies and would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can race around and let loose to his heart’s content. When he’s not zooming, Hammer is a wonderful family dog—gentle, affectionate, and great with people of all ages. He’s equally happy as a solo dog or as the perfect companion for a young couple looking for a loving, energetic friend. Hammer is a cuddler at heart and enjoys spending quiet moments snuggled up with his humans after a day of fun and play. His engaging personality and happy disposition make him a joy to be around, always eager to say hello and share some love. If you’re searching for a playful, affectionate, and well-rounded greyhound who’s ready to bring energy and warmth into your home, Hammer might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Big Boy
TEXT: Say hello to Big Boy 🐾 Big Boy is a gentle giant with a heart as big as his name! This confident and max relaxer greyhound is a true people pleaser who adores everyone—from dogs and cats to children of all ages. He’s got a warm, friendly nature that makes him an instant hit wherever he goes. While Big Boy loves socializing, he prefers to be the king of his castle and would do best as a solo dog in his forever home. That said, he’s always up for a fun doggy playdate to stretch his legs and enjoy some furry friendship time. He knows how to keep things chill and relaxed, so his play dates tend to be happy and harmonious affairs. Big Boy would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can soak up the sunshine, lounge on the grass, or explore at his own leisurely pace. He’s happiest when a family member is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys company but is also perfectly content to kick back and chill solo when needed. Whether he’s snoozing quietly or spending quality time cuddling with his humans, Big Boy’s laid-back vibe brings calm and comfort to any household. On walks, Big Boy is a star walker, calm and confident on the lead, making every outing a peaceful pleasure for both dog and human. If you’re looking for a lovable, relaxed companion who’s a true social butterfly with a preference for solo living and fun play dates, Big Boy could be your perfect match. Ready to settle in and steal your heart, he’s waiting to become the gentle giant of your family!

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Cindy is a sweet, quiet girl, who is lovely and soft with other dogs. She warms up well once you get to know her and becomes very sweet and affectionate. Cindy would suit a nurturing home where they can take things slow, but we're sure she will come out of her shell! A quiet home with a backyard to retreat to would be a perfect match for Cindy as she settles into pet life. A home without little kids is best suited as she is on the shy side. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Tails
TEXT: Meet Tails 🐕‍🦺 Tails has been in foster care with a wonderful family and their 2 greyhounds now for a few months. 💕 Tails has flourished in foster with Winnie and Potato teaching her the ropes. She loves going for walks and enjoys the beach. Tails is a collector of all things, she has learnt to clean up her toys and take them to her bed at night. She also collects many other things and looks after them. Tails would benefit from another confident playful greyhound friend like Potato to teach her the ropes and continue to bring out her confidence. Tails loves to play and run with her friend Potato in the yard while Winnie supervises watching fromt he sidelines ready to be the fun police if required.

NAME: Wooly
TEXT: Hey, I'm Wooly! I'm a quiet guy, looking for a quiet home. I warm up to new people but would prefer a nurturing chilled out place to call my own. I'd love my own backyard and don't mind mingling with other dogs big or small. I love food and will enjoy learning new tricks in my forever home. A home without children is best for me. I can't wait to meet you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a confident, friendly and affectionate girl described as 'wonderful' by her trainers here at the adoption centre. If you're looking for a super smart and focused girl, Jill's known cues are: name/recall, 'on your bed', off, down, touch, shake, chin rest, and drop (a toy). Jill loves toys & will play fetch with you. Her ideal home is a house with a backyard with colorbond fencing with shorter hours alone while she settles in. Jill requires a home without exposure to other dogs and requires an owner who lives in a low small dog populated area. She would thrive with an experienced greyhound owner who can continue her human engagement, training, focus training, and things like stationing on a bed, performing cues and recalling. She is happy to entertain herself in the yard during the day making her a good fit for those who work full-time and want a loving companion welcome them home everyday. Meet Jill at Western Sydney!

NAME: Spring
TEXT: Meet Spring! 🌼 Spring is a sweet-natured girl with a heart as soft as her gorgeous greyhound coat. She’s one of those dogs who makes life easier just by being around – relaxed, gentle, and incredibly easy to handle. Whether you’re an experienced dog owner or new to life with pups, Spring fits in effortlessly. She’s a real social butterfly, getting along brilliantly with all other dogs and loving the company of people. If you’ve got visitors, expect Spring to be first in line for a gentle hello and a little tail wag. She's a friendly soul who just wants to be included in the love. Spring would be a great fit for a family home, including one with respectful children. Her calm and steady personality makes her a safe and lovely companion for little ones. While she’s a joy in almost every way, Spring is still working on perfecting her lead manners – nothing too tricky, just a bit of ongoing training and consistency, and she’ll have it down in no time. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance, and loving dog who enjoys companionship and will bring a peaceful energy to your home, Spring could be your perfect match.

NAME: Belle
TEXT: Belle is a happy, vibrant and energetic girl who is affectionate and social! She loves all the fun things in pet life - treats, zoomies, attention and play! She would love a fun active home to keep her stimulated and meet her training and enrichment needs. She is very friendly, and would suit a home with another dog big or small. She would suit kids experienced with large breed dogs. A fully fenced yard with somewhere for her to romp around and sunbake would be ideal for Belle! Available via Northern Rivers.

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Meet Gem 💎! This gorgeous girl has a heart full of love and a gentle, shy nature that takes a little time to come out of her shell. At first, Gem might feel a bit reserved as she gets used to new surroundings and people, but with patience and a calm environment, she quickly settles in and reveals her true, loving self. Gem would thrive best in a household where someone is usually around—whether working from home, part-time, or just a steady presence—so she never feels alone and can build her confidence at her own pace. One of Gem’s greatest joys is spending time with her doggy friends. She loves to play and interact with other dogs, showing her friendly and sociable side once she feels comfortable. Gem also adores children and enjoys their playful energy, making her a wonderful companion for families with kids who can engage her in gentle games and fun activities. Though she may start off a little shy, once Gem has warmed up to you, she’s a total cuddle queen. She loves curling up close, soaking in affection, and sharing those quiet, cozy moments that truly bond a dog and their human. Her sweet, gentle spirit shines through in these calm times, reminding you just how special she is. If you’re looking for a patient, loving, and devoted friend who will blossom beautifully in a supportive and caring home, Gem is waiting to meet you. With time, love, and consistency, this gentle girl will become a treasured member of your family, bringing warmth and happiness every day.

NAME: Lonnie
TEXT: Hey, I'm Lonnie! With my big happy smile, I hope I catch your eye! I'm a friendly girl to people and dogs alike, making me a wonderful family pet. I walk perfectly on the lead, and I have a lovely gentle personality. I like car rides, adventures and having fun with my people. I would love a home who will show me all about the big wide world and include me in daily activities. I have a soft, gentle personality and would love to meet you! Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Hi, I'm angel, a gentle mannered quiet girl looking for a forever home. I'm middle aged, making me sweet and calm and ready to snooze by your side. I can take a little time to warm up but I promise to be your best friend once I get to know you. Another dog does give me some more confidence so maybe you have a confident doggie for me to be friends with? I'd love a courtyard or backyard to call my own, as I love being outside in the sunshine. Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Danny
TEXT: Meet Danny 🐕 Danny is a charming and affectionate boy with a big heart and a friendly soul. He absolutely adores other greyhounds and thrives in their company. Although he hasn’t been tested around smaller dogs yet, his gentle and calm nature suggests he could adapt well with the right introduction. Danny has lived happily with young children and has proven to be a patient and loving friend to the little ones in his life. He’s used to the hustle and bustle of a busy home and enjoys being part of a family environment where he can share lots of love and attention. One of Danny’s standout qualities is how beautifully he walks on the lead — calm, polite, and well-mannered, he makes every walk a pleasant experience. He’s also very trainable and responds well to crate training, which helps him settle and feel secure when needed. Danny would do best in a home that has a backyard or safe outdoor space where he can stretch his legs, enjoy some fresh air, and have the freedom to relax and play. He’s not just an energetic pup; he’s a true people-lover who thrives on companionship and bonds closely with his humans. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly, and devoted greyhound who will fit seamlessly into a loving home, Danny could be your perfect match. He’s ready to share his heart and make new memories with a family that can give him the care and affection he deserves.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is the sweetest boy a heart full of love and legs built for adventure. This playful boy is looking for his forever home where he can shine as either your one-and-only or alongside another medium to large dog who matches his energy and style. 🐾 Personality & Temperament: Playful & affectionate – Jimmy loves to play and thrives on human interaction. Walk enthusiast – Walks are his favorite part of the day, and he’ll happily trot beside you rain or shine. Kid-friendly – Best suited to homes with older children who understand gentle dog manners. 🏡 Ideal Home: Jimmy would do best in a home where he’s either the only pet or paired with another dog of similar size. He’s not suited to living with small dogs or cats, but he’s got plenty of love to give to his human family.

NAME: Zara
TEXT: Zara is a chilled and easy going girl Zara would like a quiet home where she can chill with her family and perhaps go on a short walk every few days Zara has been living in a home and is quiet and easy to live with Zara has been socialised with small dogs and would be fine with a relaxed quiet small friend

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal 👑🐾 Royal is a delightful girl who truly lives up to her name. She’s a playful and affectionate sweetheart who adores making friends—especially with other dogs, no matter their size! Royal’s favourite thing in the world is playing with her furry pals, and she’ll happily invite any dog she meets to join in on the fun. Whether it’s a game of chase, tug, or just a joyful romp, Royal is always ready to play. This gentle lady would make a wonderful family pet. She’s calm and confident, not easily stressed by new people or environments, which makes her adaptable and easygoing in all kinds of settings. Royal loves her toys and can spend hours happily entertaining herself or sharing playtime with her favourite humans. When she’s not busy playing or making new friends, Royal is a cuddle bug who loves to snuggle up and soak in all the love and attention she can get. She’s a perfect balance of lively and laid-back—a true joy to have around. If you’re looking for a loving, playful, and incredibly social companion who will bring laughter and warmth into your home, Royal is ready to steal your heart and become your family’s new best friend.

NAME: T Rex
TEXT: Meet T-Rex 🦕 Dog Friendly: Yes – best with medium to large dogs Child Friendly: Yes – best suited to a home with older children Ideal Home: A family with a secure backyard and an active lifestyle Don’t let the name fool you – T-Rex is all heart and happiness! This big, bouncy boy is bursting with personality and ready to find a family who’ll love his enthusiastic, affectionate nature. T-Rex is a social butterfly through and through. He’s currently living with other greyhounds and thrives in their company, especially those who can match his playful energy. He’s also friendly with medium and large dogs, and loves being part of a pack. This boy lives for his people – always close by, always ready to join in. Whether you're moving around the house or heading out for an adventure, expect T-Rex to be your loyal shadow. He’s interactive, affectionate, and happiest when included. T-Rex would do best in a home with older children who can enjoy his energy and help guide his big personality. A backyard is a must – he’s got some serious zoomie skills and needs space to stretch those long legs. While he’s eager to get out and explore, T-Rex can be strong on the lead, so he’ll need confident handlers who can continue his training and help him channel his excitement on walks. He will be your super social and loyal shadow and sidekick If you’re ready for a fun, affectionate, and outgoing greyhound who will bring non-stop joy and energy into your life, T-Rex is your guy.

NAME: Zippa
TEXT: Meet Zippa!🐾 Zippa is a charming, affectionate boy who’s never met a dog he didn’t want to be friends with—especially if they’re fellow greyhounds! He thrives on canine company and is always the first to say hello with a happy wag and a gentle nuzzle. This social superstar settles quickly into new environments and brings calm confidence wherever he goes. Whether it’s a bustling park or a cozy home, Zippa makes himself right at home in no time. He absolutely adores human affection and will happily lean in for cuddles, neck scritches, and all the love you’re willing to give. With his friendly nature and easy-going personality, Zippa is a joy to have around and will make a wonderful companion for a home with other dogs—or just humans ready to shower him with love.

NAME: Son
TEXT: *Son has spent some time in a foster home* His foster carer shared that: "He's been doing well on walks, slowly getting better each day walking on the leash without too much pulling, eating well, and enjoying playing with toys." Hi, I'm Son! I've been described as calm, loving, sociable, and easy-going. I enjoy spending time with my people and thrive on human companionship. Once I've gotten to know you, I'm more than happy to snuggle in for some attention and pats. I'm comfortable travelling in the car, snoozing in a crate, and relaxing around the home. I have a charming nature and a zest for life, and I'd love a backyard where I can search for my toys and find the perfect sunny spot for an afternoon nap. I would suit a home where I can have quiet spaces to relax while I settle in and learn all about my new surroundings. I'd also love a family who can be around more often than not while I continue building confidence being left alone. I may enjoy living with another medium to large breed dog as a companion, provided introductions are managed appropriately. I would also be best suited to a home with mature-aged children who can understand and respect my boundaries. If you're looking for a gentle, affectionate companion who enjoys both adventure and relaxation, I could be the perfect match for you. You can meet me at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre!

NAME: Diesel
TEXT: With his sweet little undershot jaw, Diesel oozes character both on the outside and on the inside! This sweet dog is good with children and other dogs, he is ready to slot right into family life and find a sofa to call his own. Whist he loves to play ball and goof around, Diesel is also happy to curl up next to his person for a cuddle and a snooze!

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris! 🐕 Boris is a high-energy, fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. With his confident nature and bouncy enthusiasm, he’s always ready to play, explore, and soak up all the affection he can get. Boris gets along great with medium to large dogs and would thrive in an active home where he can be part of the action. Whether it’s going on adventures, playing in the yard, or just enjoying time with his people, Boris is all in. He would also love a friend at home to keep him company and is happy to play with him. If you’re an energetic family looking for a lively, loving companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Boris is your guy!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Gazza is a sweet boy who travels well in vans, cars and trailer, also walks well on lead on adventures out and about. Gazza has shown polite manners with children ranging from 20 months to 9 years old, showing a gentle & polite indifference. Gazza has spent time mingling with big and small dogs and would suit a home looking for a laid back boy happy to go with the flow. Gazza dreams of a little backyard to spend his days in and kids to keep him entertained during the day. He can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sooky
TEXT: walks well on lead Confident and social. higher energy dog for someone thats looking for adventure and likes fitness jumps up and down playful and jumps up to give cuddles likes to go off and explore would love a big backyard good for fulltime working hours enjoys a zoomie

NAME: Zane
TEXT: Say hello to Zane! 🐾 Say hi to Zane, a lovable boy with a bright personality and a constantly wagging tail! Zane is the kind of dog who takes life in stride—always happy, always friendly, and ready to make new friends wherever he goes. Zane gets along beautifully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether he’s meeting other Greyhounds or mingling with different breeds, he’s calm, polite, and loves being part of the action. Busy environments? No problem for Zane! He takes everything in with a relaxed attitude and copes well with new places, people, and experiences. He’s curious, confident, and always up for a new adventure—especially if there are treats involved (his favourite!). Zane would thrive in a home where he gets to be part of the fun and share his joy with others. If you’re after a gentle, friendly companion who brings sunshine wherever he goes, Zane might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Garth
TEXT: Introducing Garth… 🐾✨ Garth is a clever, confident greyhound who is happy to sniff out the world around him. 🌍👃 Whether it’s a leafy park, a busy street, or a quiet trail, Garth’s nose is always on a mission. He’s got a serious sniff game going on, taking in all in. But don’t let his independent streak fool you — when it’s time to wind down, Garth transforms into a total cuddle champ. 🥰 He’s a pro at snuggling up close, giving the best warm, cozy vibes after a long day of exploring. 🐕❤️ On walks, Garth is the perfect gentleman: calm, focused, and walking nicely on the lead. 🐕‍🦺 He’s happy to take the lead on where to sniff next, but always by your side. If you’re after a smart, easy-going companion who loves his independence but knows how to share the love, Garth is your guy and he can’t wait to meet you! 💙

NAME: Shakey
TEXT: Meet Shakey! 🐾 Shakey is a lovable greyhound with a heart full of affection for humans and fellow dogs alike❤️. Always the initiator of cuddles and belly rubs, Shakey thrives on connection and companionship. Curious and adventurous, he loves exploring new surroundings and enjoys every walk — especially because he’s such a pro on the lead! 🚶‍♂️ He’d be happiest in a busy, lively home where there’s plenty going on and would be more than happy with another furry friend to share the fun 🐕🎉. If you’re looking for a gentle, sociable, and well-mannered greyhound to brighten your days, Shakey might just shake her way into being your perfect match!

NAME: Tommy
TEXT: Meet Tommy – The Tail-Wagging Bundle of Joy! 🐾🎉 Tommy is a happy greyhound whose tail never stops wagging! He’s a lovable guy who thrives on cuddles, pats, and playtime—always ready to share his infectious enthusiasm with everyone he meets. Tommy loves exploring new places and sniffing out adventures, making every walk an exciting journey. His joyful spirit and affectionate nature make him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a fun-loving, loving friend. If you want a happy, playful pal who’s always up for a cuddle and a romp, Tommy’s your guy!

NAME: Bruiser
TEXT: Meet Bruiser – Big Heart, Bigger Tail Wags! 🐶💕 Don’t let the name fool you – Bruiser is a total softie! This happy-go-lucky boy is bursting with love and has a tail that never stops wagging. He’s always ready to greet you with a smile and a nuzzle, and he thrives on affection from his human friends. Bruiser is full of energy and enjoys his playtime, walks, and any chance to explore the world by your side. He’s been around children aged 8 and up and would do well in a home where he can continue building those bonds – he loves being part of the action! Whether it’s zoomies in the yard or cuddles on the couch, Bruiser brings a joyful spark to every moment. He’d be a wonderful match for an active family or anyone looking for a loyal, loving companion. Ready to meet your new best friend? Bruiser can’t wait to wag his way into your heart!

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a gentle, easy-going boy with a calm and placid nature. He loves a good snuggle but is just as happy doing his own thing or spending time with his people. With a slow introduction, he may get along well with smaller dogs. Sonny is a relaxed companion ready to bring quiet joy to a loving home.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾 Charlie is a social butterfly who loves spending time with people and gets along great with other dogs. He’s full of energy and can be a bit strong on the lead at first, but he quickly settles into a calm and well-mannered walker once he gets going. Charlie is also a pro traveller—he enjoys van rides and is comfortable on the road, making him a great adventure buddy. If you’re looking for a friendly, outgoing greyhound who’s ready to join you on walks and trips, Charlie is your guy!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a calm, easygoing greyhound who’s as lovely on the inside as he is on the outside. With his gentle nature and relaxed attitude, he settles into new environments quickly and takes everything in his stride. Jack is fantastic with children and other dogs, making him a wonderful family companion. He’s always polite, friendly, and happy to be part of the group – whether it’s a quiet day at home or a walk around the neighbourhood. He walks beautifully on the lead, never pulling or fussing, and is more than happy to stroll along at your side. Jack’s chilled-out personality and kind soul make him a joy to have around.

NAME: Greg
TEXT: Meet Greg – A Gentle Soul Ready to Bloom 🌟🐾 Greg is a sweet and sensitive greyhound with a quietly charming personality. He can be a little shy at first, but it doesn’t take long for him to warm up – and once he does, you’ll see a loving and loyal companion who enjoys being part of the action in his own gentle way. Greg gets along well with other dogs and enjoys their company. He walks beautifully on the lead and is a dream to take out and about, always calm and well-mannered. He also travels well in the car, making adventures easy and stress-free. With a little patience and a lot of love, Greg will continue to come out of his shell and show you just how affectionate and easy going he really is. He’s a quiet star who’s just waiting for the right person or family to help him shine.

NAME: Sheila
TEXT: Meet Sheila – A Sweet Soul with a Playful Heart 🐾💖 Sheila is a beautiful greyhound with a gentle nature and a heart full of love. She can be a little shy when meeting new people or exploring new places, but give her a bit of time and patience, and you’ll see her blossom into a joyful, playful girl with the happiest little tail wags. Once Sheila feels safe and settled, her playful side shines through. She loves to run, bounce around, and enjoy the company of her doggy friends – she gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in their company. Sheila would do best in a calm and supportive home where she’s given the space to build her confidence. In return, she’ll reward you with sweet affection, gentle playfulness, and a loyal heart.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Meet Penny🎾🐾 Penny is a bright, bubbly greyhound with a zest for life and a serious love for fetch! Toss a ball and watch her light up with joy – she could play all day if you let her. Her playful spirit and happy nature make her an absolute delight to be around. Always cheerful and full of personality, Penny brings positive energy wherever she goes. She travels well in the car, making her a great companion for outings and adventures, and she’s perfectly content relaxing in her crate when it’s time to wind down. Penny is the perfect mix of fun and easy going. Whether she’s chasing a ball, enjoying a ride, or snoozing in her crate after a busy day, she does it all with a wagging tail and a happy heart.

NAME: Glen
TEXT: Meet Glen – The Ultimate Companion with a Heart of Gold 💛🐾 Glen is a handsome greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger love for life. Friendly, affectionate, and full of charm, Glen adores people and never misses an opportunity for a cuddle or a kind word. His tail is always wagging, especially when he's surrounded by his favourite humans. Glen gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is a real social butterfly. Whether he's playing with his pals or just chilling nearby, he brings calm, friendly energy wherever he goes. A big fan of toys, Glen loves a bit of playtime and will happily keep himself entertained with a squeaky or two. He also travels like a dream in the car, making him the perfect buddy for road trips, weekend getaways, or even just a quick drive to the park.

NAME: Donnie
TEXT: Meet Donnie – The Social Butterfly with a Love for Fun! 🐶🎾 Donnie is a happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for a good time! Whether he’s heading out on a road trip or making new doggy friends at the park, Donnie takes it all in stride. He travels like a pro – calm, relaxed, and ready for the next stop on the journey. This playful boy has a soft spot for toys and will happily entertain himself with a squeaky or a tug toy, bringing a smile to everyone around him. He gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in social settings, making him a great fit for families with existing canine companions. Donnie walks beautifully on the lead and loves exploring the world at a comfortable pace by your side. His friendly nature, confidence, and zest for life make him a joy to have around.

NAME: Dougall
TEXT: Meet Dougall🚗🐾 Dougall is a charming greyhound with a heart as big as his love for car rides. This gentle soul is always ready to hop in the car and join you on your next adventure – whether it’s a weekend getaway or just a trip to the shops, Dougall’s happy place is right by your side. With excellent leash manners, Dougall walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls a breeze. He’s polite and friendly around other dogs, and his calm nature makes him a wonderful companion in a variety of settings. Dougall also has a soft spot for affection. He’ll happily lean in for a cuddle or nuzzle up for some ear scratches – he may be sleek and speedy, but he’s really just a big softie at heart.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry has lived his life surrounded by children, and would suit a home with a family of children who are eager to give him lots of love. Henry is a social butterfly who loves a bit of attention! He would suit a home with another medium to large dog who is on the chill side like him. His previous owners have summed him up as a big goof ball, who is placid, even a little bit clumsy! He settles well on his bed and is happy to watch the world go by with you by his side. Henry is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chief
TEXT: Meet Chief – a handsome, easy-going boy with a heart of gold. This laid-back fella is happy entertaining himself or just chillin' solo 😎. Patient and gentle, Chief is great with small children and gets along well with other animals. He grew up around a cattle dog and has been exposed to goats, so farm life is nothing new to him. Whether he's playing or relaxing in the sun, Chief brings a calm, loyal energy to any home 🐾.

NAME: Flow
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Flow! 🌸 Flow is a very sweet girl with a heart full of potential. 💕 She's ready to learn, grow, and succeed with the help of a loving, supportive home. With a little training and plenty of encouragement, she’ll blossom into an amazing companion. She’d do best with older, understanding children and could be a great match for a calm, medium-large dog friend. If you're looking for a kind soul to grow with, Flow is ready to start her journey with you! 🐶💫

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jasper! 💙 Jasper is an affectionate, sweet, and kind-hearted boy who just wants to be loved. 🐶 He’s playful and gentle, with so much potential to shine in the right home. He’s still learning and will need a supportive family to continue his training and help build his confidence. Jasper would do best with older, understanding children and could get along well with a compatible medium-large dog. If you're ready to open your heart to a truly lovable companion, Jasper is waiting for you! 💕

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Reggie! 🐶 Reggie is an active, playful, and seriously handsome boy! 😍 He's full of energy and would love a yard where he can run, play, and burn off that puppy spirit. Still working on his manners, Reggie needs a patient, understanding family ready to guide him with love and consistency. He’d do best with older kids and could be a great match for a friendly medium-large dog buddy. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion to grow with, Reggie’s your guy! 💙

NAME: Emma
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Emma! 💖 Emma is a gentle soul with so much love to give. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and kindness, her sweet personality shines through. 💕 She’s looking for a calm, supportive family to help her grow in confidence with continued training and socialisation. Emma enjoys the company of well-mannered dogs (especially larger ones!) and would do best with older, understanding children. A secure yard to play and explore would be the cherry on top for this lovely girl. 🐶🌿

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Goofy – A Special Boy Looking for His Special Home 🐶💛 Goofy is a sweet male with a quirky charm and a heart ready to bond. He’s looking for a quiet, patient home where he can take things at his own pace. Goofy needs someone who understands that dogs like him need time, gentle guidance, and a whole lot of love to build trust. He’s still learning about the world, so training and socialization will be key to helping him grow into his best self. Goofy would do best as the only dog in the home, with older, understanding children who can respect his boundaries. With the right people, Goofy will shine – could that be you?

NAME: Sofia
TEXT: Meet Sofia – A Loving Blue Beauty Looking for Her Forever Home 💙🐾 Sofia is a beautiful blue female with a gentle soul and a heart full of potential. She's looking for a home that can offer her support, understanding, and time—someone patient and committed to helping her grow with continued training and care. Sofia has an old injury to her front leg, so she’ll need a family that understands her physical needs and can help her feel safe and comfortable. She thrives best as a single dog in the household and would be happiest with older, dog-savvy children who can respect her space and needs. If you’re ready to offer a calm, loving home where Sofia can continue her journey, she’s ready to meet you. 💙

NAME: Tylah
TEXT: Tylah is a beautiful, gentle soul who’s mastered the art of relaxing. She’s a laid-back lady who loves her naps and cozy spots, but don’t let that fool you—she still has her zoomie moments! Short bursts of energy are her specialty, followed by lots of lounging and cuddles. She’s happiest when she’s with her people, always close by and ready to share her calm, loving presence. Loyal, sweet, and full of quiet charm, Tylah is the kind of companion who makes every day feel a little more peaceful. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who will love being by your side (especially on the couch), Tylah might just be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Digger
TEXT: Digger is a curious, affectionate boy who loves to learn and be involved in whatever you're doing. He’s attentive, enjoys playing with his toys, and thrives on interaction. Digger would do best as the only dog in the home and would love having older children to play and bond with.

NAME: Brad
TEXT: Brad is a lively, energetic boy once he feels at home. He enjoys playtime, especially in a backyard where he can stretch his legs and have fun. Brad is good with smaller dogs and would do well in a home with older children. A sweet, active companion ready for his next adventure!

NAME: Dempsey
TEXT: Dempsey is a fun-loving, affectionate boy with a big personality and an even bigger love for his toys. He's interactive, silly, and always ready to make you laugh with his goofy antics. Dempsey does well with smaller dogs after a slow, safe introduction. A joyful companion who’s all about play, cuddles, and good vibes!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet Bruce! 🖤 Bruce is a sweet, laid-back boy with a charming personality. He gets along well with small dogs and is always happy to spend time with his human friends. Bruce does have pannus, a condition that affects his eyes. While it's not curable, it’s easily managed with treatment to keep him comfortable. If you’re looking for a friendly, easy-going companion with a big heart, Bruce is ready to bring his charm into your life!

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet this laid-back, placid boy—our sweet male Blaze! He's the definition of a "dopey" cuddle bug who loves nothing more than a good snuggle. As a single dog household pup, he's very content with his quiet life in the backyard, and he's happy to share his space with older children who understand his calm nature. Experienced owners will appreciate his lazy demeanor and gentle temperament. He’s all about relaxing and enjoying the simple things in life!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a playful, cheeky, and energetic female greyhound who loves people and is very social. She’s curious and full of fun, always ready for an adventure. With the right introduction, she might get along with smaller dogs, making her a great addition to an active and engaging home.

NAME: Dare
TEXT: Dare is a big, gentle giant with a very sweet and playful nature. He’s fun-loving yet shows a patient and calm side when needed. Confident and happy, Dare is the perfect mix of energy and tranquility, making him an affectionate companion for any home.

NAME: Windy
TEXT: Windy is a very sweet-natured male dog who can be a little shy at first but quickly comes out of his shell, especially when playing with toys. Confident on his own, he gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is sure to bring joy and warmth once he settles in.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a calm, easy-going, and very friendly dog with an affectionate and interactive nature. He loves to connect with others and is great with smaller breeds of dogs. Hank’s gentle personality makes him a wonderful companion for any home looking for a sweet and sociable pet.

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a happy boy who thrives on his own in a single-dog household. He needs a supportive home where he can grow and learn. With patience and encouragement, Tom will blossom into a loving and confident companion.

NAME: Scotch
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Scotch! 🖤 Scotch is a happy, confident greyhound with a heart full of joy. Due to a past leg injury, he enjoys a slower-paced home and shorter walks—but don’t worry, he can still move around and play just fine! 🐾 Engaging, affectionate, and full of love, Scotch thrives in a calm environment where he can relax and enjoy life at his own pace. If you're looking for a gentle, loyal companion, Scotch is ready to win your heart. 💕

NAME: Uno
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Uno! 🌟 Uno is a lovely older lady with a confident, engaging personality and a heart full of love. 💕 She’s sweet, kind, and always happy—bringing a warm, joyful presence wherever she goes. With her calm nature and affectionate spirit, Uno makes the perfect companion for a caring, loving family ready to share their home with a gentle soul. 🐶💫 If you’re looking for a steady, loving friend, Uno is ready to make your heart her home.

NAME: Dozer
TEXT: Dozer, or "Little D," is a sweet boy who needs time and patience to learn and grow. He’ll thrive in a quiet home where he can feel safe and supported as he blossoms into his best self. With the right care, he’s sure to become a loving companion.

NAME: Lexi
TEXT: Lexi is a sweet and placid female greyhound with a calm demeanor. Eager to learn, she needs room to grow and thrive, along with patience and understanding. A single-dog household would be ideal, providing her with the space and care she needs to flourish.

NAME: Aggi
TEXT: Aggi is a pretty female greyhound who can be a little shy at first. She needs encouragement, support, love, and time to grow. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can feel secure and receive the attention she needs. Aggi is eager to learn and thrive with the right care and patience.

NAME: Micha
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Micha! 💖 Micha is a sweet and sensitive female greyhound looking for a calm, loving home to help her blossom. With the right support and encouragement, she’s eager to learn and grow into a confident companion. She’ll thrive in a quiet environment where she feels safe and secure. Micha would do best as the only dog to start with, giving her the space and attention she needs to adjust and build trust. If you have a gentle heart and a peaceful home, Micha is ready to find comfort by your side. 🐶💕

NAME: Tubby
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Tubby! 💗 Tubby is a sweet girl who just needs a little time and patience to truly shine. 🌸 She can be a bit unsure at times, but with the right support and encouragement, she’ll blossom into a loving, confident companion. She’d do best in a calm, single-dog household where she can feel safe and truly be herself. With your love and guidance, Tubby is sure to thrive. 🐶💕

NAME: Sassy
TEXT: Sassy is a female greyhound looking for a quiet, supportive, and loving home. She needs room to grow, learn, and thrive, along with the encouragement and patience to help her blossom. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can receive all the attention and care she deserves.

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a sweet female greyhound who can be a little shy and unsure at first, but she’ll open up with time and patience. She needs space, encouragement, and room to grow in a supportive environment. Molly thrives in a single-dog household where she can receive the love and attention she needs to feel comfortable and secure.

NAME: Minni
TEXT: Minni is a laid-back, easy-going older gal with a calm and confident demeanor. She’s curious and independent, but also affectionate and loves a good snuggle. Minni is the perfect companion for someone looking for a relaxed and loving pet.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Lucy is a very friendly and affectionate older girl who loves to give and receive cuddles. She can be relaxed and easy-going, but also has a cheeky, playful side that adds fun to her personality. Good with smaller breeds of dogs, Lucy makes a sweet and loving companion for any home.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Beautiful Lucy is lady who needs to find a supportive, patient & kind family. Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Red
TEXT: This is our boy Red. Say hello to this charming boy who is looking for his forever home. Red is relaxed on lead, great to handle, making your daily walks very enjoyable. He has had frequent exposure to leisurely strolls in town and enjoys the slow paced lifestyle. He is very friendly and will stop for pats or to say hello. At times Red can be apprehensive in new environments. Once he has found his feet, he takes the world in his stride and settles into a happy pace of life. He would suit a quieter home with any humans, big or small, that are willing to give him all of the love in the world.

NAME: Paddy
TEXT: Mr Paddy! This gentle giant is such an easy-going, laid-back goof ball! He is always down to clown or just take it easy and rest his feet. He gets on well with smaller breeds of dogs- there's a Yorkie always saying hello :) Paddy interacts positively with new people, even younger children. He would love to have yard where he can run about, chasing toys thrown by his new best friends :)

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Quote from foster career, We have loved getting to know Katie and giving her the opportunity to enjoy her new life as a pet. Being the older sister, she is very independent and settles very easily. She is very happy to sit on her bed whilst you work or go about your day. She is toilet trained and has fallen into her new routine very easily. She gets so excited to see us, as exemplified with her happy, whipping tail (duck for cover!). She tends to jump up on you when she’s very excited, but this is something we are working on and have already seen great improvements on. Katie walks well on a leash and doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small. She has done well approaching small dogs and children and saying hello. Katie would be a great pet for a someone looking for an independent dog that will also shower you will love and affection. __________________________________________________________________________ Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals and is now in suburban foster care enjoying cuddly toys, living out the back and coming in the home for the evening.

NAME: Flash (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Flash is a lovable boy with a heart as big as his appetite! If you’re looking for a sweet companion who knows how to enjoy the simple things in life, Flash might just be your perfect match. This handsome pup is a fan of food (treats are definitely the way to his heart 🍖), and he never says no to a fun toy. But his true specialty? Mastering the art of relaxation. Flash absolutely thrives when he’s stretched out on the couch, soaking up the good life. Flash has experience in a foster home and has shown that he could be left alone for multiple hours as long as he somewhere comfy to stretch out and relax Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. Flash would prefer a home where this is no small children or other animals as he prefers to be a solo guy. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. Watch Flash here: https://youtu.be/a4Vk92SvmEY?si=qwlyZhvy56Jmp_Oa **Flash is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 7 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Baby
TEXT: Nobody puts baby in the corner! This little lady is looking to learn all about the world with you! She would suit short hours alone as a solo girl, or longer hours with a canine companion. Polite with dogs big or small, beautiful Baby has so much love to give and is searching for the right place to call home. If this Baby girl sounds like the perfect addition to your family, apply to take her home from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Irena
TEXT: Are you ready to be laughing with your newest furry friend? Well, Irena will have you cackling. She is a true definition of a family favorite. She is relaxed, chilled and loves giving/receiving attention confident she is in doing so. Irena enjoys spending time with her humans or basking in the sunshine. She loves to have someone's full-attention so is best suited to being an only dog. Irena knows her name well and with a little bit of getting used to your voice she will come (running) straight back. Irena has had experience living inside a family home, is great on a lead and easy to live with.

NAME: Moses
TEXT: Are you after a dog to be totally besotted by you? Well meet Moses, a quirky and loveable boy whose after his forever home. Moses boasts confidence and is extremely gentle in his approach. He has been around children 4+ and will request frequent pats. He has been brought up with a jack russel at home, but would benefit from a meet and greet prior to being adopted. Moses will be attending our Adoption Day at Glandore Wines on the 5th of October.

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Spot is independent and enjoys spending time roaming around. Spot would suit a family who is after a companion to cruise around the backyard with. At times Spot can be weary and a bit timid in new environments but with the right re-assurance, she recovers really well. If you're interested in meeting our darling Spot, please apply now.

NAME: Julian
TEXT: Julian is best described as a distinguished gentleman. He is calm, friendly and an easy-going boy who just goes about his day without a fuss. He's walked around busy streets, schools, shopping centres as well as farms and paddocks. Nothing much fazes Julian, including other large dogs, small dogs and children. He loves people and pats and loves a walk, rarely pulling. Julian would suit most households and make a very special and loving companion who wants to be with you.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Meet Gus: The Gentle Soul Gus is a serene and soft-natured Greyhound who thrives in a calm and loving environment. His gentle demeanor and shy personality make him a unique and endearing companion for the right home. Gus may be a bit reserved at first, but his gentle nature shines through once he feels comfortable. He’s the kind of dog who appreciates a quiet and patient approach, revealing his sweet personality in a calm and loving setting. Gus thrives in a peaceful environment where he can feel secure and relaxed. He’s not a fan of loud noises or bustling activities, so a tranquil home is ideal for him. Despite his shy nature, Gus is friendly and gets along well with other dogs. He enjoys their company and can be a great addition to a home with existing canine companions. If you’re looking for a sweet, soft-natured Greyhound who will flourish in a calm, loving home, Gus is the perfect match. He’s ready to bring his gentle presence and quiet companionship into your life.

NAME: Sub
TEXT: Sub is a joyful greyhound whose enthusiasm and positive energy are truly contagious. She approaches each day with a wagging tail and a bright smile, spreading happiness wherever she goes. She is a high-energy girl who thrives on regular physical activity. Her zest for life is evident in her love for playtime and her eagerness to engage in various activities. Sub absolutely adores zoomies! She loves to let loose and sprint around her playful bursts of speed are a sight to behold. Sub is a vibrant and spirited greyhound looking for an energetic home where her zest for life can shine. If you’re ready to embrace her joyful nature and provide a dynamic environment, Sub is eager to become your new best friend!

NAME: Corene
TEXT: Corene carries herself with a natural poise and assurance. She navigates new environments and situations with a calm self-assuredness that makes her a standout companion. Corene loves to stay on the move. Whether it’s a brisk walk, a run in the park, or playtime in the backyard, she’s always ready for an adventure. Corene’s curiosity knows no bounds. She’s always exploring her surroundings with an eager eye, making sure she’s aware of all that’s happening around her. Corene gets along well with medium and large dogs. She’s confident and social, but her interactions are best suited for companions of similar size and energy levels. Smaller dogs may find her enthusiasm overwhelming. Corene is a spirited and delightful greyhound ready to bring her energy and enthusiasm into a loving home. If you’re looking for a confident and active companion, Corene might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Bailey
TEXT: Are you looking for a new furry companion to help bring out of their shell? Bailey would be the ideal companion for you! Bailey is our beautiful nervous nelly, he loves his routine and the people he is around all the time, but new people can make him revert into his greyhound bubble. Bailey is searching for home that is quiet and will allow him the time to really show off his personality. He would suit an avid Knights fan as he enjoys spending his Sunday afternoons by the TV, Bailey enjoys basking in the sunshine and having a splash at the beach. He is currently living inside/outside and is quiet and relaxed, he is okay to be left alone so long as he is in his safe spot.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Due to Billy's young age he is inquisitive and active. This can be a great age to bring a beautiful hound like Billy into your life so you can grow and create good memories together.

NAME: Zarva
TEXT: Meet Zavra! Zarva is a very sweet natured boy. He is very curious & interested in the world. He positively interacts with those around him; children & smaller dogs :) Zarva wants to be involved. He'll be happy doing almost about anything. Whether it's a family movie day or spending a day outside going on adventures :) Enquire now & arrange to meet Zarva!

NAME: Maisie
TEXT: Meet Maisie! She might have the age of a senior lady, but definitely doesn't show it! Maisie is sweet curious girl. Eager to explore & learn. She might take a little while to warm up but once she does, she is full of character. Maisie would be best suited to a home with bigger dogs only, or a single dog home. Older kids to play with her preferred. Maisie would become a very loyal part of your home once settled & feeling comfortable :)

NAME: Meg
TEXT: Meg is the epitome of gentle charm, with a touch of bashfulness that adds to his irresistible appeal. This shy guy isn't just looking for any home; he's on a quest for his own private sanctuary, where he can be the star of the show without any pesky co-stars stealing his spotlight. Meg's motto? "One dog, one throne!" He's not one for sharing his kingdom, but he'll gladly share his love with respectful children who understand the art of giving him space but love when he likes. With Meg around, every day is an adventure filled with quiet moments of contemplation, punctuated by bursts of zoomies when no one's looking. So, if you're ready to welcome a regal greyhound into your castle and bask in the glory of his majestic presence then Meg is the dashing companion you've been searching for. Contact our Western Sydney facility to arrange a meet and greet and get ready to embark on a journey of laughter, love, and endless tail wags with this shy but lovable boy!

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Introducing Sandy, a beautiful and gentle girl who is ready to bring a ton of joy into your life! Known for her soft and gentle demeanor, Sandy possesses the ability to fill any room with calmness and love. Sandy is not just a dog; she's a friend and companion. Her kind and loving nature ensures that she gets along beautifully with both children and other dogs. She is known for her soft, soulful eyes that seem to look straight into your heart. What Sandy would love the most is a family that showers her with the same affection that she effortlessly gives to others. In her new home, Sandy would enjoy a cozy corner to curl up in, a safe garden to explore, and a family that she can love and be loved by. Sandy is just waiting to create numerous wonderful memories with a family who adores her. She promises a lifetime of love and dedication to those who welcome her into their heart.

NAME: Wighton
TEXT: Hello! My name is Wighton. I was known as Four Five on the racing tracks, but I hung up my racing collar late last year. I'm a courteous fellow, though I may take a little time to open up. Once I'm comfortable, I love to display my energetic zoomies. I've encountered several small dogs and they don't pique my interest much. I'm looking for a home with a backyard where I can have some space to myself from time to time. And, if you could take me on walks, that would be wonderful. I am looking forward to meeting my new human companions, so be sure to hit the 'apply' button when you can.

NAME: Miss Ling
TEXT: Miss Ling is a big snuggle bunny. She is sweet and affectionate and will seek out affection Described as a happy girl she will bring a ray of sunshine to your life and be happy to be by your side through thick and thin. Miss Ling may be on the other side of 9 but she still has a lot of love to share and is looking for the right person to shower her love on

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Say hello to Luna, a sociable and friendly female dog who is sure to win your heart. Luna's radiant persona lights up every room she enters, and her charming nature has a contagious effect that brightens up everyone around her. Luna's love for people is truly one of her fine characteristics. She adores being in the company of humans and is a strong advocate for endless belly rubs, cuddles, and ear scratches. She thrives off attention and relishes in making every moment delightful for you, and herself of course. Interactive playtime is Luna's favorite! She gets immense joy out of chasing toys, whether it's a game of fetch or squeaky toys that catch her attention. This playful activity helps Luna stimulate her mind and use her attentive nature to the best of her abilities. In a dog community, Luna prefers the companionship of medium to large breed dogs. She blends well with her fellow canine mates, her easygoing nature allowing her to adapt quickly to their play style. This adaptability makes her the perfect addition to a family with a medium to large breed dog. In stepping into Luna's life, be prepared for an overflow of love and memorable moments. Luna is ready to love her new family wholeheartedly, and promises to bring with her a bundle of joy, laughter, and playful adventures.

NAME: Tori
TEXT: Looking to spruce up your abode? We have some styling tips: Simply add the stunning Tori aka "Rattlin' Style" into your house! You'll be all the fashion and talk of the town! This strikingly elegant and beautiful girl has other lovely qualities too: ✅ Very affectionate little lady who thrives on human companionship. ✅ Good with older children: - Tori currently interacts with children aged 6+years old - She is relaxed and calm around older kids. She recognizes their gentle and caring presence, and her natural instincts guide her to be extra gentle and patient. - Tori is the kind of dog who will offer a warm nuzzle or a gentle paw to her young humans, ensuring an unbreakable bond. ✅ Tori is a good, polite girl in her kennel. ✅ This clever lass has an understanding of appropriate conduct and is respectful of boundaries. ✅ Good with Medium-Large breed dogs: - Regularly interacts with other Greyhounds. - Tori interacts best with male Greyhounds. - She would need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs. ✅ Tori loves her toys! Watching her play is a joy in itself. Her evident fun and energy is contagious! - so both Tori and you can have a grand old time! Tori will need a fully fenced yard. Tori can sometimes Resource Guard her food, so it is best if she is fed separately and left alone to eat her dins. If having a devoted dame in your life sounds like a pretty picture, then Enquire or Apply to Adopt Tori (Rattlin' Style) to style up your home 😉 She may just improve your life and happiness too!

NAME: Jeremy
TEXT: Meet Jeremy – A True Distinguished Gentleman 🐾 Jeremy is a handsome, older gentleman who perfectly embodies the calm and graceful nature of a classic Greyhound. With his gentle manners and relaxed personality, he’s the kind of companion who brings a quiet, comforting presence into any home. He walks beautifully on lead, making outings with him an easy and enjoyable experience. At heart, Jeremy is a laid-back boy who much prefers lounging around and taking life at his own relaxed pace—he’s truly earned his title as a “distinguished gentleman.” Jeremy is very social and gets along well with both small dogs and larger breeds, making him a great addition to a multi-dog household. His easygoing nature also means he settles in nicely and enjoys simply being around his people. If you’re looking for a calm, affectionate companion who is past the busy puppy stage and ready to enjoy the quieter side of life, Jeremy could be the perfect match.
